--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self.ss_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.fx_data:dispose_all()

	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.chase_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's10_chase_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_enter_start
		start_coroutine(self.guard_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.zone_enter_end then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's10_chase_enter_zone') then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.back_and_return_scene, self, 's10_chase_enter_zone')
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's10_boss_enter_zone') then
			self.current_state = self.states.boss_enter_start
			start_coroutine(self.boss_enter_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.boss_enter_start and
			e.BattleGroupName == 's10_battle_boss' then
		self.current_section_state = self.states.boss_battle_end
		start_coroutine(self.boss_eliminate_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--스테이지 시작 연출
function local_class:start_routine()
	--현재 섹션에서 스테이지 진입 했을 경우
	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'field' })

		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	else
		scene_util.hide_weapon(self.get_rimuru())
		scene_util.hide_weapon(self.get_milim())
		scene_util.hide_weapon(self.get_shuna())
	end

	self:pre_setting()

	self.dynamic_npc:load_async()

	--연출
	self.current_state = self.states.chase_start
	self:chase_start_scene()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

--추격 시작
function local_class:chase_start_scene()
	local hero = self.get_legendary_hero()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local rimuru = self.get_rimuru()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local milim = self.get_milim()
	local monster_1 = get_character('s10_monster_1_3')
	local monster_2 = get_character('s10_monster_1_7')

	local player_group = { rimuru, shuna, milim }
	local demon_group = { hero, demon_queen }
	local monster_group = {}

	local count = 7
	for i = 1, count do
		local npc = get_character('s10_monster_1_' .. i)
		table.insert(monster_group, npc)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--1번 신도(attack,relesae2회): 어서 녀석들을 막아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster_1, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s10_0_1')

	--2번 신도(attack,cast): 교주님을 지켜야 해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster_2, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s10_0_2')

	--화면 shake 0.1/ 0.3초 와 동시에 1번 2번 신도 (down,attack,idle)(jump1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_03')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ monster_1, monster_2 }, 'down', false)
	character_util.group_normal_jump({ monster_1, monster_2 }, '01_player_jump_01')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라가 에리나 위치까지 0.5초간 이동( 그리드를 영향을 받음 )
	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_hero_jump_pos') + vector(0, 0, -4), 0.5)

	--에리나가 그리드 밖에서 부터 (dagger_run)으로 1번 위치까지 1초간 이동
	do
		local duration = 1
		local move_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_hero_jump_pos') + vector(0, 0, -4)

		scene_util.set_anim(hero, self, 'dagger_run')

		wp_util.move_async(hero, move_pos, nil, duration)

		scene_util.set_anim(hero, self, 'dagger_idle')
	end

	--1초간  y축 2 높이로 2번위치까지 jump해서 이동
	do
		local duration = 1
		local height = 2
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_hero_jump_pos')
		local start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)

		camera_util.move(target_pos, duration)

		--jump 시작할 때 화면 shake 0.1 / 0.3초
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--jump 시작할 때 jump 자리에 FX_minotaur_buttbounce 출력
		self.fx:bounce():Instantiate(start_pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')

		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
			local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

			character_util.set_position(hero, lerp_pos, true)
		end)
	end

	--착지와 동시에 에리나 위치에 fx_lasthit
	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(hero.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	--화면 shake 0.1 / 0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--에리나 애니메이션 (legendary_hero/attack1) 실행
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(hero, 'legendary_hero/attack1')
	scene_util.set_anim(hero, self, { name = 'legendary_hero/attack1', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration - 0.2)
	--에리나 이펙트 fx_m_legendaryhero_slash_360 출력
	self.fx:slash_360():Instantiate(hero.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_erina_event_01')

	--몬스터 들에게 fx_m_legendaryhero_shield_hit 출력
	--평타 실행과 동시에 초록색 몬스터들 전원 spindead
	for _, npc in pairs(monster_group) do
		self.fx:shield_hit():Instantiate(npc.Position)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
		character_util.air_spin(npc)
	end

	--attack1 종료 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--에리나(down,attack,release 2회): 이쪽이다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self,
			'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s10_1')

	--(1)리리스 (2)리무루 (3)슈나 (4) 밀림
	do
		local duration = 1.5
		local wp_key = 'slime_move'
		local move_pos = vector(0, 0, 12.5)

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = rimuru,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, rimuru.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, shuna.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, milim.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		dash_sfx:Stop()
		dash_sfx = nil
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--리리스(left,attack,idle): 정말 끝도없이 쏟아지는 군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s10_2')

	--리무루(left,attack,cross_arm): 라파엘 씨. 마정석의 위치는?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')

	self.ss_util:show_monologue_speech_async(rimuru, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			'ss_slime_main_s10_3')

	--라파엘: 숲 내부에 강한 마나를 감지. 이대로 쭉 전진하면 마정석의 위치까지 도달할 수 있습니다.
	self.ss_util:show_raphael_speech_async('ss_slime_main_s10_4')

	--이때 화면 shake0.1 / 0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--화면내에 캐릭터 (left,attack,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(player_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(player_group, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(player_group, false)

	scene_util.set_group_direction(demon_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(demon_group, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(demon_group, '01_jump_01')

	--화면 중앙 좌측[shout] : 막아! 시간이라도 끌란 말이야!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_main_s10_5', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8) })

	--리리스(left,attack,release2회): 도망치기 시작했어! 서두르자 에리나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_6', skip = true })

	--에리나 0.5초간 좌측 2칸 (run)으로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(hero)
	wp_util.move_async(hero, hero.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true })

	--에리나(left,attack,sword_attack 모션끝에 정지): 한 놈도 도망치게 두지 않겠다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, keep = true, sfx_name = '02_erina_event_02' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_7', skip = true })


	--에리나와 리리스 속도 7로 좌측 그리드 밖에서 사라짐
	do
		local speed = 8
		local wp_key = 'demon_move'
		local hero_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', hero.Position, -2)
		local demon_queen_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', demon_queen.Position, -2)

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = hero,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.remove_anim(hero)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero_pos, speed, nil, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(demon_queen)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen, demon_queen_pos, speed, nil, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		dash_sfx:Stop()
		dash_sfx = nil

		self:set_npc_by_data(self.enter_start_npc_data)

		character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(demon_group)
	end

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(player_group)

	--에리나 리리스 출발 1초 후 컨트롤 해제
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:guard_enter_scene()
	local hero = self.get_legendary_hero()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local rimuru = self.get_rimuru()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local milim = self.get_milim()

	local player_group = { demon_queen, hero, rimuru, shuna, milim }
	local demon_group = { hero, demon_queen }
	local monster_group = self.dynamic_npc:get_group_a()

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.7)

	do
		local duration = 2
		local wp_key = 'align_move'
		local rimuru_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_demon_queen_guard_pos') + vector(0, 0, -1)
		local shuna_pos = rimuru_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

		--리무루 슈나 1차 정렬 위치까지 2초간 정렬 (up,idle,idle)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, rimuru_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, shuna_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		--에리나 리리스 로 카메라 1초간 이동
		camera_util.move_async(demon_queen.Position, 1)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--카메라 대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--후 좌측 그리드 끝으로 1초간 이동
	camera_util.move_async(demon_queen.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--좌측에서 몬스터 8체가 그리드 밖에서 부터 점프 위치까지 0.75초간 이동
	do
		local wp_key = 'monster_group_move'
		local duration = 0.75
		local move_pos = vector(4, 0, 0)
		local init_pos = vector(4, 1, 65)
		local offset = {
			vector(0, 0, 0),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(0, 0, -1),
			vector(1, 0, -1),
			vector(0, 0, -2),
			vector(1, 0, -2),
			vector(0, 0, -3),
			vector(1, 0, -3),
		}

		for num, npc in pairs(monster_group) do
			npc.Position = init_pos + offset[num]
			character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + move_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_03')

		camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--점프하여 1 초간 착지위치까지 이동
	do
		local duration = 1
		local start_pos = vector(0, 1, 0)
		local target_pos = vector(4, 0, 0)
		local height = 1
		local forward_pos = start_pos

		--사냥개 (pounce)
		scene_util.set_group_anim({ monster_group[4], monster_group[6] }, self, 'pounce')

		--오거 (jump)
		scene_util.set_group_anim({ monster_group[3], monster_group[5] }, self, 'jump')

		--헐크 (get)
		scene_util.set_group_anim({ monster_group[1], monster_group[2], monster_group[7], monster_group[8] }, self, 'get')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
			local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)
			local move_pos = lerp_pos - forward_pos
			forward_pos = lerp_pos

			for _, npc in pairs(monster_group) do
				character_util.set_position(npc, npc.Position + move_pos, true)
			end
		end)

		character_util.remove_group_anim(monster_group)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_golem_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_06')
	end

	--착지 할때 화면 shake0.2/0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	--동시에 화면 흔들릴 때 에리나 리리스 (left,attack,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(demon_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(demon_group, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(demon_group, false)

	--괴물들 1초간 우측으로 1칸 이동 시작
	--리무르와 슈나가 표시된 위치까지 1초간 정렬
	do
		local wp_key = 'monster_move'
		local duration = 1
		local move_pos = vector(1, 0, 0)

		local rimuru_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_milim_finish_pos') + vector(1, 0, -1.5)
		local shuna_pos = rimuru_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

		for _, npc in pairs(monster_group) do
			character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + move_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		end

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = rimuru,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, rimuru_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, shuna_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		dash_sfx:Stop()
		dash_sfx = nil
	end

	--밀림 y 20 위치에서 1초간 착지
	local milim_wait = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		local height = 10
		local duration = 0.4
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_milim_finish_pos')
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, height)

		--밀림 (smile)(jingak 모션정지)
		scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(milim, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, scale = 999 })

		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
			character_util.set_position(milim, cur_value, true)
		end)

		--착지할때 화면 shake0.2/0.3초
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

		--착지한 위치에 fx_demonpowergirl_basic_3rd 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_milim_stomp_02')
		self.fx.smash():Instantiate(milim.Position)

		--밀림이 하늘에서 떨어져서 나머지 (1)~(5)까지 제거
		local npc_group = {
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_1'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_2'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_3'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_4'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_5'),
		}

		--괴물들 spindead
		for _, npc in pairs(npc_group) do
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
			self.fx.hit():Instantiate(npc.Position)
			character_util.air_spin(npc, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })
		end

		milim_wait = false
	end)

	--리무루 스킬 이펙트 사용하여 (6)(8) 제거
	do
		local npc_group = {
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_6'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_7'),
			self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_npc_1_8'),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_rimuru_slash_03')
		local fx_rimuru_slash = self.fx:rimuru_3rd_slash():Instantiate(rimuru.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
		fx_rimuru_slash.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

		--괴물들 spindead 방향 우측
		--fx_hit+Damage Squish, Red pulse 적용
		--(8)번 위치에 fx_lasthit
		for num, npc in pairs(npc_group) do
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
			character_util.air_spin(npc, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })

			if num == 3 then
				self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(npc.Position)
			end
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(rimuru, self, { name = 'attack' })

		scene_util.set_anim_async(rimuru, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rimuru)
	end

	while milim_wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--1.5 초대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(milim)

	scene_util.set_group_emotion(demon_group, self, 'idle')

	scene_util.hide_weapon(rimuru)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(milim)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(shuna)

	--이 후 해당 대열로 1초간 정렬
	do
		local wp_key = 'player_move'
		local duration = 1
		local milim_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_milim_finish_pos') + vector(1, 0, 0)
		local rimunu_pos = milim_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
		local shuna_pos = milim_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, milim_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, rimunu_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, shuna_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		camera_util.move_async(milim_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0), duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--리무루(right,tired,bomb_idle): 정말 끝도 없이 쏟아지네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_8', skip = true })

	-- 에리나(left,idle,nod 2회): 일정한 간격으로 괴물들을 불러오는것 같군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_9', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 우리를 저지하려는 목적이 아니야. 뻔한 술수지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_10', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(idle,bomb_idle): 조무래기들로 시간을 끌고 도주하려는 계획이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_11', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(idle,idle): 리무루, 어때? 녀석들의 본거지를 파악할 수 있겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_12', skip = true })

	-- 리무루(attack,nod 2회): 응! 강한 마나가 느껴지는 공간이 하나 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_13', skip = true })

	-- 화면 shake 0.1/ 2초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)

	-- 이때 전원 (attack,idle,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(player_group, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(player_group, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(player_group, '01_jump_01')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 괴물 9체 1초간 표시된 위치까지 이동
	-- 이때 에리나와 리리스가 해당 위치까지 1초간 이동 (괴물 이동과 동시에)
	do
		local wp_key = 'guard_move'
		local duration = 1
		local hero_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_hero_guard_pos')
		local demon_queen_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_demon_queen_guard_pos')

		local guard_monster_group = self.dynamic_npc:get_group_b()
		local monstar_default_pos = demon_queen_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)
		local monster_offset = {
			monstar_default_pos,
			monstar_default_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(2, 0, -0.5),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(1, 0, -1),
			monstar_default_pos + vector(2, 0, -1),
		}

		--monster move

		for i = 1, #monster_offset do
			local npc = guard_monster_group[i]

			npc.Position = monster_offset[i] + vector(0, 0, -6)

			character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, monster_offset[i],
					nil, duration, self, wp_key, { end_callback = function()
						scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'push')
						character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 99999)
					end })
		end

		--demon queen
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen, demon_queen_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		--party
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, rimuru.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, shuna.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, duration, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, milim.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, -5), duration)

		--이동 종료 까지 대기
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		--이때 에리나 리리스 중앙에 fx_lasthit 출력
		self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(demon_queen.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

		--화면 shake 0.2/ 0.3초
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

		-- 에리나 리리스 (down,attack,push)(shake0.03)
		scene_util.set_group_anim(demon_group, self, 'push')
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(demon_group, self, 'attack')
		character_util.shake(demon_queen, 0.03, 99999)
		character_util.shake(hero, 0.03, 99999)

		-- 에리나: 이대로 지나가게 두지 않겠다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_summershapira_stomp_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_14', skip = true })

		-- 리리스: 리무루! 교주가 도망치기 전에 서둘러 이동해!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_15', skip = true })

		-- 리무루(attack,idle): 맡겨둬!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_16', skip = true })

		--리리스 에리나가 몬스터를 밀어 아래로 한칸 이동
		do
			local push_duration = 1
			local push_key = 'push_move'
			local push_pos = vector(0, 0, -1)
			--monster move
			for i = 1, #guard_monster_group do
				local npc = guard_monster_group[i]
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + push_pos,
						nil, push_duration, self, push_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })
			end

			--demon queen
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero.Position + push_pos,
					nil, push_duration, self, push_key)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + push_pos,
					nil, push_duration, self, push_key)

			--이동 종료 까지 대기
			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, push_key)
		end

		--에리나 초기화
		character_util.stop_shake(hero)
		character_util.remove_anim(hero)

		-- 리리스 (down, attack, demon_ceo/attack5)
		character_util.stop_shake(demon_queen)
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(demon_queen, 'demon_ceo/attack5')
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'demon_ceo/attack5', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration - 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_demon_hand_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_demon_claw_01')

		-- 리리스가 스킬 사용하여 앞에 있는 9체의 괴물제거
		-- fx_cwp_lilith_death_scratch_claw(Clone) 출력 (하단 괴물 전원 에어스핀 사망)
		local fx_ceo_claw = self.fx:ceo_claw():Instantiate(demon_queen.Position + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0))
		fx_ceo_claw.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

		-- 카메라 shake 세기 0.2 / 0.5초
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

		-- 괴물들에 fx_hit 추가
		for _, npc in pairs(guard_monster_group) do
			character_util.stop_shake(npc)
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(npc.Position)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
			character_util.air_spin(npc)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 괴물들 spindead 시작하면 에리나 (down,attack,idle)
		character_util.remove_anim(demon_queen)

		-- 괴물들 spindead 종료 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--에리나 리리스 0.5초간 하단 그리드 밖으로 사라짐
	do
		local wp_key = 'demon_move'
		local duration = 0.5
		local demon_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', demon_queen.Position, -2)
		local hero_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', hero.Position, -2)

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = demon_queen,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen, demon_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		dash_sfx:Stop()
		dash_sfx = nil

		demon_queen.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		hero.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ rimuru, shuna, milim })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.current_state = self.states.zone_enter_end

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:boss_enter_scene()
	local bishop = self.get_believer_bishop()
	local rimuru = self.get_rimuru()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local milim = self.get_milim()
	local clayman = self.get_clayman()
	local clayman_battle = self.get_clayman_battle()

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.7)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc', parent = bishop })

	--교주쪽으로 2초간 카메라 이동
	do
		local wp_key = 'align_move'
		local duration = 2
		local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_shuna_boss_pos') + vector(7, 0, 0)

		--리무루 일행 이벤트 정렬 위치로 2초간 정렬
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, align_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, align_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key)

		camera_util.move_async(bishop.Position, duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	-- 교주(left,attack,eat): 멍청한 녀석들 본거지를 들키다니…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bishop, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s10_18', skip = true })

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	-- 교주 0.5초간 하단 1칸 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(bishop)
	wp_util.move_async(bishop, bishop.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), nil, 0.5)

	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc', parent = bishop })

	-- 교주(left,attack,eat) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(bishop, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(bishop, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

function local_class:pre_ending_scene()

	--리리스(down,idle,idle): 대화는 다 마쳤어?

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_main_s11_43', skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--이제 돌아갈 채비는 마쳤어.
		{ 'ss_slime_main_s11_44', 'normal' },
		--조금만 더 돌아보고 올게.
		{ 'ss_slime_main_s11_45', 'normal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--이제 돌아갈 채비는 마쳤어.
		--엔딩 연출
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		self:ending_scene()

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		--조금만 더 돌아보고 올게.
		--컨트롤 해제
		scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'right', false)
	end
end

function local_class:hero_landing(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	--FIXME: 히어로 랜딩 애니메이션이 요청이 들어 갔기에 이에 맞춰 애니메이션이 추가될 때 교체 해주는 것이 좋을 듯.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, scale = 999 }
	, { name = 'attack' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
end

function local_class:allow_change_field_music(can_change)
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('ShortStorySlimeController')

	stage_controller.can_change_field_music = can_change
end
--endregion scene

return local_class

		npc_name = 's2_dynamic_npc_',
		spec_name = {
			'short_story_slime_demon_business_male',
			'shortstory_slime_demon_punk_female',
			'shortstory_slime_demon_kid_girl',
			'shortstory_slime_demon_civilian_female'
		},
		count = 4,
		container = nil,
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

				for i = 1, this.count do
					dynamic_npc_spec[this.npc_name .. i] = this.spec_name[i]
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)
			end
		end,
		get_npc = function(this, index)
			return this.container[this.npc_name .. index]
		end,
		get_npc_table = function(this)
			local return_table = {}

			for i = 1, this.count do
				table.insert(return_table, this.container[this.npc_name .. i])
			end

			return return_table
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)
				this.container = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- zones
	self.zones = {
		police_office_zone_1 = 's2_police_zone_1',
		police_office_zone_2 = 's2_police_zone_2',
		police_office_out_zone = 's2_police_out_zone',
		out_zone = 's2_out_zone_',
		shion_event_zone = 's2_shion_event_zone',
		benimaru_event_zone = 's2_benimaru_event_zone',
	}

	-- quest marker
	self.quest_marker_name = 'main_quest'
end

end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()

	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/Common/Util')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.legendary_hero(), self.controller)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.bartender(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.bartender(2), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.waitress(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.waitress(2), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.oldman(), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.oldwoman(), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.homeless_male(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.homeless_male(2), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.swat(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.swat(2), 'disabled')

	self.virtual_wall:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	self.markers = nil
	self.zones = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.police_office_event_2 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.characters.legendary_hero(), e.Target) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_legendary_hero
		start_coroutine(self.legendary_hero_talk_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.police_office_zone_1) then
		self.current_state = self.states.police_office_event_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_police_office_event_1, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.out_zone .. 'left') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.return_party, self, e.Zone, 'left')

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.out_zone .. 'right') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.return_party, self, e.Zone, 'right')

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.police_office_event_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.police_office_out_zone) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.return_party_police_office, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.police_office_event_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.police_office_zone_2) then
		self.current_state = self.states.police_office_event_2
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_police_office_event_2, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.police_office_event_2 and not self.show_shion_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.shion_event_zone) then
		self.show_shion_event = true
		start_coroutine(self.shion_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.police_office_event_2 and not self.show_benimaru_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.benimaru_event_zone) then
		self.show_benimaru_event = true
		start_coroutine(self.benimaru_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 시작 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	local rimuru = self.characters.rimuru()
	local shuna = self.characters.shuna()
	local souei = self.characters.souei()
	local legendary_hero = self.characters.legendary_hero()

	local npcs = { rimuru, shuna, souei, legendary_hero }

	local rimuru_pos = self.markers.start_pos()
	local shuna_pos = rimuru_pos + vector(1, 0, 1)
	local souei_pos = rimuru_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	local legendary_hero_pos = rimuru_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	character_util.set_position(rimuru, rimuru_pos)
	character_util.set_position(shuna, shuna_pos)
	character_util.set_position(souei, souei_pos)
	character_util.set_position(legendary_hero, legendary_hero_pos)

	scene_util.set_group_direction(npcs, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(npcs)

	self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

	--최초 NPC 다음과 같이 배치
	--마계 시민 (남) (좌표 -96, 0, 77)
	--스파인 명 : demon_civilian_business_male
	local business_male = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npc(1)
	character_util.set_position(business_male, self.markers.business_male_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(business_male, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(business_male)

	local punk_female = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npc(2)
	character_util.set_position(punk_female, self.markers.punk_female_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(punk_female, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(punk_female)

	local kid_girl = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npc(3)
	character_util.set_position(kid_girl, self.markers.kid_girl_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(kid_girl, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_girl)

	local civilian_female = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npc(4)
	character_util.set_position(civilian_female, self.markers.civilian_female_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(civilian_female, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(civilian_female)

	-- 시작 전 screen 세팅
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	local camera_move_scene = function(number, move_vec)
		local camera_pos = self.markers.start_camera_pos(number)
		local camera_move_pos = camera_pos + move_vec

		--최초 화면은 ●지점을 포커스한 상태.
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		--7초에 걸쳐 방향으로 6칸 패닝.
		camera_util.move(camera_move_pos, 7)
		wait_for_sec(6)

		--6초가 되었을 때, 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	local city_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_city_01', fade_in_time = 2,
								 loop = true, volume = 0.8, type_priority = 'loop' })

	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_move_scene, 1, vector(6, 0, 0)
			},
			function()
				--1.5초가 되었을 때, 마계 시민 (남) left 방향 전환 1회. 0.5초 대기 이후 right 방향 전환 1회.
				wait_for_sec(1.5)

				scene_util.set_direction(business_male, 'left', false)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				scene_util.set_direction(business_male, 'right', false)
				--0.5초 대기 이후 NPC가 4초에 걸쳐 (좌표 -96, 0, 72) 로 이동.
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				wp_util.move_async(business_male,
						business_male.Position + vector(0, 0, -5), nil, 4.5)
			end
	)

	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_move_scene, 2, vector(0, 0, -6)
			},
			function()
				local wp_key = 'civilian_wp'

				--0초에 마계 시민 7초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 10칸 이동.
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(punk_female, punk_female.Position + vector(0, 0, -10),
						nil, 7, self, wp_key)

				wait_for_sec(1)

				--1초에 꼬마 여, 마계 시민 (여) 동시에 4초에 걸쳐 위쪽으로 6칸 이동.
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kid_girl, kid_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
						nil, 6, self, wp_key)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(civilian_female, civilian_female.Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
						nil, 6, self, wp_key)

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
			end
	)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(city_sfx, 4)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--2초에 걸쳐 리무루,슈나,에리나,소우에이 왼쪽으로 2칸 이동.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_move'

		for i, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
					nil, 2, self, wp_key)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--리무루 (left, surprise, jump 1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(rimuru, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(rimuru, true)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--리무루 (left, surprise, idle) : 여기가 이세계의 도시인가…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s2_1')

	--해당 대사는 방향을 전환하면서 대사 출력됨.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--리무루 (up방향 전환 이후 0.5초 대기 후 down 방향 전환, surprise, idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'up')
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'down')
			end,
			{
				--리무루(surprise, idle) : 아무리 봐도 내가 전생하기 전에 살던 곳이랑 크게 다르지 않은데…
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, rimuru, 'ss_slime_main_s2_2'
			}
	)

	--리무루 (down, surprise, idle) : 마치 도쿄의 야경을 보는 느낌이야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_main_s2_3')

	--슈나 (left, idle, idle) : 에리나… 님이라고 하셨죠?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuna, 'ss_slime_main_s2_4')

	--에리나 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'right', false)
	--슈나 (left, idle, cast) : 저희 일행 분들을 찾으려면 어디로 가면 되나요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			'left',
			'cast',
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s2_5')

	--리무루 (up, idle, idle) 전환.
	character_util.remove_emotion(rimuru)
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'up', false)
	--에리나 (right, idle, release 2회) : 여기서 위쪽 길로 꺾으면 중앙 경찰서가 하나 있다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(legendary_hero, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s2_6')

	--에리나 (right, idle, idle) : 네 동료들은 지금 그곳에 있어.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(legendary_hero, 'ss_slime_main_s2_7')

	--리무루 (up, idle, idle) : 경찰서에 있다고?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_main_s2_8')

	--리무루 (up, idle, idle) : 진짜로 현대 배경의 세계잖아…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_main_s2_9')

	--리무루,슈나,에리나,소우에이 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_group_direction(npcs, 'left', false)
	--(플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'police_field', target = self.markers.police_office_center_pos(1) },
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('main_s1_exit_inner') },
		{ zone = 'demonworld_field', target = get_field_object('police_office_in_exit') },
	})
end

		end,
		pop_item = function(this, item_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					if this.data[i].ItemPlaceholder.ItemId == item_id then
						local item = this.data[i]
						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					this.data[i]:ConsumeComplete()
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- dynamic npc
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		npc_name = 's3_dynamic_npc_',
		spec_name = 'shortstory_slime_believer_wizard',
		count = 4,
		container = nil,
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

				for i = 1, this.count do
					dynamic_npc_spec[this.npc_name .. i] = this.spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)
			end
		end,
		get_npc_table = function(this)
			local return_table = {}

			for i = 1, this.count do
				table.insert(return_table, this.container[this.npc_name .. i])
			end

			return return_table
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)
				this.container = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- 루프 관련 처리
	self.attack_loop = true
	self.stage_ended = false

	-- battle group
	self.battle_group_name = 's3_battle'
	self.battle_zone_name = 's8_battle_zone'
	self.battle_gate_name = 'village_battle_gate_'
	self.battle_gate_count = 15

	-- item
	self.rock_id = 21186
	self.book_id = 21187

	-- quest marker
	self.quest_marker_name = 'main_quest'
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()

	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/Common/Util')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.items:dispose_all()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	local civilian_count = 4

	for i = 1, civilian_count do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.civilian(i), 'disabled')
	end

	self.stage_ended = true
	self.attack_loop = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.items = nil
	self.fx = nil
	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.veldora_event_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.veldora_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.veldora_move_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.veldora_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.out_zone_down) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.out_zone_event, self, e.Zone, 'down')

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.veldora_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.out_zone_right) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.out_zone_event, self, e.Zone, 'right')

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.veldora_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.battle_event_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_start_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_event and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_end
		start_coroutine(self.battle_end_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

	self.items:add_item(self.rock_id, self.markers.item_pos(5) + vector(0.2, 0, 0), 0.5)

--- 반복 루틴 이벤트
function local_class:npc_attack_routine(believer, civilian, attack_anim)
	local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z((believer.Position + civilian.Position) * 0.5, 0.3)

	while not self.stage_ended and self.attack_loop do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = believer })
		scene_util.set_anim(believer, self, { name = attack_anim, count = 1 })
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.3, function(_)
			return not self.stage_ended and self.attack_loop
		end)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = civilian })
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(civilian)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(civilian)

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.stage_ended and self.attack_loop
		end)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:rock_break_routine(move_vec, duration, rocks_data)
	local veldora = self.characters.veldora()
	local time_passed = 0

	wp_util.move(veldora, move_vec, nil, duration, { run = true })

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for i, rock_data in ipairs(rocks_data) do
			--베루도라 이동하는동안 몸에 닿은 2X2 바위들이 파괴된다.
			if rock_data.active and bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(rock_data.rock.Bounds, veldora.Bounds) then
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01',
					play_pos = rock_data.rock.Position,
					type_priority = 'event',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				self.fx.rock_destroy():Instantiate(rock_data.rock.Position)
				rock_data.rock.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				rock_data.active = false
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:veldora_move_event()
	local milim = self.characters.milim()
	local veldora = self.characters.veldora()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초에 걸쳐 밀림, 베루도라 up 방향으로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_move'
		local milim_pos = self.markers.milim_pos(2)
		local veldora_pos = self.markers.veldora_pos(2)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, milim_pos,
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(veldora, veldora_pos,
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--밀림 left 방향 전환 1회. 0.5초 대기 이후 right 방향으로 전환 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'right')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--베루도라 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(veldora, 'left', false)
	--밀림 (right, idle, idle) : 길이 세갈래로 나뉘었구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s3_17')
	--밀림 (right, idle, release 2회) : 베루도라여, 리무루는 어디쪽에 있는 것이냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s3_18')

	--베루도라 (left, sleep_deep, question) : 흠…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(veldora, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'question', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s3_19')

	--대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--[화면 0.04값으로 0.5초 shake 하며] 베루도라 (right, smile, release) : [shout] 이쪽이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(veldora, self,
			'right',
			'release',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s3_20')

	--밀림 (right, attack, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(milim, true)

	--베루도라 (right, smile, run) 자세로 1.5초에 걸쳐 12칸 이동.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local rock_data = {
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(7), active = true },
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(8), active = true },
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(9), active = true },
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(10), active = true },
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(11), active = true },
					{ rock = self.field_object.rock(12), active = true }
				}

				--베루도라 이동하는동안 몸에 닿은 2X2 바위들이 파괴된다.
				local move_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.markers.veldora_pos(3), veldora.Position.z)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
				self:rock_break_routine(move_pos, 2, rock_data)

				wp_util.move_async(veldora, self.markers.veldora_pos(3),
						nil, 0.2, { last_direction = 'right' })

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(veldora)
				character_util.convert_to_npc(veldora)
				scene_util.set_anim(veldora, self, 'release')
			end,
			function()
				--이동하는 동안 하단의 대사 출력
				--[화면 0.4값으로 1초 shake 하며] 베루도라 : [shout] 내 친우, 리무르여!!!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
				camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_21',
						false, { screen_pos = vector(0, 50), scale = 2 })
			end
	)

	--밀림 (right, attack, release) : 나, 날 두고 가지 말란 말이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			'release',
			'attack',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_22')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name,
			self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, self.markers.milim_pos(3))
end

--- 잘못된 방향으로 가려고 하면 이벤트 진행
function local_class:out_zone_event(zone, dir)
	local milim = self.characters.milim()

	--밀림 (dir, attack, idle) : 베루도라를 쫓아가야 하는 것이다!
	scene_util.set_direction(milim, dir, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(milim, 'ss_slime_main_s3_23')

	-- 2칸 이동
	local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, milim, dir, 2)

	wp_util.move_async(milim, return_pos, nil, 0.5)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.remove_emotion(milim)
end

--- 마신교 신자들과 싸우는 밀림과 베루도라
function local_class:battle_start_event()
	local milim = self.characters.milim()
	local veldora = self.characters.veldora()

	local believers = {}
	local believer_count = 5

	for i = 1, believer_count do
		table.insert(believers, self.characters.believer(i))
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초에 걸쳐 밀림 right 방향으로 정렬.
	wp_util.move_async(milim, self.markers.milim_pos(3), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--[화면 0.3값으로 1초 shake 하며] 베루도라 (right, idle, release) :  [shout] 리무루여!!! 어딨는가!!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(veldora, self,
			'right',
			'release',
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s3_24')

	--[화면 0.3값으로 1초 shake 하며] 밀림 (right, attack, release ) : [shout] 리무루! 들리면 대답하라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			'release',
			'attack',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_25')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--베루도라 left 방향 정렬.
	scene_util.set_direction(veldora, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'up', false)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--베루도라 (down, sleep_deep, question) : 흠…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(veldora, self,
			'down',
			{ name = 'question', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s3_26')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--베루도라 (left, smile, idle) : 와하하!! 전혀 대답이 없구나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(veldora, self,
			'down',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_27')

	--밀림 (right, tired, idle) : 리무루… 대체 어딨는 것이냐…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s3_28')

	--대기 0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(veldora, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--베루도라 (right, smile, jump 1회) 하며 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(veldora, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(veldora, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(veldora, nil, 'notice')

	--베루도라 (right, smile, idle) : 오! 앞에 사람들이 있군!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_29')

	--밀림 idle 표정 전환.
	character_util.remove_emotion(milim)

	start_coroutine(function()
		start_coroutine(self.npc_attack_routine, self, self.characters.believer(2), self.characters.civilian(2), 'bomb_attack')
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		start_coroutine(self.npc_attack_routine, self, self.characters.believer(1), self.characters.civilian(1), 'attack')
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		start_coroutine(self.npc_attack_routine, self, self.characters.believer(3), self.characters.civilian(3), 'attack')
	end)

	--밀림과 베루도라 1.5초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 7칸 walk 자세로 이동.
	--카메라는 베루도라 NPC를 고정한 채로 함께 이동.
	do
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 6 })

		local wp_key = 'party_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(milim, milim.Position + vector(9, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(veldora, veldora.Position + vector(9, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--베루도라 (right, idle, jump 1회) 와 동시에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(veldora, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(veldora, nil, 'notice')

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = believers[4] })

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 오른쪽으로 5칸 이동.
	do
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

		local camera_pos = veldora.Position + vector(5, 0, 0)

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)
	end

	--대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 다시 베루도라 NPC 쪽으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(veldora, 1)

	--밀림 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 리무루는 어디 있는 것이냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'ss_slime_main_s3_31')

	--베루도라 (right, smile, idle) : 와하하! 뭔가 나빠보이는 놈들이 잔뜩 있구나!
	scene_util.set_emotion(veldora, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_32')

	--마신교 신자 1,2,3,4,5 동시에 left 방향 전환.
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	self.attack_loop = false
	scene_util.set_group_direction(believers, 'left')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(believers)

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마신교 신자4 (left, attack, release 2회) : 넌 또 뭐야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(believers[4], self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_33')

	--마신교 신자3 (left, attack, release 2회) : 없애버려!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(believers[3], self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_34')

	--베루도라 (right, smile, boong_attack_ready_loop) : 호오. 감히 이 베루도라님에게 도전하려 하다니!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(veldora, self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_35')

	--밀림(right, smile, cast2) : 간만에 몸 좀 풀 수 있는 것이냐? 잘 된 것이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			'right',
			'cast2',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'ss_slime_main_s3_36')

	local npcs = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npc_table()

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local npc_pos = {
					self.markers.milim_pos(3) + vector(-12, 0, 2),
					self.markers.milim_pos(3) + vector(-13, 0, 1),
					self.markers.milim_pos(3) + vector(-13, 0, 0),
					self.markers.milim_pos(3) + vector(-12, 0, -1)
				}

				local wp_key = 'believers_wp'

				for i = 1, #npcs do
					character_util.set_position(npcs[i], npc_pos[i])
					scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[i], self, 'attack')
					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npcs[i], npc_pos[i] + vector(10, 0, 0),
							7, nil, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
				end

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
			end,
			{
				camera_util.move_async, self.markers.milim_pos(3), 1
			}
	)

	--마신교 신자7 (left, attack, idle) : 저기 방해꾼이 나타났다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs[2], 'ss_slime_main_s3_36_1')

	--마신교 신자8 (left, attack, release 2회) : 놈들에게 죽음을!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs[3], self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_36_2')

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 플레이어(밀림)에게 패닝하며 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--베루도라, 밀림 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ milim, veldora }, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ milim, veldora })

	--베루도라 (left, smile, jump 1회) : 오! 놈들이 더 몰려왔군!
	character_util.normal_jump(veldora, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(veldora, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_36_3')

	--베루도라 (left, smile, idle) : 밀림! 저 놈들은 내가 상대하지!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_36_4')

	--밀림 (right, smile, nod 2회) : 그렇다면 난 이쪽을 맡겠느니라!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(milim, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			'smile',
			'ss_slime_main_s3_36_5')

	do
		--동시에 0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어(밀림) 에게로 복귀.
		camera_util.move(milim.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 0.5, { end_target = milim })

		--동시에 베루도라는 1.5초에 걸쳐 왼쪽으로 10.5칸 run 자세로 이동.
		wp_util.move(veldora, veldora.Position + vector(-10.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

		--0.5초에 걸쳐 밀림 run 자세로 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동.
		wp_util.move_async(milim, milim.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ milim, veldora })

	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, true))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'combat', mix = 0 })

	--일반 전투 진행.
	for i = 1, #believers do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(believers[i], self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(believers[i], user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end
end

function local_class:battle_end_event()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local milim = self.characters.milim()
	local veldora = self.characters.veldora()

	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, true))
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	--일반 전투 클리어 이후 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--최초 NPC는 다음과 같이 배치.
	character_util.set_position(milim, self.markers.believer_pos(4) + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(veldora, self.markers.believer_pos(4) + vector(-12, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ milim, veldora }, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ milim, veldora })

	character_util.set_position(self.characters.civilian(3),
			self.markers.believer_pos(4) + vector(-2, 0, -3))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 페이드 인이 완료 된 후, 화면 왼쪽에서 베루도라가 run 자세로 1.5초 동안 10칸 이동하여 지정된 위치로 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(veldora, self.markers.believer_pos(4) + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			nil, 1.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--베루도라가 이동을 완료 한 후, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--밀림 left 방향 전환 1회, 0.3초 대기 이후 right 방향 전환 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	scene_util.set_direction(milim, 'right')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--밀림 (left, smile, idle) : 다들 놀다 지쳐버린 것이냐?
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(milim, 'ss_slime_main_s3_37')

	--베루도라 (right, smile, idle) : 모두 이 몸이 두려워서 도망친 모양이군! 하하하!!!
	scene_util.set_emotion(veldora, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(veldora, 'ss_slime_main_s3_38')

	--밀림 (right, idle, idle) 전환
	character_util.remove_emotion(milim)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--밀림 캐릭터 머리 위에 (question) 이모티콘 표시.
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(milim, nil, 'question')

	--밀림 (right, idle, idle) : 그런데, 이 돌은 무엇이냐?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(milim, 'ss_slime_main_s3_39')

	--밀림 1초에 걸쳐 run 자세로 아래쪽으로 1칸, 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동.
	do
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(milim, milim.Position + vector(4, 0, -1), false)

		wp_util.move_async(milim, wp, nil, 1, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	--0.5초에 걸쳐 화면 ●지점을 포커스.
	do
		local camera_pos = milim.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)
	end

	--밀림 (left, smile, idle) : 반짝반짝 이뻐보이는 것이다!
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(milim, 'ss_slime_main_s3_40')

	--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 1)

	--밀림 sleep_deep 표정 0.8초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--밀림 (left, millim_eye, idle) 2초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_milim_cwp_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.set_emotion(milim, self, 'millim_eye')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 4로 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, 1)

	--밀림 sleep_deep 표정 0.8초

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc_data()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #pre_npc_data do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)

		if npc == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if pre_npc_data[i].pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if pre_npc_data[i].fly ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, pre_npc_data[i].pos, isFlying)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, pre_npc_data[i].dir, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, pre_npc_data[i].emo)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = pre_npc_data[i].anim })
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, pre_npc_data[i].anim_time_scale)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if pre_npc_data[i].alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = pre_npc_data[i].alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, pre_npc_data[i].alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, pre_npc_data[i].shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_key, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = pre_npc_data[i].string
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					pre_npc_data[i].weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					pre_npc_data[i].weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		:: continue ::
	end
end

function local_class:play_rimuru_party_entrance_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local rimuru = self.characters.rimuru()
	local shuna = self.characters.shuna()
	local shion = self.characters.shion()
	local benimaru = self.characters.benimaru()
	local hakurou = self.characters.hakurou()
	local souei = self.characters.souei()
	local veldora = self.characters.veldora()
	local milim = self.characters.milim()

	local legendary_hero = self.characters.legendary_hero()

	if self.is_current_section_start then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	else
		-- 파티원 전체 교체
		self.controller:party_switch({ rimuru, shuna, legendary_hero, benimaru, shion, souei, hakurou })
	end

	self.rimuru_party = {
		rimuru,
		shuna,
		shion,
		benimaru,
		hakurou,
		souei,
	}

	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	-- 리무르, 슈나, 에리나,시온, 베니마루, 하쿠로우, 소우에이 NPC 동시에 1초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 3칸 walk 자세로 이동.
	-- 이동하는동안 동시에 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	local wp_key = 'party_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rimuru, self.markers.rimuru(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuna, self.markers.shuna(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shion, self.markers.shion(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(benimaru, self.markers.benimaru(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hakurou, self.markers.hakurou(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(souei, self.markers.souei(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(legendary_hero, self.markers.legendary_hero(1, 2), nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 에리나 (left, idle, idle) : 보고가 들어온 곳은 이곳 숲 외곽에 있는 마을이다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(legendary_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_s4_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 리무루 (left, idle, release) : 좋아, 얘들아. 조금만 더 힘내서 가자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_s4_1_2', skip = true })

	-- 뒤에 있는는 일행들 전원 (right, idle, nod 1회) : 네, 리무루님!
	for i = 1, #self.rimuru_party do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(rimuru, self.rimuru_party[i]) then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.rimuru_party[i], self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
		end
	end
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_s4_1_3', world_pos = shuna.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -0.5), skip = true })

	-- 리무르 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'right', false)

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	-- 파티원 : 리무루, 슈나, 에리나, 베니마루, 시온, 소우에이, 하쿠로우 7인 파티.
	-- 이후 컨트롤 해제.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	if is_current_section_start then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.path_to_village

	self:set_current_scene_npc_data()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.markers.scene_focus(2, 1) },
		{ zone = 'demonworld_field', target = get_field_object('main_s1_exit_inner_2') }
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' and
						name ~= 'clear' then

				end
			end
		end,

		cache = function(this, fx_inst)
			table.insert(this.cached_inst, fx_inst)
		end,

		clear = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.cached_inst do
				this.cached_inst[i]:Dispose()
				this.cached_inst[i] = nil
			end

			this.cached_inst = { }

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.build_controller = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStorySlimeBuildController')

	self.vc_system = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/VillageConstruction/VCSystem')

	self:set_required_npcs_by_state(self.states.settlement_tutorial)
	self:set_auto_quest_marker_info_by_state(self.states.none)

	-- 특정 기믹들 미리 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(self.gimmicks.craft_table(), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.gimmicks.hologram(), 'disabled')

	if self.basket_emoticon ~= nil then
		self.basket_emoticon:Clear()
		self.basket_emoticon = nil
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.slime_util = nil
	self.build_controller = nil
	self.village_construction = nil
	self.vc_system = nil

	if self.forge_twinkle_fx ~= nil then
		self.forge_twinkle_fx:Dispose()
		self.forge_twinkle_fx = nil
	end
	
	self.fx:dispose()
	self:dispose_all_potions()

	self:clear_basker_emoticon()

	self:dispose_basket()

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_basket()
	if self.basket ~= nil then
		self.basket:ConsumeComplete()
		self.basket = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npcs.black_smith()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_settlement_tutorial, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.foraging_resources and 
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.forge_site())then
		start_coroutine(self.construct_forge, self, e.Target)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.potion_merchant and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.craft_table())then
		self:remove_main_quest_auto_marker_control()
		self.fx:clear()
	end
end

	if self.current_state == self.states.potion_merchant and 
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_potion_merchant_area') then

		local scene_func = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(self:has_player_created_basket(), 
			self.scene_approaching_merchant_box_created, self.scene_approaching_merchant_box_not_created)

		sp_util.start_scene(scene_func, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_fo_move_event(e)
	if self.basket ~= nil and 
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.gimmicks.drop_item_holdable()) then

		self.basket.Position = e.FieldObject.Position + vector(0, 0.125, 0)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.foraging_resources and 
		e:GetParamAt(0) == self.res_amount_changed_event_key then
		self:update_all_foraging_site_marker()
	end
end

	local target_table = {

		[self.states.foraging_resources] = self.gimmicks.forge_site(),
		[self.states.potion_merchant] = self.gimmicks.craft_table()

	align_dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(align_dur, 1)
	if state >= self.states.none and state <= self.states.settlement_tutorial then
		party_align_data = {
			rimuru = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_black_smith_slime'),
				direction = 'right'
			},
			milim = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_black_smith_milim'),
				direction = 'up'
			},
			shuna = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_black_smith_shuna'),
				direction = 'up'
			},
		}
	elseif state == self.states.helped_potion_merchant then
		party_align_data = {
			rimuru = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_potion_merchant_rimuru'),
				direction = 'left'
			},
			milim = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_potion_merchant_milim'),
				direction = 'left'

			shuna = {
				target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_potion_merchant_shuna'),

function local_class:update_all_foraging_site_marker()
	-- 1번 메인퀘스트 마커 : 돌이 20개 미만일 경우 출력. 20개 이상일 경우 제거.
	-- 2번 메인퀘스트 마커 : 나무가 20개 미만일 경우 출력. 20개 이상일 경우 제거.
	local required_num_each_resource = 10

	local has_enough_branches = self.data_storage:get_tree_branch() >= required_num_each_resource
	local has_enough_stones = self.data_storage:get_stone_piece() >= required_num_each_resource

	self:update_foraging_site_marker(has_enough_branches, self.resource_foraging_site_name.branch)
	self:update_foraging_site_marker(has_enough_stones, self.resource_foraging_site_name.stone)

	-- 3번 메인퀘스트 마커 : 돌, 나무 모두 20개 이상일 경우 출력.
	-- 3번 메인퀘스트 마커 출력되는 시점에 대장간 빈터 오브젝트에 FX_Object_Twinkle 출력.
	-- 이후 3번 메인퀘스트 마커가 출력되는 시점에서 부터 대장간 빈터 인터렉트를 통해 건축 UI 실행이 가능. 

	local forge_site = self.gimmicks.forge_site()

	if has_enough_branches and has_enough_stones then
		self:set_auto_quest_marker_info_by_state(self.states.foraging_resources)
		
		self:set_fo_interactable(forge_site)

		local forge_twinkle_fx_pos = forge_site.Position + vector(1.5, 0.1, 1.5) 

		if self.forge_twinkle_fx == nil then
			self.forge_twinkle_fx = self.fx.object_twinkle():Instantiate(forge_twinkle_fx_pos)
		end
	else
		if self.forge_twinkle_fx ~= nil then
			self.forge_twinkle_fx:Dispose()
			self.forge_twinkle_fx = nil
		end
	end
	
end

function local_class:update_foraging_site_marker(has_enough, site_name)
	if has_enough then
		quest_marker_util.remove(site_name)
	else
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(site_name)
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(site_name, self.quest_id, true, pos)
	end
end

function local_class:construct_forge(forge)
	self.build_controller:pop_build_ui_routine(forge.Name, forge, function(target_fo, handle_name, id)
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self.fx:clear()
		self.forge_twinkle_fx:Dispose()
		self.forge_twinkle_fx = nil
		self.build_controller:default_building_screenplay(target_fo, handle_name, id)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.gimmicks.forge_site(), 'disabled')

function local_class:create_potion(potion_type, show_on_character, pos, target_pos, cache, rotation)
	local potion_id_by_type = {
		[self.potion_type.red] = 21179,
		[self.potion_type.blue] = 21180,
		[self.potion_type.green] = 21181,
	}

	local potion = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ 
			pos = pos,
			target = target_pos,
			itemid = potion_id_by_type[potion_type],
			notforinven = true,
			showoncharacter = show_on_character,
			show_shadow = false,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			skip_text = true,
		}
	)

	if rotation ~= nil then
		potion.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(rotation)
		potion.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(rotation)
	end

	if cache ~= nil then
		table.insert(cache, potion)
	end

	return potion
end

function local_class:dispose_cached_potions(potions)
	for _, v in ipairs(potions) do
