---@class ShortStorySlimeManaAddictionPotionMakingActivity
local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeManaAddictionPotionMakingActivity')

function local_class:init()
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.game_data = {
		patterns = {
			[1] = {
				time_limit = 10,
				--뿌리, 약초, 열매 순서대로 넣어주세요.
				order_speech_key = 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_1',
				order = {
					'root',
					'mandrake',
					'fruit',
				}
			},
			[2] = {
				time_limit = 15,
				--약초, 약초, 뿌리, 열매 순서대로 넣어주세요.
				order_speech_key = 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_2',
				order = {
					'mandrake',
					'mandrake',
					'root',
					'fruit',
				}
			},
			[3] = {
				time_limit = 20,
				--열매, 약초, 뿌리, 약초, 열매, 뿌리 순서대로 넣어주세요.
				order_speech_key = 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_3',
				order = {
					'fruit',
					'mandrake',
					'root',
					'mandrake',
					'fruit',
					'root',
				}
			},
		},
	}

	self.get_manual_character = function()
		return get_character('potion_making_manual')
	end

	self.get_shuna = function()
		return get_character('shuna')
	end

	self.get_milim = function()
		return get_character('milim')
	end

	self.handling_item_key = nil
	self.handling_item_offset = unity_class.vector3.up

	self.items = {}

	-- FIXME : 액티비티 클래스와 상호참조하는 케이스가 있음. 한번 더 감싸도 되긴하지만, 동작 자체를
	local add_item_info = function(key, item_id)
		self.items[key] = {
			key = key,
			item_id = item_id,
			item = nil,

			get_interactable = function(this)
				return get_field_object('potion_making_' .. this.key .. '_interactable')
			end,

			create = function(this)
				this.item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = item_id,
					notforinven = true,
					pos = this:get_interactable().Position,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					showoncharacter = true,
				})

				this:set_on_chair()
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.item ~= nil then
					this.item:ConsumeComplete()
					this.item = nil
				end

				local interactable = this:get_interactable()

				interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end,

			set_on_chair = function(this)
				local interactable = this:get_interactable()

				interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				this.item.Position = interactable.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.7
				this.item:Stop()

				this.item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
				this.item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
			end,

			set_on_leader = function(this)
				local interactable = this:get_interactable()

				this.item.Position = self.get_manual_character().Position + self.handling_item_offset

				interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end,

			throw_into_pot = function(this, target_pos)
				local rotation = 1080 * lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
						this.item.Position.x < target_pos.x, 1, -1)

				drop_item_util.move_item(this.item, target_pos, {
					duration = 0.5,
					angle = rotation,
					y_move = function(progress)
						return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 1.65
					end,
					callback = function(move_done)
						if not move_done then
							return
						end

						self:on_item_into_pot(this.key)

						this:set_on_chair()
					end
				})
			end,

			set_after_clear = function(this)
				local interactable = this:get_interactable()

				interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end,
		}
	end

	add_item_info('fruit', 21196)
	add_item_info('mandrake', 21197)
	add_item_info('root', 21198)

	self.game_state = {
		none = 0,
		before_control = 1,
		in_control = 2,
		put_wrong_item = 3,
		time_out = 4,
		succeed_pattern = 5,

		force_end = 99,
	}

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	self.current_pattern = {
		num = 1,
		order_num = 1,

		reset = function(this, pattern_num)
			this.num = pattern_num
			this.order_num = 1
		end,

		is_right_order = function(this, item_key)
			local pattern = self.game_data.patterns[this.num]
			local target_item_key = pattern.order[this.order_num]

			return target_item_key == item_key
		end,

		walk_order = function(this)
			this.order_num = this.order_num + 1

			return this.order_num > #self.game_data.patterns[this.num].order
		end
	}

	self.get_pot = function()
		return get_field_object('mana_addiction_pot')
	end

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_IronMissile_Explosion')
		end,
		awakening = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Cin_Awakening')
		end,
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.leftover_members = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	for _, item in pairs(self.items) do
		item:dispose()
	end

	self.leftover_members = nil
end

function local_class:force_end()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.force_end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.in_control then
		return false
	end

	for key, item in pairs(self.items) do
		if key ~= self.handling_item_key and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, item:get_interactable()) then
			if self.handling_item_key ~= nil then
				local handling_item = self.items[self.handling_item_key]

				handling_item:set_on_chair()
			else
				self.get_pot().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				character_util.set_anim(self.get_manual_character(), {
					name = 'hold',
					next_anim = 'hold_loop',
					loop = false,
					upper = true
				})
			end

			self.handling_item_key = key

			item:set_on_leader()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')

			self.fx.get():Instantiate(self.get_manual_character().Bounds.center)

			return true
		end
	end

	if self.handling_item_key ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_pot()) then
		local handling_item = self.items[self.handling_item_key]
		local leader = self.get_manual_character()

		character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {
			name = 'throw',
			loop = false,
			upper = true,
			remove_after = 0.3
		})

		handling_item:throw_into_pot(vector_util.get_x0z(e.Target.Bounds.center, 1.5))

		e.Target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self.handling_item_key = nil

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if self.handling_item_key ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_manual_character()) then
		local item = self.items[self.handling_item_key]

		item.item.Position = e.FieldObject.Position + self.handling_item_offset

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_control and e.IsComplete then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.time_out

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.leftover_members ~= nil and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'potion_making_activity_party_recovery') then
		for i = 1, #self.leftover_members do
			character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.leftover_members[i], user_party, true)
		end

		self.leftover_members = nil

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_into_pot(item_key)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.in_control then
		return
	end

	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(self:get_pot_effect_pos())

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')

	if self.current_pattern:is_right_order(item_key) then
		local is_done = self.current_pattern:walk_order()

		if is_done then
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.succeed_pattern
		end
	else
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.put_wrong_item
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local origin_party = {}
	local leader = self.get_manual_character()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()

	do
		for i = user_party.Count, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			origin_party[i] = {
				member = member,
				origin_pos = member.Position,
				origin_dir = member.Direction,
			}

			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			character_util.set_position(member, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end

		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

		leader.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled

		character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(leader, param)
	end

	self:set_characters()

	--각 테이블위에 (열매) (뿌리) (약초) 가 올려져있다.
	for _, item_info in pairs(self.items) do
		item_info:create()
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--액티비티 간에 무기 장착 해제 및 이동과 인터랙트만 가능한 상태로 전환
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_field_object_event')

	local bgm_on = false

	local succeed = false

	for pattern_num = 1, #self.game_data.patterns do
		succeed = false

		local is_first = pattern_num == 1
		local is_last = pattern_num == #self.game_data.patterns
		local pattern = self.game_data.patterns[pattern_num]
		local is_retried = false

		while not succeed do
			self.current_pattern:reset(pattern_num)

			--페이드인이 끝나고

			--해당 대사는 1 단계 패턴때만 재생
			if is_first then
				--0.5초간 슈나에게 카메라 이동
				camera_util.move_to_target_async(shuna, 0.5)

				--paper_piece 스프라이트
				--종이를 들고 있다. (이 후 액티비티 간에 슈나는 해당 스프라이트를 들고있다.)
				--슈나(smile,staff_idle): 제가 순서를 알려드릴테니 리무루 님은 그에 따라 재료를 넣으시면 된답니다.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
				self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(true)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuna, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_4')
			elseif is_retried then
				camera_util.move_to_target_async(shuna, 1)
			end

			shuna.Interactable.Talk = pattern.order_speech_key

			self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuna, pattern.order_speech_key)

			--슈나가 레시피를 읊는다.
			--이 후 1초간 리무르에게 카메라가 이동된다.
			--카메라 도착과 동시에
			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			do
				local start_count_string_key = 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_4_1'

				for i = 3, 1, -1 do
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
					CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), 3)

					wait_for_sec(1)
				end
			end

			--  BGM이 변경된 적이 없으면 변경해줌
			if not bgm_on then
				bgm_on = true

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({
					state = 'event',
					name = 'bgm_chasing'
				})
			end

			--컨트롤 해제와 동시에
			sp_util.exit_scene({
				vincible = false
			}, leader)

			--타이머 활성화
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')

			timer_util.start_timer({
				duration = pattern.time_limit,
				handler = self,
				callback = 'on_global_timer_alarm_event',
				show_ui = true,
			})

			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_control

			while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_control do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.force_end then
				message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
				message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

				return nil
			end

			timer_util.end_timer(self)

			if self.handling_item_key ~= nil then
				self.handling_item_key = nil

				character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
			end

			for key, item in pairs(self.items) do
				item:set_on_chair()
			end

			sp_util.enter_scene({
				invincible = false,
			})

			if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.succeed_pattern then
				self:succeed_scene(is_last)

				succeed = true
			else
				local retry = self:failed_scene()

				if retry then
					screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

					self:set_characters()

					screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

					is_retried = true
				else
					-- 포기 시
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if not succeed then
			break
		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	if succeed then
		-- 성공한 경우에는 리더만 원복함
		-- FIXME : 진짜 개 지 저 분 하 다
		local member_info = origin_party[1]

		character_util.set_position(member_info.member, leader.Position)
		character_util.set_direction(member_info.member, leader.Direction)

		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

		member_info.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(member_info.member, param)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_position(leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

		shuna.Interactable.Talk = nil

		self.leftover_members = {}

		for i = 2, #origin_party do
			table.insert(self.leftover_members, origin_party[i].member)
		end

		for _, item in pairs(self.items) do
			item:set_after_clear()
		end

		self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(false)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

		-- 파티 리셋
		for i = 1, #origin_party do
			local member_info = origin_party[i]

			if i == 1 then
				local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

				character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(member_info.member, param)
			else
				character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(member_info.member, user_party, true)
			end

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member_info.member)
			character_util.set_position(member_info.member, member_info.origin_pos)
			character_util.set_direction(member_info.member, member_info.origin_dir)
		end

		for _, item in pairs(self.items) do
			item:dispose()
		end
	end

	return succeed
end

function local_class:set_characters()
	local leader = self.get_manual_character()

	character_util.set_position(leader, self:get_pot_align_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	local shuna = self.get_shuna()

	character_util.set_position(shuna, field_util.get_marker_pos('potion_making_activity_align_shuna'))
	character_util.set_direction(shuna, 'left')

	local milim = self.get_milim()

	character_util.set_position(milim, field_util.get_marker_pos('potion_making_activity_align_milim'))
	character_util.set_direction(milim, 'left')
end

function local_class:get_pot_align_pos()
	local pot = self.get_pot()

	return vector(pot.Bounds.center.x, pot.Position.y, pot.Bounds.min.z - 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_pot_effect_pos()
	local pot = self.get_pot()

	return vector_util.get_x0z(pot.Bounds.center) + vector(0, 1.3, -0.5)
end

function local_class:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(enabled)
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()

	if enabled then
		scene_util.set_anim(shuna, self, 'staff_idle')
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(shuna, '[base]weapon1', 'paper_piece')
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(shuna, self, 'idle')
		character_util.spine_remove_attachment(shuna, '[base]weapon1')
	end
end

function local_class:succeed_scene(is_last)
	local pot = self.get_pot()
	local leader = self.get_manual_character()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()

	character_util.remove_anim(shuna)

	--리무루 (smile) 표정
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, {
		look_target = pot.Bounds.center,
		look_mode = 'side',
		sfx = false,
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

	--동시에 항아리에 FX_Cin_Awakening
	local awakening_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	self.fx.awakening():Instantiate(self:get_pot_effect_pos())

	--참고
	--[가디언 테일즈] 월드 7-5 서브 - 던전의 작은 주방
	--이펙트 재생 2초 후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(awakening_sfx, 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_flower_03')

	--리무루(smile,success) 1초 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'success', remove_after = 1 })

	--이펙트 재생 3.5 초 후
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if not is_last then
		--화면에 체크 표시 재생
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)

		--체크 표시 끝나면 슈나(smile,idle) 상태
		scene_util.set_emotion(shuna, self, 'smile')
		self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(false)

		--1초간 슈나에게 카메라가 이동된다.
		camera_util.move_to_target_async(shuna, 1)

		--슈나(smile,clap): 잘하셨어요! 리무루 님!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self, nil,
				'clap', nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_5')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		--슈나(idle,staff_idle): 그럼, 다음은…
		--다시 종이를 손에든다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
		self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuna, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_6')
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({
			state = 'field',
			volume = 0.6,
			mix = 5
		})

		--화면에 액티비티 성공 재생
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

function local_class:failed_scene()
	local pot = self.get_pot()
	local leader = self.get_manual_character()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_03')

	--이때 리무루 (attack)(jump1회) 표정
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, {
		look_target = pot.Bounds.center,
		look_mode = 'side',
		sfx = false,
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')

	--이때 슈나(tired) 표정
	self:toggle_shuna_hold_paper(false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuna, self, 'tired')

	do
		local duration = 0.5

		--항아리 shake 0.1 /0.5 초
		field_object_util.shake(pot, 0.1, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--항아리에 FX_IronMissile_Explosion 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.fx.explosion():Instantiate(self:get_pot_effect_pos())

	--참고
	--[가디언 테일즈] 월드 7-5 서브 - 던전의 작은 주방
	--이때 화면 shake 0.1/0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--이때 리무루 (damaged,cliff) 0.5초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil, 'cliff', 'damaged', 1)

	--리무루(tired,bomb_idle): 흠… 잘 안됐네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_7')

	--선택지 출력
	--그만한다.
	--재도전.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_8', 'normal' },
		{ 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_9', 'mercy' },
	})

	--그만한다.
	if result == 1 then
		--슈나 바라보며
		character_util.look_at(leader, shuna)
		character_util.look_at(shuna, leader)

		--리무루(idle,idle): 슈나, 일단 다른일부터 하고오자.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_10')

		--슈나(idle,idle): 네, 리무루 님.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuna, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_11')

		return false
	else
		--재도전.
		--슈나 바라보며
		character_util.look_at(leader, shuna)
		character_util.look_at(shuna, leader)

		--리무루(sleep_deep,nod 끝에 정지): 미안해. 슈나, 다시 한 번 도와줄래?
		local talk_done = false

		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'nod', loop = false })

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			if talk_done then
				return
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(leader, 0)

			while talk_done do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(leader, 1)
		end)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_12')

		talk_done = true

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		--슈나(smile,nod 2회): 알겠습니다. 리무루 님.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self, nil,
				'nod', 'smile', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_activity_13')

		--페이드인 페이드 아웃 후 재시작

		return true
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeManaAddictionSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStorySlimeManaAddiction @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type SlimeManaAddictionController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_activate = 2,
		before_meet_addict = 3,
		meet_addict = 4,
		done = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.main_quest_id = 7001701

	self.paper_piece_item_id = 21191

	self.blocking_boards = {
		get = function(number)
			return get_field_object('mana_addiction_s1_mountain_blocking_board_' .. number)
		end,
		count = 2,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local fo = this.get(i)

				action(i, fo)
			end
		end
	}

	-- 밀림
	self.get_milim = function()
		return get_character('milim')
	end

	-- 슈나
	self.get_shuna = function()
		return get_character('shuna')
	end

	--비네트
	self.get_demon_engineer = function()
		return get_character('demon_engineer')
	end

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'mana_addiction_s1',
		constants_key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, data, this.key)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(nil, this.key)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress >= 5 and not main_quest.IsComplete then
		self:set()

		self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_addict
	else
		do
			--초록색 표시한 곳에 표지판
			--야생동물 출현 주의
			--해당 표지판은 섹션6 진입 전까지 존재하고,
			local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('mana_addiction_s1_mountain_blocking_board_pivot')

			self.blocking_boards:foreach(function(index, fo)
				local target_pos = pivot + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5 + unity_class.vector3.forward * (index - 1)

				fo.Position = target_pos
			end)
		end

		self.current_state = self.states.before_activate

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_activate and
			e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_addict

		self:set()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_addict and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mana_addiction_s1_meet_addict') then
		self.current_state = self.states.meet_addict

		self.quest_marker:remove()

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:meet_addict_scene()
			self.controller:progress_section()

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set()
	--물약 이벤트 세팅과 동시에 사라진다.
	self.blocking_boards:foreach(function(_, fo)
		fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
	end)

	local npc_position_sum = unity_class.vector3.zero

	--(A) (left,damaged,prostrate)
	--(B) (right,damaged,prostrate)
	--(C) (left,damaged,prostrate)
	local data = {
		{
			dir = 'left',
			pos = self.controller.addict.get_prostrate_pos(1),
		},
		{
			dir = 'right',
			pos = self.controller.addict.get_prostrate_pos(2),
		},
		{
			dir = 'left',
			pos = self.controller.addict.get_prostrate_pos(3),
		},
	}

	self.controller.addict:foreach(function(index, npc)
		local npc_data = data[index]

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'prostrate')

		npc_position_sum = npc_position_sum + npc_data.pos
	end)

	-- 대략 중간 지점에 찍어줌
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = npc_position_sum / #data
		}
	})
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeManaAddictionSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStorySlimeManaAddiction @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type SlimeManaAddictionController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_enter_mountain = 2,
		entered_mountain = 3,
		before_interact = 4,
		interacting = 5,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	local create_ingredients_table = function(item_id, key)
		return {
			key = key,
			item_id = item_id,
			item = nil,

			is_consumed = false,

			get_fo = function(this)
				return get_field_object('mana_addiction_s2_ingredient_' .. this.key)
			end,

			get_setting_pos = function(this)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('mana_addiction_s2_ingredient_' .. this.key)
			end,

			set = function(this)
				if this.item ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local target_pos = this:get_setting_pos()

				this.item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = this.item_id,
					pos = target_pos,
					notforinven = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				})

				local fo = this:get_fo()

				fo.Position = target_pos
				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end,

			set_marker = function(this)
				local fo = this:get_fo()

				self.quest_marker:add({
					{
						zone = 'main_field',
						target = fo,
					}
				}, this.key)
			end,

			dispose = function(this, on_exit)
				if this.is_consumed or this.item == nil then
					return
				end

				self.quest_marker:remove(this.key)

				if on_exit then
					this.item:ConsumeComplete()
					this.item = nil
				else
					this.item.ConsumeTarget = get_party_leader()
					this.item:Fly()
					this.item = nil

					local fo = this:get_fo()

					fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
					fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
				end

				this.is_consumed = true
			end
		}
	end

	self.ingredients = {
		create_ingredients_table(21196, 'fruit'),
		create_ingredients_table(21197, 'mandrake'),
		create_ingredients_table(21198, 'root'),
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		key_prefix = 'mana_addiction_s2_',
		constants_key = 'main_quest',

		add = function(this, data, key)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, data, this.key_prefix .. key)
		end,
		remove = function(this, key)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(nil, this.key_prefix .. key)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	for _, ingredient in pairs(self.ingredients) do
		ingredient:set()
	end

	self.controller.get_pot().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	do
		local mountain_entrance_zone = field_util.get_zone('mana_addiction_s2_enter_mountain')

		self.quest_marker:add({
			{
				zone = 'main_field',
				target = vector_util.get_x0z(mountain_entrance_zone.Bounds.center)
			}
		}, 'entrance')
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_mountain
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done

	for _, ingredient in pairs(self.ingredients) do
		ingredient:dispose(true)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_mountain and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mana_addiction_s2_enter_mountain') then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_mountain

		self.quest_marker:remove('entrance')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_mountain_scene, self):Then(function()
			for _, ingredient in pairs(self.ingredients) do
				ingredient:set_marker()
			end

			self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact then
		for _, ingredient in pairs(self.ingredients) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ingredient:get_fo()) then
				self.current_state = self.states.interacting

				sp_util.start_scene(function(info)
					local is_done = self:get_item_routine(info)

					if is_done then
						-- 모든 아이템 수집이 끝났을 경우 섹션 넘어감
						self.controller:progress_section()
					else
						-- 아이템 수집이 끝나지 않았으면 섹션 유지
						self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
					end
				end, ingredient)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_mountain or self.current_state == self.states.before_interact) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_pot()) then
		local prev_state = self.current_state

		self.current_state = self.states.interacting

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			--재료가 모이지 않은 상태에서 증류 시도시
			--항아리 오브젝트에 인터랙트 시
			--리무루(tired,idle): 일단 산에 가서 재료 부터 모아와야겠어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(get_party_leader(), self,
					nil, nil, 'tired', 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_0_3')

			self.current_state = prev_state
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter_mountain_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()

	-- 재료를 구할 수 있는 산입구로 진입하면 이벤트 진행

	-- 리무루(idle,idle):[독백 연출] 라파엘 씨. 주변에서 레시피에 있는 재료를 탐색해줄래?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')
	self.controller.util:show_monologue_speech_async(rimuru, self,
			nil, nil, nil,'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_0_1')

	-- 라파엘: 레시피에 따라 악취가 풍기는 열매, 인간의 모습을 한 약초, 마른 뿌리 탐색을 시작하겠습니다.
	self.controller.util:show_raphael_speech_async('ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_0_2')
end

function local_class:get_item_routine(ingredient)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	--리무루 아이템 바라보며 (eat) 1초 아이템 스프라이트를 획득한다.
	scene_util.play_custom_action(leader, self, {
		look_target = ingredient:get_fo(),
		look_mode = 'side',
		sfx = false
	}, 'eat', nil, function()
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		ingredient:dispose(false)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(eat_sfx, 0.3)

	self['get_' .. ingredient.key .. '_scene'](self)

	local is_done = true

	for _, info in pairs(self.ingredients) do
		if not info.is_consumed then
			is_done = false

			break
		end
	end

	return is_done
end

function local_class:get_fruit_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()

	-- 리무루(damaged,idle): 으윽… 정말 기분 나쁜 냄새가 나네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			nil, 'damaged', 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_1')

	-- 리무루(tired,idle): 냄새가 새지 않게 빨리 품안에 넣어 놓자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_2')
end

function local_class:get_mandrake_scene()

	--리무루: 인간의 모습을 한 약초… 이걸 말하는 거겠지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s2_3')

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_potion_store_built = 2,
		before_first_try = 3,
		in_activity = 4,
		before_retry = 5,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	---@type ShortStorySlimeManaAddictionPotionMakingActivity
	self.activity_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/ManaAddiction/PotionMakingActivity')

	self.get_shuna = function()
		return get_character('shuna')
	end

	self.get_milim = function()
		return get_character('milim')
	end

	self.get_potion_house_exit = function()
		return get_field_object('potion_building_exit')
	end

	self.potion_house_exit = {
		collider = nil,

		get = function()
			return get_field_object('potion_building_exit')
		end,

		set_non_interactable = function(this)
			local origin_fo = this.get()

			if this.collider == nil then
				this.collider = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(origin_fo.Position, {
					hit_box = origin_fo.Hitbox,
				})
			else
				this.collider.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
			end

			origin_fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.visible
		end,

		set_interactable = function(this)
			if this.collider ~= nil then
				this.collider.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
			end

			local origin_fo = this.get()

			origin_fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.collider == nil then
				return
			end

			this.collider:Dispose()
			this.collider = nil
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'mana_addiction_s3',
		constants_key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, data, this.key)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(nil, this.key)
		end
	}

	self.vc_system = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.activity_controller:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.controller.get_pot().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local data_storage = self:get_vc_system():get_data_storage()

	if not data_storage:is_active_potion_store() then
		self:add_quest_marker_to_potion_store_place()

		self.current_state = self.states.before_potion_store_built

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	else
		self:add_quest_marker_to_pot()

		self.current_state = self.states.before_first_try
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done

	if self.activity_controller ~= nil then
		self.activity_controller:force_end()

		self.activity_controller = nil
	end

	self.vc_system = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_potion_store_built and
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'changed_village_state' and self:is_potion_store_activated() then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_first_try

		self.quest_marker:remove()
		self:add_quest_marker_to_pot()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_first_try or self.current_state == self.states.before_retry) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_pot()) then
		local is_first_try = self.current_state == self.states.before_first_try

		self.current_state = self.states.in_activity

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			if is_first_try then
				self:try_activity_scene()
			else
				local retry = self:retry_activity_scene()

				if not retry then
					self.current_state = self.states.before_retry

					music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

					return
				end
			end

			self.quest_marker:remove()

			local fade_out_duration = 1

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				state = 'muted',
				mix = fade_out_duration
			})

			screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_out_duration, unity_class.color.black)

			local pot = self.controller.get_pot()

			pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			self.potion_house_exit:set_non_interactable()

			local succeed = self.activity_controller:game_routine()

			if succeed == nil then
				return nil
			elseif not succeed then
				screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

				self.potion_house_exit:set_interactable()

				pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				self:add_quest_marker_to_pot()

				self.current_state = self.states.before_retry

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

				return
			end

			self.potion_house_exit:set_interactable()

			self:after_succeed_scene()
			self.controller:progress_section()

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker_to_potion_store_place()
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = get_field_object('potion_store')
		}
	})
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker_to_pot()
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = get_field_object('potion_building_entrance')
		},
		{
			zone = 'potion_house',
			target = self.controller.get_pot()
		}
	})
end

function local_class:is_potion_store_activated()
	local data_storage = self:get_vc_system():get_data_storage()

	return data_storage:is_active_potion_store()
end

function local_class:get_vc_system()
	if self.vc_system == nil then
		self.vc_system = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/VillageConstruction/VCSystem')
	end

	return self.vc_system
end

function local_class:try_activity_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local milim = self.get_milim()

	--재료가 다 모인 후 시설내부로 들어가 증류를 시작한다.
	--항아리 오브젝트에 인터랙트 시
	--(1) 리무루 (2) 슈나 (3) 밀림 0.5초간 중앙으로 정렬
	self:align_to_pot_async()

	--리무루(항아리 기믹 오브젝트 쪽 side로 바라보며)(eat) 1초
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.play_wait_action(rimuru, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'eat', nil, 1)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(eat_sfx, 0.3)

	--리무루(idle,question): 물이 끓어오르면 재료를 정해진 순서대로 넣어 단숨에 끓여내시오…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			'question', nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_1')

	--리무루(tired,idle): 뭔가 만들기 까다로워보이네…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_2')

	--리무루(idle,idle): 슈나, 레시피 읊는 걸 조금 도와줄래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_3')

	--슈나(smile,idle): 네, 리무루 님을 돕는 일이라면 기꺼이 하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self, nil,
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_4')

	--리무루(smile,nod2회): 응, 고마워!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			'nod', 'smile', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_5')

	--이 후 액티비티 시작
end

function local_class:align_to_pot_async()
	local pivot = self:get_pot_align_pivot()

	self.controller.util:align_party_by_name_async({
		rimuru = {
			target_pos = pivot,
			direction = 'up'
		},
		shuna = {
			target_pos = pivot + unity_class.vector3.right,
			direction = 'left'
		},
		milim = {
			target_pos = pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
			direction = 'left'
		},
	})
end

function local_class:get_pot_align_pivot()
	local pot = self.controller.get_pot()

	return vector(pot.Bounds.center.x, pot.Position.y, pot.Bounds.min.z - 0.5)
end

function local_class:retry_activity_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()

	self:align_to_pot_async()

	--그만한다. 선택 후 냄비 오브젝트를 인터랙트해 액티비티 재도전 시
	--리무루(idle,idle): 좋아, 다시 한 번 만들어볼까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_6')

	--네.
	--아니요.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_7', 'mercy' },
		{ 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_8', 'normal' },
	})

	return result == 1
end

function local_class:after_succeed_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local pot = self.controller.get_pot()
	local potion_item_id = 21195

	--리무루가 제조 시설(항아리) 앞에서
	do
		local target_pos = self:get_pot_align_pivot()

		wp_util.move_async(rimuru, target_pos,  3)
	end

	--(left,smile,eat) 1초
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.play_wait_action(rimuru, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'eat', { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 1)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(eat_sfx, 0.3)

	--fx_dead 이펙트와 함께 항아리에서 물약이 나온 후 리무루 가 획득
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

	local potion_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = potion_item_id,
		pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pot.Bounds.center, pot.Position.y + 1),
		target = rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.left,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'FixLooter'
	})

	potion_item.ConsumeTarget = rimuru

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--리무루 물약을 들고 (victory_get) 포즈
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(rimuru, '[base]weapon1', 'green_potion')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(rimuru, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(rimuru)
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(rimuru, '[base]weapon1')

	--리무루(right,smile,idle)(jump1회): 완성했어! 도와줘서 고마워 슈나.
	character_util.normal_jump(rimuru, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_9')

	--슈나(sleep_deep,nod 끝에 정지): 저야말로 리무루 님을 도울 수 있어 영광입니다.
	do
		local talk_done = false

		scene_util.set_anim(shuna, self, { name = 'nod', count = false })

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			if talk_done then
				return
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(shuna, 0)

			while not talk_done do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(shuna, 1)
		end)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self, nil,
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_10')

		talk_done = true

		character_util.remove_anim(shuna)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(rimuru)

	--물약 스프라이트를 들고 있다.
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(rimuru, '[base]weapon1', 'green_potion')

	--리무루(idle,staff_idle):[독백 연출] 라파엘 씨. 제대로 만들어졌는지 확인해줄래?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')
	self.controller.util:show_monologue_speech_async(rimuru, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_11')

	--라파엘: 해석 감정 결과. 체내의 마나를 빠르게 순환시켜 정화하는 효과가 있습니다.
	self.controller.util:show_raphael_speech_async('ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_12')

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(rimuru, '[base]weapon1')
	character_util.remove_anim(rimuru)

	--리무루(sleep_deep,nod2회): 좋아, 그렇다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, nil,
			'nod', 'sleep_deep', 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_13')

	--리무루(throw)로
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(rimuru, self, {
		name = 'throw',
		loop = false,
	})

	--자기 바로앞에 포션을 내려놓는다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

	potion_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = potion_item_id,
		pos = rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.up,
		target = rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.left,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		bounce_callback = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
		end
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(rimuru)
	character_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'down')

	--리무루 unique/transform_slime 애니메이션 재생 후
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_slime_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(rimuru, self, { name = 'unique/transform_slime', loop = false })

	character_util.remove_anim(rimuru)

	--unique/slime 상태로 포션을 습득하는 연출
	scene_util.set_anim(rimuru, self, 'unique/slime')
	potion_item.ConsumeTarget = rimuru
	potion_item:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--슬라임 리무루(shake0.03 ) 2초
	do
		local duration = 2

		scene_util.shake(rimuru, 0.03, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--슬라임 리무루(shake 제거)(jump2회) 후
	do
		character_util.normal_jump_async(rimuru, true)
		character_util.cancel_jump(rimuru)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(rimuru, true)
	end

	--1초대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--슬라임 리무루 (shake) 시작
	scene_util.shake(rimuru, 0.03, 999, false)

	--0.25초 간격으로 물약 스프라이트 6개가 리무루 앞에 떨어진다.
	local potion_items = {}

	do
		local drop_offsets = {
			vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
			vector(0.5, 0, -1),
			vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			vector(1.5, 0, 0),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_04')

		for i = 1, #drop_offsets do
			potion_items[i] = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = potion_item_id,
				pos = rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.up,
				target = rimuru.Position + drop_offsets[i],
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				skip_text = true,
				bounce_callback = function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
				end
			})

			if i ~= #drop_offsets then
				wait_for_sec(0.25)
			end
		end
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(rimuru)

	--슬라임 리무루 (shake) 종료 후 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--슬라임 리무루(jump1회): 좋았어, 이걸 가져다주면 치료할 수 있겠어.
	character_util.normal_jump(rimuru, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rimuru, 'ss_slime_mana_addiction_s3_14')

	--물약 스프라이트 6개가 동시에 슬라임 리무루에게 습득된다.
	for _, item in pairs(potion_items) do
		item.ConsumeTarget = rimuru
		item:Fly()
	end

	--리무루(unique/transform_human) 애니메이션 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_fall_down_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(rimuru, self, { name = 'unique/transform_human', loop = false })
end

return local_class

			sp_util.enter_scene()

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:talk_with_demon_engineer_scene()
			self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:talk_with_demon_engineer_scene()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()

	local addict_a = self.controller.addict.get(1)
	local addict_b = self.controller.addict.get(2)

	--리무루가 비네트를 인터랙트하면 이벤트 재생

	--파티순서대로 1,2,3 0.5초간 정렬
	local pivot_pos = demon_engineer.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
	self.controller.util:align_party_by_name_async({
		rimuru = {
			target_pos = pivot_pos,
			direction = 'left'
		},
		shuna = {
			target_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
			direction = 'left'
		},

		milim = {
			target_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			direction = 'left'
		}
	}, 0.5)

	local demon_engineer_origin_dir = demon_engineer.Direction

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_engineer, 'right')

	-- 리무루(smile,idle): 비네트. 전에 말했던 포션을 가져왔어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_1', skip = true })

	-- 리무루가 비네트 앞에 위에서 부터 5개의 포션을 0.25초 간격으로 내려놓고 곧이어 비네트가 포션을 한꺼번에 습득한다.
	local potion_dropped = 0
	local potion_items = {}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_04')

	for i = 4, 0, -1 do
		local item_z_pos = (i * 0.6) - 1
		local item_target_pos = rimuru.Position + vector(-1, 0, item_z_pos)
		local potion_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{
					pos = rimuru.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
					target = item_target_pos,
					itemid = self.potion_item_id,
					notforinven = true,
					showoncharacter = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					skip_text = true,
					bounce_callback = function()
						potion_dropped = potion_dropped + 1

						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
					end
				})
		table.insert(potion_items, potion_item)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	while potion_dropped > 4 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for _, item in pairs(potion_items) do
		item.ConsumeTarget = demon_engineer
		item:Fly()
	end

	-- 비네트(surprise,idle)(jump1회): 아니 단기간에 이 많은 포션을 다 만들어온거야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_engineer, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'surprise' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_2', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(smile,release2회): 좋았어, 환자들에게 나눠주고 올게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_3', skip = true })

	-- 페이드 아웃 페이드 인 후 치료된 환자들이 비네트 옆에 와있다.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_active_state(addict_a, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction(addict_a, 'right', false)
	addict_a.Position = demon_engineer.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0.5)

	character_util.set_active_state(addict_b, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction(addict_b, 'right', false)
	addict_b.Position = demon_engineer.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 주민A(smile,cast2): 정말 고마워요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(addict_a, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_4', skip = true })

	-- 주민B(smile,success): 덕분에 말짱히 나았어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(addict_b, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'success' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_5', skip = true })

	-- 리무루(smile,bomb_idle): 감사 인사는 이정도면 됐어. 둘 다 쉬러가.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_6', skip = true })

	-- 주민A(smile,nod2회): 네, 알겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(addict_a, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_7', skip = true })

	-- 주민A,B 경로대로 이동 후 사라짐
	local screen_out_x = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', addict_a.Position, -2).x
	local screen_out_wp = {
		addict_a = {
			addict_a.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
			addict_a.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
			vector(screen_out_x, 0, addict_a.Position.z + 2.5)
		},
		addict_b = {
			addict_b.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
			addict_b.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
			vector(screen_out_x, 0, addict_b.Position.z + 2.5)
		},
	}

	local screen_out_wp_key = 'screen_out_wp_key'
	local speed = 5
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(addict_a,
			screen_out_wp.addict_a, speed, nil, self, screen_out_wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = function()
				character_util.set_active_state(addict_a, 'disabled')
				addict_a.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(addict_b,
			screen_out_wp.addict_b, speed, nil, self, screen_out_wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = function()
				character_util.set_active_state(addict_b, 'disabled')
				addict_b.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end })

	-- 비네트(smile,bomb_idle): 정말 굉장한 걸? 이런 기술은 난생 처음이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_8', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(sleep_deep,question): 사실은 조금 의심이 가서 직접 진단을 해봤는데 마나 중독이 맞더라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_9', skip = true })

	-- 리무루(tired,bomb_idle): 뭐, 의심받는 건 익숙하니까…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_10', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(smile,idle): 나도 이렇게 빨리 진단하는 건 처음봐서 놀랍네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_11', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(sleep_deep,nod2회): 덕분에 다들 후유증 없이 말끔히 치료됐어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_12', skip = true })

	-- 슈나(smile,idle): 모두들 건강하다면 다행이에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_13', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(idle,question): 그것보다 이렇게까지 체내에 빠르게 흡수되는 마나는 처음이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_14', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(attack,nod2회): 역시 평범한 마정석은 아닌 모양이야. 리리스에게도 말해둬야지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_15', skip = true })

	-- 리무루(idle,nod2회): 응, 서둘러 마정석을 분석해 줘.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_16', skip = true })

	-- 라파엘: … 마정석의 분석은 지속적으로 진행중입니다.
	self.controller.util:show_raphael_speech_async('ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_17')

	-- 리무루(tired,cast):[독백 연출] 아앗, 라파엘 씨… 성실하네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	self.controller.util:show_monologue_speech_async(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			'ss_slime_mana_addicion_s4_18')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, screen_out_wp_key)

	demon_engineer.Direction = demon_engineer_origin_dir

	-- 물약상점 npc 활성화
	get_stage_event_controller('ShortStorySlimeController'):set_buyer_npc('potion_store')

	--이벤트 종료
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeManagementBulletinBoardPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = ShortStorySlimeManagementBulletinBoard @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type SlimeManagementBulletinBoardController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		effect_attached_to_bulletin = 2,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.bulletin_twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 이 섹션에서 시작했으면 별도 처리하지 않음
	if self.cs_controller.StartingGrade == 0 then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		return
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.effect_attached_to_bulletin

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 관리 보드 오브젝트에 FX_Object_Twinkle 출력된 상태.
	local bulletin = self.controller.get_bulletin_board()

	self.bulletin_twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(bulletin.Bounds.center, 0.7))

	--1회 인터렉트하면 이펙트 사라짐.
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done

	if self.bulletin_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.bulletin_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.bulletin_twinkle_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.effect_attached_to_bulletin and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_bulletin_board()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		if self.bulletin_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
			self.bulletin_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
			self.bulletin_twinkle_effect = nil
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeManagementBulletinBoardSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStorySlimeManagementBulletinBoard @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type SlimeManagementBulletinBoardController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_activate = 2,
		before_talk_with_souei = 3,
		talking_with_souei = 4,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.get_souei = function()
		return get_character('souei')
	end

	self.get_rimuru = function()
		return get_character('rimuru')
	end

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'management_bulletin_board',
		constants_key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, data, this.key)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(nil, this.key)
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.main_quest_id = 7001701
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress >= 5 and not main_quest.IsComplete then
		self:set()
	else
		self.controller.get_bulletin_board().ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled

		self.current_state = self.states.before_activate

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_talk_with_souei then
		self:set_activate_marker()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_activate and
			e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
		self:set()
		self:set_activate_marker()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_talk_with_souei and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_souei()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talking_with_souei

		character_util.remove_relate_event(e.Target, self)
		self.quest_marker:remove()

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:talk_with_souei()

			local bulletin_board = self.controller.get_bulletin_board()

			bulletin_board.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set()
	--10번 소우에이 up, idle, idle로 배치되어 있고,
	local souei = self.get_souei()
	local bulletin_board = self.controller.get_bulletin_board()
	local target_pos = bulletin_board.Position + unity_class.vector3.back

	character_util.set_active_state(souei, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(souei, target_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(souei, 'up')

	character_util.add_listener(souei, self)

	bulletin_board.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
	bulletin_board.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.current_state = self.states.before_talk_with_souei
end

function local_class:set_activate_marker()
	local souei = self.get_souei()

	--소우에이에게 서브 퀘스트 마커 출력상태.
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = souei
		}
	})
end

function local_class:talk_with_souei()
	local rimuru = self.get_rimuru()
	local souei = self.get_souei()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--인터렉트 시 위와 같이 정렬하여 이벤트 진행.
	do
		local align_pivot = souei.Position

		self.controller.util:align_party_by_index_async({
			{
				target_pos = align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right,
				direction = 'left',
			},
			{
				target_pos = align_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
				direction = 'up',
			},
			{
				target_pos = align_pivot + vector(1.5, 0, -2),
				direction = 'up',
			},
		})
	end

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(souei, 'right')

	-- 리무루 (left, idle, idle) : 소우에이? 거기서 뭐하고있어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_management_bulletin_board_s1_1')

	-- 소우에이 (right, idle, idle) : 리무루님. 보고드립니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(souei, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_management_bulletin_board_s1_2')

	-- 소우에이 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : 현재 이 근방을 순찰중에 있습니다만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(souei, self, 'right',

local local_class = newclass('SlimeMoneySupportSection1')

	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	--self.states = {
	--	none = 1,
	--}
	--
	--self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.main_quest_id = 7001701

	self.custom_key_name = 'quest_progress_count'

	self.cur_quest_progress = nil

	self.fx_star_piece_list = {}

	self.fx_star_piece_pos_list = {}

	self.fx_star_piece = nil

	self.nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.current_demon_queen_pos = vector(0,0,0)
	self.current_demon_queen_dir = nil

	self.scene_data = {
		money_support_scene_1 = self.money_support_scene_1,
		money_support_scene_2 = self.money_support_scene_2,
		money_support_scene_3 = self.money_support_scene_3,
		money_support_scene_4 = self.money_support_scene_4,
		money_support_scene_5 = self.money_support_scene_5,
		money_support_scene_6 = self.money_support_scene_6,
		money_support_scene_7 = self.money_support_scene_7
	}

	self.communicators = setmetatable({
		first_device = function()
			return get_field_object('first_communication_device')
		end,

		end,

			return get_field_object('third_communication_device')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			get_list = function(this)
				local list = {}

				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					table.insert(list, func())
				end

				return list
			end,

			is_interacted = function(this, target)
				local data = nil

				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					if type_util.is_interacted_target(target, func()) then

					end

				return data
			end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_Object_twinkle()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent), 'on_treasure_open_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()

	self.device_interact_handler = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/Common/HologramDeviceInteractHandler')

	--각 단계별 진행상황과 이벤트 결과로 습득한 마계 달러가 저장되어야 함
	--custom_state나 섹션 구분 중 보다 나은 방법 선택해서 구현
	local get_progress_count = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.custom_key_name)

	if get_progress_count ~= -1 then
		self.cur_quest_progress = get_progress_count
	else
		self.cur_quest_progress = 1
	end

	local main_quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id).InnerProgress

	--메인퀘스트 섹션 6 이상부터 서브퀘스트 활성화
	--서브퀘스트 마커는 없음
	if main_quest_progress > 4 and self.cur_quest_progress < 8 then
		self:quest_active()
	end

	if self.cur_quest_progress < 9 then
		--보물상자 오픈 전에는 보물상자가 보여지지 않게 처리
		if self.cur_quest_progress < 8 then
			self.get_chest().Position = self.nowhere
		end

		self:quest_disabled()
	end

	--달러 기믹
	self.village_construction = get_stage_event_controller('ShortStorySlimeController').village_construction
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent))

	self.village_construction = nil

	self.device_interact_handler = nil

	if self.fx_star_piece_list ~= nil then
		for index = 1, #self.fx_star_piece_list do
			self.fx_star_piece_list[index]:Dispose()
			self.fx_star_piece_list[index] = nil
		end
		self.fx_star_piece_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_chest()) then
		self.get_chest().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		start_coroutine(function()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			yield_return_func(function()
				quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.custom_key_name, 10)
			end)

			yield_return_func(function()
				self.village_construction:update_resource_and_update_status(self.dollar_id, 10000)
				self.village_construction:update_status_ui()

				-- 강제 저장
				self.village_construction:get_data_storage():force_all_data_save()
			end)

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, self.get_chest().Name))

			while not self.treasure_event_end do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			field_ui_manager:Show()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_device_interact(device)
	--현재 진행도에 따른 scene 연출 진행
	self.cur_communicator = device

	start_coroutine(self.scene_routine, self, self.cur_quest_progress)
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
		self:quest_active()
	end
end

function local_class:on_treasure_open_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chest()) then
		start_coroutine(function()
			do
				--상호작용하여 오픈시 10000 마계 달러와 스타피스를 획득한다
				--마계 달러 획득 처리
				--스테이지용 재화 획득 처리에 대해선 ShortStortLina1At1의 on_stage_loaded_event() 내부 ‘골드 지급 보물상자 세팅’ 부분 참고
				--예시 영상: 가디언테일즈 단편집 - 데몬 슬레이어즈 Pt.1 (Guardiantales Short Story Demon Slayers Pt.1)
				--마계 달러 획득 연출
				--가짜 마계달러 스프라이트들을 생성 후 획득하게 해 많은 아이템을 획득하는 것 처럼 표현
				--마계 달러 스프라이트는 demonworld_dollar 사용

				local items = {}

				for i = 1, 12 do
					local x = random_util.get_random_int(-24, 24) * 0.1
					local y = random_util.get_random_int(-8, 8) * 0.1
					local get_random_pos = vector(x, 0, y)
					get_random_pos.y = 0
					local cur_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.dollar_item_id, notforinven = true,
																  pos = self.get_chest().Bounds.center, target = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) + get_random_pos,
																  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.9, skip_text = true })
					table.insert(items, cur_item)
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
					wait_for_sec(0.1)
				end

				wait_for_sec(1)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
				end

				CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(user_party.Leader):JustPrintItemName('+' .. (10000) .. ' ' ..
						game_string:GetString('ss_slime_moneysupport_3'), 0)
			end

			wait_for_sec(1)

			do
				--Christmas1At6의 open_preset_gift_chest() 참고
				--스타피스 획득 처리
				--타일맵에 스타피스를 미리 배치해두고 숨겨둔 뒤 상자를 열었을 때 나타나는 것 처럼 연출
				--스타피스 위치는 이미지의 노란색 별
				--Christmas1At6 참고
				--예시 영상: 가디언테일즈 루 더 레드 #6 메리 크리스마스 공략
				local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
				local star_piece_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('money_support_chest_pos') + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
				local star_piece_start_pos = star_piece_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
				star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = true

				star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), star_piece_start_pos, star_piece_pos)
				wait_for_sec(2)

				self.treasure_event_end = true
			end
		end)

	end

end

function local_class:quest_active()
	--해당 퀘스트 활성화 시점부터 완료 전까지 다음 세팅
	--영빈관 중앙의 통신기
	--위 이미지에서 빨간 동그라미로 표시해 놓은 오브젝트
	--임시로 obj_table1 오브젝트 사용하고 있음
	--
	--퀘스트 완료 전까지 interactable 활성화
	--퀘스트 완료 전까지 오브젝트 중앙에 FX_starpiece_in_floor 이펙트 배치
	--영빈관이 업그레이드 되어도 해당 퀘스트를 항상 진행 가능하도록 처리 필요
	self.device_interact_handler:add_listener(self, 'low')

	do
		local star_piece_fx_count = 3

		local communicator_list = self.communicators:get_list()

		for index = 1, star_piece_fx_count do
			local fx_pos = communicator_list[index].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)

			local fx_star_piece = self.get_fx_Object_twinkle():Instantiate(fx_pos)

			fx_star_piece.transform.localScale = vector(3, 1, 3)

			table.insert(self.fx_star_piece_list, fx_star_piece)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:quest_disabled()
	--보물상자 인터렉트 추가, 스타피스 숨김 처리
	self.get_chest().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.get_star_piece().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:scene_start_setting()
	local communicator = self.cur_communicator
	--이벤트 시작
	--UI 전체 제거
	--컨트롤 빼앗음
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	--FX_starpiece_in_floor 이펙트 보이지 않게 위치 변경
	for index = 1, #self.fx_star_piece_list do
		self.fx_star_piece_pos_list[index] = self.fx_star_piece_list[index].transform.position
		self.fx_star_piece_list[index].transform.position = self.nowhere
	end

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	--카메라 1초간 통신기 중심 오른쪽 1칸 지점으로 이동
	local camera_move = communicator.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(camera_move, 1)

	--리무루와 파티원들 1초간 이미지와 같이 통신기 오른쪽에 arc로 정렬
	local align_pivot = communicator.Position + vector(2, 0, 0.5)

	self.controller.util:align_party_by_index_async({
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot,
			direction = 'left',
		},
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
			direction = 'left',
		},
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			direction = 'left',
		}
	}, 1)
	--두 동작 모두 끝날 때까지 대기

	--이벤트 종료 세팅
end

function local_class:scene_routine(number)
	--선택지 이벤트 발생과 함께 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 조정
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self:scene_start_setting()

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(intellect) 리리스에게 자금 지원을 요청한다.
		{ 'ss_slime_moneysupport_1', 'intellect' },
		--(normal) 그만둔다.
		{ 'ss_slime_moneysupport_2', 'normal' },
	})

	--해당 선택지 선택시 다음 단계로 진행
	if result == 1 then
		--리무루(left, idle, attack 2회) 끝날 때까지 대기
		local rimuru = get_character('rimuru')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(rimuru, self, { name = 'attack', count = 2 })

		--리무루(left, idle, idle) 0.3초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		local scene_name = 'money_support_scene_' .. number
		yield_return_func(self.scene_data[scene_name], self, self.cur_communicator)

		self.cur_quest_progress = self.cur_quest_progress + 1
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.custom_key_name, self.cur_quest_progress)
	end

	--해당 선택지 선택 즉시 이벤트 종료
	self:scene_end_setting()

	--선택지 이벤트 종료 후 bgm 볼륨 1로 복귀
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:scene_end_setting()
	--파티원 전원 표정&애니메이션 해제
	for index = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[index - 1]

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
	end

	--0.5초간 카메라 파티 리더에게 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--UI 복구
	--컨트롤 복구
	--FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 다시 통신기 오브젝트 중앙으로 위치 변경
	for index = 1, #self.fx_star_piece_list do
		local fx_pos = self.fx_star_piece_pos_list[index]
		self.fx_star_piece_list[index].transform.position = fx_pos
	end

	if self.cur_quest_progress == 8 then
		for index = 1, #self.fx_star_piece_list do
			self.fx_star_piece_list[index]:Dispose()
			self.fx_star_piece_list[index] = nil
		end

		self.fx_star_piece_list = nil
	end

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:appear_demon_queen(set_direction, set_emotion, set_anim, set_sfx_name)
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	local emotion = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_emotion, 'idle')
	local anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_anim, 'idle')
	local direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_direction, 'right')
	local sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_sfx_name, '01_communication_error_01')

	local communicator = self.cur_communicator

	self.current_demon_queen_pos = demon_queen.Position
	self.current_demon_queen_dir = demon_queen.Direction

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_queen, 0, 0)

	demon_queen.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	local demon_queen_pos = communicator.Position + vector(0.5, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_position(demon_queen, demon_queen_pos)
	--등장
	--투명도 0의 리리스 캐릭터를 통신기 중앙에 배치
	--표정 / 애니메이션 등은 사용시 별도로 기술
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, anim)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, emotion)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, direction, false)

	--이후 1초간 리리스 투명도 0.5가 됨. 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_queen, 0.5, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--퇴장
	--1초간 리리스 투명도 0이 됨. 끝날 때까지 대기
	--이후 vector(999, 0, 999) 위치로 캐릭터 보내버림
end

function local_class:exit_demon_queen(set_sfx_name)
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	local sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_sfx_name, '01_communication_error_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_queen, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_queen)

	character_util.set_position(demon_queen, self.current_demon_queen_pos)
	demon_queen.Direction = self.current_demon_queen_dir

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_queen, 1, 0)

	demon_queen.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
end

function local_class:star_piece_scene()
	local security = self.get_demon_security()
	local chest = self.get_chest()

	local chest_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('money_support_chest_pos') + vector(1, 0, 1)

	--화면 가려진 동안 세팅
	--NPC 이미지의 위치에 세팅
	character_util.set_active_state(security, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(security, 'money_support_npc_pos')

	--요원(right, idle, eat)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(security, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_anim(security, self, { name = 'eat', sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	--리무루&슈나&밀림(up, idle, idle)
	local align_pivot = chest_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -3)

	self.controller.util:align_party_by_index_async({
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot,
			direction = 'up',
		},
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
			direction = 'up',
		},
		{
			target_pos = align_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
			direction = 'up',
		}

	--카메라 이미지의 녹색 마름모 위치에 세팅
	do

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--요원(right, idle, idle) 0.3초 대기
	equip_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(security)

			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = false },
			'idle',
			'ss_slime_moneysupport_59'
	)

	do
		local move_offset = vector(0, 0, -8)

		wp_util.move(security, security.Position + move_offset, nil, 2,
				{ end_callback = function()
					character_util.set_position(security, self.nowhere)
					character_util.set_active_state(security, 'disabled')
				end })
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)
	--다음 동작 묶음 각각 동시에 실행
	--묶음 1
	--요원 2초간 아래로 8칸 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	--요원 캐릭터 vector(999, 0, 999) 위치로 이동

	--두 동작 묶음 모두 끝날 때까지 대기

function local_class:drop_dollar_in_communicator()
	local rimuru = self.get_rimuru()

	local communicator = self.cur_communicator

	--통신 장치 중앙에서 demonworld_dollar 아이템 스프라이트가 리무루 캐릭터의 왼쪽 0.3칸 에 회전하며 떨어진다.

			{ pos = communicator.Position + vector(0.5,0,0),
			  target = rimuru.Position + vector(-0.3,0,0), sprscale = 0.5
			, itemid = self.dollar_item_id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	dollar.ConsumeTarget = rimuru
	dollar:Fly()
end
