function local_class:water_bomb_act(target_pos, ignore)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.water_bomb_async, self, target_pos, ignore))
end

function local_class:water_bomb_async(target_pos, ignore)
	--create_item
	local data = {
		state = self.pattern_state.none,
		item = nil,
		start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 6, 0),
		destination = target_pos,
		progress = 0,
		relate = nil
	}

	while data.state < self.pattern_state.done do
		self:explode_pattern_execute(data, ignore)
		coroutine.yield()
		self.bomb_alert_sfx = nil
		self.bomb_explode_sfx = nil
		self.ball_throw_sfx = nil
	end

	data = nil
end

function local_class:elastic_scale(progress)
	local v = math.sin(progress * math.pi * 2) * (1 - progress) * 0.3
	return vector(1 + v,1,1 - v * 0.7)
end

function local_class:explode_pattern_execute(data, ignore)
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	if self.is_paused then
		return
	end

	data.progress = data.progress + dt

	if data.state == self.pattern_state.none then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.pre
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = 20708, pos = data.start_pos,
		                                         notforinven = true, sprscale = 1,
		                                         lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true})
		data.relate = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.destination, {duration = 1, interpolation = interpolations_constants.ease_in_sine})
		data.item = item
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.pre then
		if data.progress > 1 then
			data.progress = 0
			data.state = self.pattern_state.on_going
			--TODO: 착지시 작업

		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.on_going then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.imminent
		--TODO: 아이템 교체되어야 함.
		data.progress = 0
		if self.bomb_alert_sfx == nil and ignore == nil then
			self.bomb_alert_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_bombard_range_01', loop = false,
			                                                  max_distance = 6, play_pos = data.destination})
		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.imminent then
		if data.progress < 1 then
			--TODO: 터지기 직전 연출
			local twopithird = math.pi * 2 / 3
			local shake = (data.progress%0.1 * 360) + twopithird + random_util.get_random_value() * twopithird
			while shake > 360 do
				shake = shake - 360
			end
			data.item.Position = data.destination + vector(math.cos(shake), 0, math.sin(shake))
					* ((data.progress < 0.5) and 0 or data.progress * 0.05)

			local tint = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos(6 * math.pi * (data.progress) * (data.progress + 1))

			local sprite = data.relate
			sprite.TintColor = unity_color({1, tint, tint, 1})
			sprite:Rebuild()
		else
			data.state = self.pattern_state.done
			--TODO: 물풍선 터지는 연출
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			data.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

			data.item:ConsumeComplete()
			--TODO: 해당 패턴 정보 Dispose 해줘야 함.

			self.get_water_explosion_effect():Instantiate(data.destination + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

			if self.bomb_explode_sfx == nil and ignore == nil then
				self.bomb_explode_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_stomp_water_01', loop = false,
				                                                    max_distance = 6, play_pos = data.destination})
			end

		end
	end
end


function local_class:water_throw_act(data_string, destination, cb, ignore)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.water_throw_async, self, data_string, destination, cb))
end

function local_class:water_throw_async(data_string, destination, cb)
	local minigame = self.survival_minigame

	--create_item
	local data = {
		state = self.pattern_state.none,
		item = nil,
		start_pos = vector(0, 0, 0),
		destination = vector(0, 0, 0),
		progress = 0,
		relate = nil
	}

	-- 물투척 패턴
	local dir
	local idx
	local diag
	for x, y, z in string.gmatch(data_string, '(%u+)(%d+)(%u+)') do
		dir = x
		idx = tonumber(y)
		diag = z
	end
	if dir == 'N' or dir == 'U' then
		dir = 'up'
	elseif dir == 'S' or dir == 'D' then
		dir = 'down'
		idx = 7 - idx
	elseif dir == 'W' or dir == 'L' then
		dir = 'left'
		idx = 7 - idx
	elseif dir == 'E' or dir == 'R' then
		dir = 'right'
	end

	local thrower = self.controller.throwers[dir][idx]
	data.relate = thrower
	data.start_pos = thrower.Position

	local diff = data.start_pos - (minigame.origin_pos + vector(-2, 0, -2))
	local pos

	if diag == 'L' then
		pos = minigame:direction_diagonal({diff.x, diff.z}, dir, 1)
	elseif diag == 'R' then
		pos = minigame:direction_diagonal({diff.x, diff.z}, dir, -1)
	end
	data.destination = destination

	while data.state < self.pattern_state.done do
		self:throw_pattern_execute(data)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	data = nil

	if cb ~= nil then
		cb()
	end
end

function local_class:throw_pattern_execute(data, ignore)
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	if self.is_paused then
		return
	end

	data.progress = data.progress + dt

	if data.state == self.pattern_state.none then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.pre
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = 20697, pos = data.start_pos + vector(0, 0.7, 0),
		                                         notforinven = true, sprscale = 1,
		                                         lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = false})
		local thrower = data.relate
		character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
		data.item = item
		drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.start_pos + vector(0, 0.4, 0), {
			duration = 0.4, y_move = function(progress)
				data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				data.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				if progress > 0.75 then
					item:Stop()
				end
			end,
			callback = function()
				character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'get'})
				drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.start_pos + vector(0, 1, 0), {duration = 0.3})
			end
		})
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.pre then
		if data.progress > 1 then
			data.state = self.pattern_state.on_going
			--TODO: 던지는 연출
			local thrower = data.relate
			character_util.remove_anim(thrower)
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(thrower, {name = 'bomb_attack', count = 1})

			data.item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1, -1)
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			data.item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

			data.progress = 0.1

			if self.ball_throw_sfx == nil and ignore == nil then
				self.ball_throw_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', loop = false,
				                                                  max_distance = 6, play_pos = data.item.Position})
			end
		end

	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.on_going then
		local vec = (data.destination - data.start_pos).normalized
		local is_hit = false

		if (data.destination - data.item.Position).magnitude < 0.6 then
			data.state = self.pattern_state.imminent

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySummerBoundBallSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName =  @
		Comment =  퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.chapter_common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Summer/Common/CommonUtil')

	-- 대사 스크립트
	self.sm_bound_ball_script = controller.sm_bound_ball_script

	--mini game
	self.mini_game = nil
	self.game_name = 'BoundBall'
	self.game_constants_key = 'summer_bound_ball'

	--state key
	self.state_key = 'bound_ball_key'
	self.bound_ball_open_event_key = 'bound_ball_challenge_open_event'

	--quest marker name
	self.quest_marker_name = 'bound_ball_quest'

	--marker
	self.get_moderator_pos = controller.get_moderator_pos
	self.get_follower_pos = controller.get_follower_pos
	self.get_game_start_pos = controller.get_game_start_pos

	--npc
	self.get_moderator = controller.get_moderator
	self.get_yuze = controller.get_yuze
	self.get_kid_android = controller.get_kid_android
	self.get_follower = controller.get_follower

	--이벤트 변수
	self.is_first = true
	self.try_check = true
	self.open_check = false

	-- 메인 퀘스트 ID
	self.main_quest_id = 7001201
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local state = 0
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.state_key)
	end

	--키 여부에 따라 npc 셋팅
	self:setting_npc(state)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_moderator()) then
		if self.open_check then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if self.open_check then
			if e.Success then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_game, self))
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fail_game, self)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == 'sm_activity_events_start' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_interact_setting, self))
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:clear_game()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()
	local moderator = self.get_moderator()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:change_leader_to_yuze()
	self:reset_setting()

	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--유즈 (right, smile, idle) : 잘했어! 실력이 엄청나던데? 어떻게 한 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 21, skip = true })

	--안드 꼬마 (left, idle, idle) : 다른 안드로이드 언니들이 자기 머리를 가지고 노는 걸 몇 번 봤어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_android, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 22, skip = true })

	--안드 꼬마 (left, idle, idle) : 별로 대단한 것도 아닌 걸…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_android, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 23, skip = true })

	--유즈 (right, smile, idle) : 아니야! 세상에 공을 그렇게 오래 튀길 수 있는 사람은 많지 않은걸!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 24, skip = true })

	--유즈 (right, smile, idle) : 정말 굉장했어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 25, skip = true })

	--꼬마의 표정이 2초 동안 blush 상태로 변한다. 이후 꼬마, 유즈 둘다 표정이 idle로 변환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_android, { name = 'blush' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_android)

	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')

	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, clap) : 성공하셨네요! 축하드립니다!
	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_direction(moderator, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(moderator, { name = 'clap' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 18, skip = true })

	clap_sfx:Stop()
	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 공을 다루는 실력이 정말 대단하던데요? 인상적이었어요!
	character_util.remove_anim(moderator)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 19, skip = true })

	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 가지고 계신 스탬프 용지를 꺼내주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 20, skip = true })

	--유즈와 꼬마 NPC의 자리를 서로 바꾼다.
	--유즈가 오른쪽으로 한칸 가고, 꼬마 NPC가 왼쪽으로 한칸 가서 사회자 NPC의 오른쪽에 서게끔
	wp_util.move(yuze, {
		yuze.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
	}, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_async(kid_android, {
		moderator.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0),
	}, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--스탬프 받는 연출
	self.chapter_common_util:get_stamp_mark_event(moderator)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(yuze, { self.bound_ball_open_event_key }))

	self.chapter_common_util:check_clearing_last_activity(self.controller.quest_id)

	self.open_check = false
	character_util.remove_relate_event(moderator, self.controller)

	--이벤트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, nil, nil, nil, false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(yuze, false)
end

function local_class:fail_game()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local moderator = self.get_moderator()
	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_android, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_android, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drown_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:change_leader_to_yuze()
	self:reset_setting()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 공 튀기기 게임 실패! 아쉽군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 15, skip = true })

	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 깃발을 지나가는 동안 공을 떨어뜨리지 않는 것이 중요하답니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 16, skip = true })

	--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 좌절하지 말고, 언제든지 도전해 주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 17, skip = true })

	--isStory가 false인 퀘스트지만 true인것처럼 표현하기 위해 바인딩이 안된 함수 사용
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.main_quest_id, true, moderator)

	character_util.hide_weapon(yuze, false)
end

--미니 게임 시작 시 설정
function local_class:start_setting()
	local moderator = self.get_moderator()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()

	--유즈
	character_util.set_position(yuze, self.get_moderator_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast2' })

	--안드로이드 꼬마
	character_util.set_position(kid_android, self.get_game_start_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(kid_android, 'left')

	--사회자
	character_util.set_position(moderator, self.get_follower_pos(3) + vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(moderator, 'left')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(yuze, { 'stop_pre_play_bound' }))
end

--게임 종료 후 제자리 셋팅
function local_class:reset_setting()
	local moderator = self.get_moderator()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	character_util.set_position(yuze, self.get_moderator_pos() + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_android)
	character_util.set_position(kid_android, self.get_moderator_pos() + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(kid_android, 'left')

	--사회자
	character_util.set_position(moderator, self.get_moderator_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(moderator, 'right')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(yuze, { 'start_pre_play_bound' }))
end

--리더 변경 안드로이드 꼬마
function local_class:change_leader_to_kid()

	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(kid_android, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(kid_android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(yuze, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(yuze)

--리더 변경 유즈
function local_class:change_leader_to_yuze()

	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(yuze, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(kid_android, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(kid_android, user_party)

--메인 섹션4 스탬프 이벤트 수락 이후 인터렉트 시 실행
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid_android = self.get_kid_android()
	local moderator = self.get_moderator()

	character_util.hide_weapon(yuze, true)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	--첫 인터렉트 시 스토리 연출

		self.is_first = false

		--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 어서 오세요! 스탬프 이벤트에 참여하려고 오셨나요?
		character_util.set_direction(moderator, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(moderator, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_script .. 1, skip = true })

		--유즈 (left, smile, nod 2회) : 네, 맞아요!

	--state key
	self.state_key = 'bound_ball_challenge_key'

	--quest marker name

	--marker
	self.get_moderator_pos = controller.get_moderator_pos
	self.get_follower_pos = controller.get_follower_pos
	self.get_game_start_pos = controller.get_game_start_pos

	self.get_moderator = controller.get_moderator
	self.get_yuze = controller.get_yuze
	self.get_kid_android = controller.get_kid_android
	self.get_follower = controller.get_follower

	--비치볼 item
	self.ball_item_number = 20685
	self.ball = nil

	--ball update
	self.free_fall = nil
	self.ball_progress = 0

	--banana
	self.banana_item_number = 20696
	self.bananas = {}
	self.is_bound = true

	--mini game
	self.mini_game = nil
	self.game_name = 'BoundBall'
	self.game_constants_key = 'summer_bound_ball_challenge'

	--이벤트 변수
	self.is_first = true
	self.open_check = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.controller.quest_id - 4)
	if not is_unity_null(qp) and qp.IsComplete then
		self:npc_setting(1)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.free_fall:Dispose()
	self.is_bound = false

	--비치볼 item 제거
	if self.ball ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.ball)
		self.ball = nil
	end

	--바나나 제거
	for i = 1, #self.bananas do
		if self.bananas[i] ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.bananas[i])
			self.bananas[i] = nil
		end
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_moderator()) then
		if self.open_check then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if self.open_check then
			if e.Success then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_game, self)
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fail_game, self)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == 'bound_ball_challenge_open_event' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_interact_setting, self))
		end
	end
end

	if self.is_first then

		--사회자 (right, smile, idle) : 혹시… 방금 경기가 아쉽지 않으셨나요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_challenge_script .. 1, skip = true })
		--사회자 (right, smile, idle) : 그런 당신을 위해 더 높은 난이도를 준비했습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_challenge_script .. 2, skip = true })
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_challenge_script .. 3, skip = true })

	--예
	--아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_summer_bound_ball_choose_1', 'Intellect' },
		{ 'short_story_summer_bound_ball_choose_2', 'normal' }
	})

	--예
	if choose_result == 1 then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		--사회자 NPC (right, smile, idle) : 네! 그럼 바로 시작합니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = self.sm_bound_ball_challenge_script .. 5, skip = true })

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)

		local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, self.game_constants_key, function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end)

		while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self:change_leader_to_kid()
		self:start_setting()

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

function local_class:open_interact_setting()

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.state_key, 1)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_moderator(), self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_moderator())
end

function local_class:npc_setting(state)
	if state == 1 then
		self:open_interact_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:pre_play_routine()
	--참가자
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_follower(1), 'enabled')

	if self.ball ~= nil then
		self.ball.SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.ball.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.ball.Position = self.get_game_start_pos() + vector(0, 1, 0)
	else
		self.ball = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.ball_item_number,
			pos = self.get_game_start_pos() + vector(0, 1, 0),
			notforinven = true,
			showoncharacter = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})
		self.ball.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.ShadowTransform.localPosition, 0.03)
	end

	self.is_bound = true
	self.ball_progress = 0

	if self.free_fall == nil then
		self.free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(15, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.is_bound do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		self:ball_update(dt)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:ball_update(dt)
	local ball_y = self.free_fall:GetDistance(self.ball_progress)
	local pinnacle = self.free_fall:GetPinnacleDistance()

	self.ball.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position, ball_y + 0.5)
	self.ball.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Max((pinnacle - ball_y) / pinnacle, 0.2)

	--바닥 도착 시 조건 처리
	if ball_y <= 0 then
		self.ball_progress = 0
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_follower(1))
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.get_follower(1), 'dualgun_victory', { scale = 1.5 })
	end

	self.ball_progress = self.ball_progress + dt
end

return local_class

function local_class:get_stamp_mark_event(moderator)
	local android_kid = self.get_android_kid()
	local dir = 1

	-- 꼬마 NPC 방향에 오브젝트 위치 변경
	if android_kid.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		dir = -1
	end

	-- 꼬마NPC right, smile, push를 실행하며 두 손에 스탬프지 스프라이트 생성.
	character_util.set_emotion(android_kid, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(android_kid, { name = 'push' })

	local kid_hand_pos = android_kid.Position + vector(dir * 0.25, 0, 0.3)

	local drop_item_stamp_paper = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = vector(999, 0, 999), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		itemid = self.stamp_paper_item_num, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.5, showoncharacter = true
	})

	-- 그림자 비활성화
	drop_item_stamp_paper.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--꼬마 방향에 따른 sprite 좌우 반전
	drop_item_stamp_paper.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector( dir * -0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	drop_item_stamp_paper:SetSortingLayerAndOrder("Default", 2, "Default", 0)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	drop_item_stamp_paper.Position = kid_hand_pos

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(moderator, '[base]weapon1', 'stamp')

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(moderator, 'twohand_attack4')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(moderator, { name = 'twohand_attack4', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_spear_02')
	self:item_shake(drop_item_stamp_paper, 0.03, 0.25)

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- stamp 종이 비활성화
	character_util.remove_anim(android_kid)
	-- drop item dispose
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(drop_item_stamp_paper)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_emotion(android_kid)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(moderator, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
end
--endregion

--- 아이템 떨림 연출 함수
---@param item fo 드랍 아이템 오브젝트
---@param amplitude number 떨림 위치 범위(범위 만큼 랜덤 위치 변경)
---@param duration number 떨림 지속시간
function local_class:item_shake(item, amplitude, duration)
	local pos_1 = item.SpriteTransform.position
	local pos_2 = item.ShadowTransform.position
	local time = 0
	while time < duration do
		local rand_1 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)
		local rand_2 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)

		item.SpriteTransform.position = pos_1 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)
		item.ShadowTransform.position = pos_2 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)

		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.SpriteTransform.position = pos_1
	item.ShadowTransform.position = pos_2
end

---마지막 엑티비티를 클리어 하였는지 체크
---@param this_activity_id number 함수가 호출된 엑티비티의 퀘스트 id
---@return boolean true: 지금 클리어 하는 엑티비티를 포함해 모든 엑티비티 클리어
function local_class:check_clearing_last_activity(this_activity_id)
	--클리어 해야하는 엑티비티 아이디 리스트
	local activity_quest_id_list = {
		bound_ball = 7001202,
		watermelon_breaking = 7001203,
		throwing_water_balloons = 7001204,
		beach_survival = 7001205
	}

	for _, quest_id in pairs(activity_quest_id_list) do
		if quest_id ~= this_activity_id then
			local activity_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

			if activity_progress == nil or not activity_progress.IsComplete then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

		if self.beach_ball ~= nil then

			item:ConsumeComplete()

	self.item_container = nil

	self.drop_item_container = nil
	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()

	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

function local_class:knight_princess_play_beach_ball()
	self.is_beach_ball = true

	--기사, 공주 설정
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	--턴에 따른 설정
	local turn = {
		knight = {
			thrower = knight,
			throw_to = vector_util.get_x0z(princess.Bounds.center) + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			angle = -1800
		},
		princess = {
			thrower = princess,
			throw_to = vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Bounds.center) + vector(0, 0, 0.75),
			angle = 1800
		}
	}
	local cur_turn = turn.princess

	--비치 볼 아이템 배치
	local beach_ball_id = 20685
	local create_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_turn.thrower.Bounds.center)

	self.beach_ball = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = create_pos,
		itemid = beach_ball_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	--공 던지기 관련 변수
	local progress_dur = 1.25
	local anim_delay = 0.367
	local real_duration = progress_dur - progress_dur * 0.05
	local catch_time = real_duration - anim_delay
	local throw_height = 3

	--공 그림자 크기 조절
	self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, 0.5, 1)

	if self.is_beach_ball_sound_on then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', parent = cur_turn })
	end

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(cur_turn.thrower, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	wait_for_sec(anim_delay)

	while self.is_beach_ball do
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
		local is_anim_played = false
		local next_turn = cur_turn == turn.knight and turn.princess or turn.knight

		while self.beach_ball and time_passed < real_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--공 위치 이동
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / progress_dur)
			local cur_horizontal_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, cur_turn.throw_to, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * throw_height
			local cur_pos = cur_horizontal_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			--공 회전
			local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, cur_turn.angle, progress)

			--공 그림자 위치 조정
			local shadow_pos = vector(cur_pos.x, 0.12, cur_turn.thrower.Position.z)

			self.beach_ball.Position = cur_pos
			self.beach_ball.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
			self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_pos

			--받는 애니메이션 미리 플레이
			if time_passed >= catch_time and not is_anim_played then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(next_turn.thrower, { name = 'victory_extra' })
				is_anim_played = true
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_beach_ball_sound_on then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', parent = next_turn.thrower })
		end

		cur_turn = next_turn
	end
end

--- 섹션 6, 7에서 스텔라 점멸하는 루틴
function local_class:kid_blink_routine()
	local kid = get_character('kid_android')
	local peak_color = unity_color({ 0.5, 0, 0, 1 })

	-- 중복 루틴 방어
	local req_id = self.kid_blinking_req_id

	-- stop_kid_blinking을 호출하더라도 기존에 동작중이던 코루틴은 즉시 중지되지 않기 때문에 조건을 두개로 분리
	while req_id == self.kid_blinking_req_id and self.is_kid_blinking do
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(kid, peak_color, 1, 1, self.kid_blink_period)

		wait_for_sec(self.kid_blink_period / 3)

		if req_id ~= self.kid_blinking_req_id or not self.is_kid_blinking then
			break
		end

		if self.is_kid_blink_sfx_on then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_count_tick_02')
		end

		wait_for_sec(self.kid_blink_period * 2 / 3)
	end
end

--- 스텔라 점멸 시작
function local_class:start_kid_blinking()
	if self.is_kid_blinking then
		self:stop_kid_blinking()
	end

	self.kid_blinking_req_id = self.kid_blinking_req_id + 1
	self.is_kid_blinking = true

	start_coroutine(self.kid_blink_routine, self)
end

function local_class:stop_kid_blinking()
	local kid = get_character('kid_android')

	self.is_kid_blinking = false
	kid.SpineController:RemovePulse(nil, 0)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			self:s3_intro_scene()
		elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s4 then
			self:s4_intro_scene()
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.crowd_beach_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_beach_sfx:Stop()
		self.crowd_beach_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.amb_beach_sfx ~= nil then
		self.amb_beach_sfx:Stop()
		self.amb_beach_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shake_sfx:Stop()
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.eat_sfx ~= nil then
		self.eat_sfx:Stop()
		self.eat_sfx = nil
	end

	--region s1
	if self.s1_typing_text ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.s1_resource_holder ~= nil then
		self.s1_resource_holder:Dispose()
		self.s1_resource_holder = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region s2
	local s2_pet = self.get_s2_pet()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(s2_pet, self.controller)

	if self.s2_pet_emoticon ~= nil then
		self.s2_pet_emoticon:Dispose()
		self.s2_pet_emoticon = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region s3-1

	--endregion

	--region s3-2
	self.stop_water_effect_routine = true
	--endregion

	--region s3-3
	--trash 제거
	for i = 1, #self.trash_items do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.trash_items[i].item)
	end
	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event related
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s3 then
		if not self.is_clear_s3_1 then
			local interacted = self:on_interact_s3_1_oneline(target)
			if not interacted then
				self:on_interact_s3_1_event_npc(target)
			else
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	--흰둥이랑 s2 이상부터 쭉 상호작용
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_s2_pet()) then
		self:s2_pet_reaction()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s3 then
		--region s3_2
		if not self.is_clear_s3_2 and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's1_s3_2_event_zone') then

			self.is_clear_s3_2 = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_s3_2, self)
			return true
		end
		--endregion

		--region s3_3
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, yuze, self.s3_3_enter_event_zone_name) and not self.s3_3_enter_check and
			not self.is_clear_s3_3 then
			self.s3_3_enter_check = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s3_3_enter_routine, self)
			return true
		end
		--endregion
	elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s4 then
		if self.s4_cur_progress == self.s4_progress.none and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.s4_android_event_zone_name) then
			self.s4_cur_progress = self.s4_progress.android_zone_entered

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s4_enter_android_zone, self)

			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' and self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s3 and
			self.s3_3_enter_check then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_s3_3_trash(i)) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.s3_3_trash_marker_name .. i)
				start_coroutine(self.trash_collect, self, self.trash_items[i])
			end
		end

	end
end
--endregion

--region s1
function local_class:s1_intro_scene()
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(vector(-999, 0, -999), 0)

	local text_width = 1000
	local text_speed = 0
	local text_fade_duration = 0.5
	local text_lifetime = text_fade_duration + 3

	self.s1_typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
	self.s1_typing_text.Widget.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Bottom
	self.s1_typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 0)
	self.s1_typing_text.Label.fontSize = 40
	self.s1_typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
	self.s1_typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local text = game_string:GetString('short_story_summer_main_s1_s1_3_' .. i)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				self.s1_typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

		screen_util.fade_in(text_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		wait_for_sec(text_lifetime)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(text_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 초기 위치 설정
	local cam_start_pos = vector(3, 0, 3)

	camera_util.move_async(cam_start_pos, 0)

	--해변 뛰는 npc 설정
	local run_npc = self.get_s1_running_npc()
	local run_to = run_npc.Position + vector(29, 0, 0)
	local run_npc_speed = 2

	character_util.set_active_state(run_npc, 'enabled')
	wp_util.move(run_npc, run_to, run_npc_speed, nil, { run = true, callback = function()
		character_util.remove_anim(run_npc)
	end })

	--기본 npc들 설정
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local npc = self.get_s1_npc(i)

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	--페이드 인 연출
	local fade_dur = 1
	local bonus_move_dur = 2

	--해변 이동 카메라 설정 (우 -> 좌)
	local cam_move_to = cam_start_pos + vector(20, 0, 0)
	local cam_move_speed = 1.5
	local cam_dur = (cam_move_to.x - cam_start_pos.x) / cam_move_speed

	self.crowd_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_beach_01', loop = true })

	screen_util.fade_in(fade_dur, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	camera_util.move(cam_move_to, cam_dur + fade_dur + bonus_move_dur)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.s1_typing_text.Label.alpha = 0

	for i = 4, 5 do
		local text = game_string:GetString('short_story_summer_main_s1_s1_' .. i)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				self.s1_typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

		self:fade_typing_text_in(self.s1_typing_text, text_fade_duration)
		wait_for_sec(text_lifetime)

		if i == 5 then
			screen_util.fade_out(text_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		self:fade_typing_text_out(self.s1_typing_text, text_fade_duration)
	end

	local text = game_string:GetString('short_story_summer_main_s1_s1_6')

	self.s1_typing_text.Label.alpha = 1

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-999, 0, -999), 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			self.s1_typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(text_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(text_lifetime)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(text_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--지워야하는 npcs들 제거
	local remove_npcs = {
		run_npc,
		self.get_s1_npc(1),
		self.get_s1_npc(2)
	}

	for i = 1, #remove_npcs do
		local npc = remove_npcs[i]

		character_util.stop(npc)
		character_util.set_position(run_npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s2

	self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)

	self:s2_intro_scene()
end
--endregion

--region s2
function local_class:s2_intro_scene(on_start)
	--카메라 초기 위치 설정
	local cam_start_pos = vector(13.5, 0, 1)

	camera_util.move_async(cam_start_pos, 0)

	--유즈 설정
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local yuze_pos = self.get_s2_start_pos()

	character_util.set_position(yuze, yuze_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'sleep_deep')

	--큰 화면에서 보일 수 있는 기타 npc 미리 배치
	local enable_npc_idx = { 2, 3 }

	for i = 1, #enable_npc_idx do
		local idx = enable_npc_idx[i]
		local npc = self.get_s2_npc(idx)
		local npc_pos = self.get_s2_npc_pos(idx)

		character_util.set_position(npc, npc_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	--라이프가드 남성, 여성 설정
	local lifeguards = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local lifeguard_male = self.get_s2_lifeguard_male(i)
		local lifeguard_male_pos = self.get_s2_lifeguard_male_pos(i)

		character_util.set_position(lifeguard_male, lifeguard_male_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lifeguard_male)
		character_util.set_direction(lifeguard_male, 'up')
		character_util.set_active_state(lifeguard_male, 'enabled')

		local lifeguard_female = self.get_s2_lifeguard_female(i)
		local lifeguard_female_pos = self.get_s2_lifeguard_female_pos(i)

		character_util.set_position(lifeguard_female, lifeguard_female_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lifeguard_female)
		character_util.set_direction(lifeguard_female, 'up')
		character_util.set_active_state(lifeguard_female, 'enabled')

		lifeguard_male.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		lifeguard_female.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

		table.insert(lifeguards, lifeguard_male)
		table.insert(lifeguards, lifeguard_female)
	end

	local is_cam_move_end = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_util.return_to_leader(10)
		is_cam_move_end = true
	end)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2, volume = 0.35 })

	--페이드 인 설정
	if on_start == true then
		self.crowd_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_beach_01', loop = true })

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	end

	--유즈 (down, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 사건이 발생한 장소에 가장 먼저 도착하고…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_1', false)

	--유즈 (down, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 여행객들의 안전을 최우선으로 지켜내…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_2', false)

	--유즈 (down, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 사람들에게 최고의 휴가를 선물하는 역할입니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_3', false)

	while not is_cam_move_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--패닝 종료 시점으로 상정해서, 이후 대사 실행.
	--유즈 (down, smile, cross_arm) : 목에 자신만의 호루라기를 두른 여러분들을 이미 훌륭한 라이프가드지만…
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local dur = 1

		while time_passed <= dur do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / dur)
			local cur_volume = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.3, progress)

			self.crowd_beach_sfx.Volume = cur_volume

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_4')

	--유즈 (down, smile, cast) : 마지막으로, 라이프가드로서의 마음가짐을 가르쳐주고 싶었습니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_5')

	--유즈 (down, smile, cast2) : 그럼, 앞으로의 라이프 가드 업무 잘 부탁드립니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_6')

	--라이프가드 일동 (up, idle, jump 1회)
	character_util.group_normal_jump(lifeguards)

	--하단 대사와 함께 유즈 down, surprise, jump 1회 실행.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)

	--라이프가드 일동 : [shout] 지금까지 감사했습니다! 유즈 교관님!
	local shout_pos = vector(-75, 200)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lifeguards[1], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_7',
			true, { screen_pos = shout_pos })

	--유즈 (down, blush, cast) : 이, 이제 교육도 끝났으니 교관이 아니라 선배지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'blush')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_8')

	--유즈 (down, smile, sing) : 편하게 선배라고 해! 알았지?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'sing')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_9')

	--라이프가드 일동 (up, idle, jump 1회) : [shout] 네! 유즈 선배!
	character_util.group_normal_jump(lifeguards, '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lifeguards[1], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_10',
			true, { screen_pos = shout_pos })

	--유즈 (down, attack, cross_arm) : 자, 그럼! 이번 기수 첫 순찰… 준비 됐지?!
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(yuze)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_11')

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lifeguards[1], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_14',
			true, { screen_pos = shout_pos })

	--이동 경로 빈 테이블
	local lifeguards_wps = {
		s1_s2_lifeguard_male_1 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_male_2 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_male_3 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_male_4 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_female_1 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_female_2 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_female_3 = {},
		s1_s2_lifeguard_female_4 = {}
	}

	for npc_name, wp_table in pairs(lifeguards_wps) do
		local wp_idx = self.lifeguards_s2_post_setting_data[npc_name].last_wp_idx

		for i = 1, wp_idx do
			local wp_search_name = npc_name .. '_wp_' .. i
			local wp = field:GetMarker(wp_search_name).position

			table.insert(wp_table, wp)
		end
	end

	local move_routines = {}

	for i = 1, #lifeguards do
		local move_routine = util.cs_generator(function()
			local lifeguard = lifeguards[i]
			local lifeguard_wp = lifeguards_wps[lifeguard.Name]
			local lifeguard_post_setting_data = self.lifeguards_s2_post_setting_data[lifeguard.Name]

			lifeguard.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

			wp_util.move_async(lifeguard, lifeguard_wp, 5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

			scene_util.set_anim_loop(lifeguard, lifeguard_post_setting_data.anim)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lifeguard, lifeguard_post_setting_data.emo)
			character_util.set_direction(lifeguard, lifeguard_post_setting_data.dir)
		end)

		table.insert(move_routines, move_routine)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	wait_all(move_routines)

	--유즈 (down, smile, sing) : 후훗, 후배들은 언제 봐도 귀엽다니까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'sing')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_15')

	--유즈 (down, smile, cast) : 좋아! 선배로서 가만히 있을 수 없지!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_16')

	--유즈 (down, awesome, idle) : 우리 후배들… 잘 하고 있는 지 한 번 볼까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'awesome')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s2_16_1')

	--이후 유즈 left, smile, victory_get과 함께 단편집 시작 연출 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })

	self:s2_npc_post_setting()

	self.crowd_beach_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = true

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s3

	self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)

	if not self.is_clear_s3_1 then
		self:s3_1_setting()
	else
		self:s3_1_npc_post_setting()
	end

	self:s3_2_setting()
	self:s3_3_setting()
end

function local_class:s2_pet_reaction()
	local pet = self.get_s2_pet()

	if self.s2_pet_emoticon ~= nil then
		character_util.cancel_jump(pet)

		self.s2_pet_emoticon:Dispose()
		self.s2_pet_emoticon = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(pet, true)

	self.s2_pet_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(pet, nil, 'heart')
end

--s2 연출이 끝난 상황에서의 세팅
--s3 이상인 상태에서 스테이지 진입 시 해당 npc들이 다시 활용되기 전 까지는 해당 설정 그대로 사용
function local_class:s2_post_setting()
	self:s2_lifeguard_post_setting()
	self:s2_npc_post_setting()
end

--s2 연출이 끝난 상황에서의 라이프가드 세팅
function local_class:s2_lifeguard_post_setting()
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local lifeguard_male = self.get_s2_lifeguard_male(i)
		local lifeguard_male_data = self.lifeguards_s2_post_setting_data[lifeguard_male.Name]

function local_class:on_interact_s3_1_oneline(interacted_npc)
	local string_index = 0
	local print_oneline = false

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(1)) then
		-- 해변 남성 (right, tired, cast) : 아, 아들… 그건 말이지…
		string_index = 1
		print_oneline = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(2)) then
		-- 해변 남자 꼬마 (right, tired, cast) : 아빠. 이 아이 이제 어떻게 되는 거에요…?
		string_index = 2
		print_oneline = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(3)) then
		-- 해변 여성 (up, tired, idle) : …보고있기 힘들어.
		string_index = 3
		print_oneline = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(6)) then
		-- 해변 남성 (up, tired, cast) : …….
		string_index = 4
		print_oneline = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(7)) then
		-- 해변 여자 꼬마 (left, tired, cast) : 엄마… 너무 불쌍해보여…
		string_index = 5
		print_oneline = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(8)) then
		-- 해변 여성 (left, tired, cast) : 하지만 우리가 어떻게 할 수는 없단다…
		string_index = 6
		print_oneline = true
	end

	if print_oneline then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(interacted_npc,
				{ key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_' .. string_index, skip = false })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_s3_1_event_npc(interacted_npc)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(4)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(interacted_npc, self.get_s3_1_npc(5)) then
		-- s3_1 event start
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s3_1_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:s3_1_event()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local whale = self.get_s3_1_whale()
	local npc_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.s3_1_npc_count do
		npc_list[i] = self.get_s3_1_npc(i)
	end

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = false

	self.crowd_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_beach_01', loop = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.get_s3_1_yuze_pos(), 0.8, nil, true, true, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, idle) : 무슨 일로 이렇게 사람이…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_7')

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 무슨 일 있으신가요? 제가 도와드릴게요!
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_8')

	-- NPC 4, 5 일제히 down, tired, idle 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[4], 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[4], 'tired')
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[5], 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[5], 'tired')

	-- 남2 : (down, tired, idle) : 그, 그게 말이죠…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[4], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_9')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.35)

	self.crowd_beach_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	self.amb_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	-- 상단 대사 종료 후 3, 6 NPC 1타일 up. 4, 5 NPC 1타일 side로 이동한다.
	-- 1 ~ 4 모두 right 방향, 5 ~ 8 모두 left 방향을 바라보며 고래의 모습이 보여진다.
	character_util.move_to(npc_list[3], npc_list[3].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			0.8, nil, true, true, false)
	character_util.move_to(npc_list[6], npc_list[6].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			0.8, nil, true, true, false)
	character_util.move_to(npc_list[4], npc_list[4].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			0.8, nil, true, true, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(npc_list[5], npc_list[5].Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			0.8, nil, true, true, false)

	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[3], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[6], 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[4], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[5], 'left', false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, jump 1회)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

	-- 여2 : (left, tired, cast) : 큰 파도가 치고서 돌아가지 못한 것 같아요…
	start_coroutine(function()
		for _ = 1, 2 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
			wait_for_sec(0.35)
		end
	end)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[5], 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc_list[5], 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[5], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_11')

	-- 남2 : (right, tired, cast) : 저희가 물을 뿌려주고 있지만…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[4], 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc_list[4], 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[4], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_12')

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, cast2) : 바다로 돌려보내야 해요! 잠시 물러서 주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_13')

	-- 유즈 1타일 up으로 달려간 뒤 up, attack, push를 shake와 함께 실행하고, 이를 2초간 지속.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'run')
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, whale.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
			0.5, nil, true, false, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'push', { upper = true })
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 9999, false)

	self.shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, push) : 잠시만 버텨줘…! 금방 바다로 돌려보내줄게…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_14')

	-- 꼬마(남) : (right, attack, jump 1회) : 누나! 내가 도와줄게!!
	self.shake_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[2])
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[2], 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[2], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_15')

	local wp_pos_1 = npc_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local wp_pos_2 = vector(leader.Position.x - 0.25, 0, wp_pos_1.z)
	local wp_pos_3 = leader.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, -0.25)
	wp_util.move_waypoint_async(npc_list[2], { wp_pos_1, wp_pos_2, wp_pos_3 }, 5, true, nil,
			nil, 'up', true)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc_list[2], 'push', { upper = true })
	scene_util.shake(npc_list[2], 0.03, 9999, false)

	-- 꼬마(여) : (left, attack, jump 1회) : 나도 도와줄래!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[7])
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[7], 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[7], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_16')

	wp_pos_1 = npc_list[7].Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	wp_pos_2 = vector(leader.Position.x + 0.25, 0, wp_pos_1.z)
	wp_pos_3 = leader.Position + vector(0.25, 0, -0.25)
	wp_util.move_waypoint_async(npc_list[7], { wp_pos_1, wp_pos_2, wp_pos_3 }, 5, true, nil,
			nil, 'up', true)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc_list[7], 'push', { upper = true })
	scene_util.shake(npc_list[7], 0.03, 9999, false)

	-- 남1 : (right, tired, idle) : 아들… 아빠보다도 먼저…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[1], 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[1])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[1], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_17')

	-- 여3 : (left, attack, idle) : 딸! 엄마도 도울게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[8], 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[8])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[8], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_18')

	-- 남여 1, 2, 3 (각 방향, attack, jump 1회) : [shout] 모두 아이들 뒤로 붙으세요!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[1], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[3], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[4], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[5], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[6], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_list[8], 'attack')

	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[1])
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[3])
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[4])
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[5])
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_list[6])
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc_list[8], '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_list[4], 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_19',
			true, { screen_pos = vector(-100, 200) })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_summer/audio:bgm_summer_event', state = 'event' })

	self:s3_1_npcs_push(leader, whale, npc_list)

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(whale, 'in_water')
	if anim_duration > 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(whale, 'in_water')

		--wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(whale, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 1), anim_duration * 0.55, nil, false, false)
	end

	--wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.05)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01')

	self.get_fx_water_splash_in():Instantiate(whale.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.15))
	character_util.set_active_state(whale, 'disabled')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[i], true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:s3_1_npcs_move_end_pos(npc_list)

	camera_util.move_async(vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2)), 0.5)

	-- 꼬마(여) : (up, idle, idle) : [shout] 다음엔 조심해야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(whale, { name = 'tail_swing', count = 1 })

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_1_20')

	-- QTE [up] start

	for j = 1, 3 do

		-- 고래와 밀고 있는 인원들 전부 0.3타일 씩 up으로 이동.

		end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for i = 1, self.s3_1_npc_count do
		character_util.stop_shake(npc_list[i])
	end
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)

	-- QTE end

--- 물에 빠진 아이한테 주기적으로 발생하는 루틴
function local_class:s3_2_kid_boy_routine()
	local kid_boy = self.get_s3_2_kid_boy()

	-- 위아래 움직이는 주기
	local move_cycle_duration = 0.7
	local move_cycle_time_passed = 0

	local move_dist = 0.2
	local start_y = kid_boy.Position.y
	local end_y = kid_boy.Position.y - move_dist

	while not self.stop_water_effect_routine do
		-- 위아래 이동
		move_cycle_time_passed = move_cycle_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(move_cycle_time_passed / move_cycle_duration)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_y, end_y, progress)
		kid_boy.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(kid_boy.Position, cur_y)

		if move_cycle_time_passed > move_cycle_duration then
			move_cycle_time_passed = 0
			end_y = start_y
			start_y = kid_boy.Position.y
		end


		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 물에 빠진 아이 구출
function local_class:enter_s3_2()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local kid_girl = self.get_s3_2_kid_girl()
	local kid_boy = self.get_s3_2_kid_boy()
	local father = self.get_s3_2_father()
	local mother = self.get_s3_2_mother()

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = false

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.s3_2_quest_marker_name)

	-- 대사와 함께 유즈 NPC4를 향한 방향, attack, jump 1회
	character_util.look_at(leader, kid_boy)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)

	-- 해변 여자 꼬마 (up, idle, jump 1회) : [shout] 누, 누가 좀 도와주세요!!!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(kid_girl)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid_girl, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_1')

	-- 대사 종료 후 현재 위치에서 카메라를 NPC 4가 X축 중앙에 오도록 패닝하고, Y축은 그리드 최대치만큼 상단으로 패닝.
	start_coroutine(function()
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
			wait_for_sec(0.35)
		end
	end)
	camera_util.move_async(vector_util.get_x0z(kid_boy.Position), 1)

	-- 해변 남성 (right, scared, cast, shake 미세하게) : 자, 잠시만 아들…! 아, 아빠가…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(father, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_2')

	-- 유즈 (바라보는 방향, attack, jump 1회) : [shout] 라이프가드입니다! 다들 해변에서 나오세요!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_3')

	-- npc 이동 방향
	local move_dir_vector = vector(1, 0, 0)

	-- 유즈가 오른쪽에 있으면 npc들 왼쪽으로 이동하도록
	if leader.Position.x > kid_boy.Position.x then
		move_dir_vector = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	-- npc 이동 거리 및 속도
	local move_dist = 2
	local speed = 3

	-- npc 공용 콜백
	local npc_cb = function(target, waypoint_index)
		if waypoint_index + 1 == 1 then
			character_util.look_at(target, leader)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(target, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(target, 'cast')
		end
	end

	-- 여자 아이 콜백 및 이동
	local kid_girl_cb = function(waypoint_index)
		npc_cb(kid_girl, waypoint_index)
	end

	wp_util.move(kid_girl, kid_girl.Position + move_dist * move_dir_vector, speed, nil,
			{ run = true, callback = kid_girl_cb })

	-- 아빠 콜백 및 이동
	local father_cb = function(waypoint_index)
		npc_cb(father, waypoint_index)
	end

	wp_util.move(father, father.Position + move_dist * move_dir_vector, speed, nil,
			{ run = true, callback = father_cb })

	-- 엄마 콜백 및 이동
	local mother_cb = function(waypoint_index)
		npc_cb(mother, waypoint_index)
	end

	wp_util.move(mother, mother.Position + move_dist * move_dir_vector, speed, nil,
			{ run = true, callback = mother_cb })

	-- 유즈 qte 구역으로 이동
	local leader_waypoint = {
		vector(leader.Position.x, 0, kid_girl.Position.z),
		kid_girl.Position
	}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_summer/audio:bgm_summer_event', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_waypoint, 5, nil,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'up', play_sfx = true })

	-- 위로 qte 실행
	qte_util.swipe('up', nil, 0.1)

	-- 동시에 NPC 1 ~ 3 surprise 표정 실행.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid_girl, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(father, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(mother, 'surprise')

	-- 이후 점프 방향, attack, prostrate 로 목표 위치(꼬마 뒤에 배치되는 것 고려)까지 뛰어올라 점프한다.
	-- 높이는 3타일 정도로 올라오도록 부탁드립니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(leader)
	character_util.jump_move(leader, kid_boy.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3),
			6, 3, nil, 'left')

	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'none')

	-- 유즈가물에 닿는 순간 fx_common_water_splash_in 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01')
	self.get_fx_water_splash_in():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.stop_water_effect_routine = true

	-- 유즈 꼬마의 0.5타일 Z축을 높게, X축을 -0.5로 배치해서 뒤로 오게 한 상태에서 left, attack, push, walk(반복)으로 배치.
	kid_boy.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(kid_boy.Position, -1.3)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'push', { upper = true })
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'walk')
	leader.Position = kid_boy.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.1)

	-- 유즈 (left, attack, push, walk) : [shout] 꼬마야! 누나한테 몸을 맡겨!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_4')

	-- QTE Tap 이벤트
	local start_height = kid_boy.Position.y
	local end_height = kid_boy.Position.y + 0.28

	-- 터치했을 때 시간
	local touch_time = 0

	local kid_boy_fall_state = true

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

				touch_time = unity_class.time.time

				camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.1)

				kid_boy.Position = kid_boy.Position + 0.015 * unity_class.vector3.up

				if kid_boy_fall_state then
					kid_boy_fall_state = false

					scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
				end

				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap(1)
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 1초 동안 터치 하지 않으면 표정 변경
		if not kid_boy_fall_state and unity_class.time.time - touch_time > 1 then
			kid_boy_fall_state = true

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'attack')
		end

		-- 일정 횟수만큼 터치 시 성공
		if kid_boy.Position.y >= end_height then
			break
		end

		-- 아이가 떨어지는 상태면 y축을 점점 아래로
		if kid_boy_fall_state and kid_boy.Position.y > start_height then
			local cur_height = math.max(kid_boy.Position.y - 0.005, start_height)
			kid_boy.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(kid_boy.Position, cur_height)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	kid_boy.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(kid_boy.Position, end_height)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	-- 유즈가 이동할 방향
	move_dir_vector = -1 * move_dir_vector

	-- 유즈가 꼬마를 들어 올리는 세팅
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_boy)
	scene_util.set_direction(kid_boy, vector_util.to_direction(move_dir_vector))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid_boy, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(kid_boy)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, vector_util.to_direction(move_dir_vector))
	command_util.execute_holdup(leader, kid_boy, leader.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 동시에 NPC 1, 2, 3 표정 attack 으로 변경.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid_girl, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(father, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(mother, 'attack')

	-- 이펙트와 함께 점프하여 밖으로 나감
	self.get_fx_water_splash_out():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	local duration = 1
	local height = 2

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_boat_01')
	character_util.jump(kid_boy, height, duration)
	character_util.jump(leader, height, duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, kid_girl.Position + 3 * move_dir_vector, duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(kid_boy, 0.04, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid_boy)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid_boy, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_seat_anim(kid_boy, '01_rustle_01')

	-- 해변 남자 꼬마 (left, tired, seat) : 아, 아빠…? 나 방금까지 바다에서…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(kid_boy, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kid_boy, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_5_1')

	-- 해변 여성 (left, cry, cast) : 다, 다행이야… 엄마는 네가 어떻게 되는 줄…

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(mother, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mother, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_6')

	-- 해변 여자 꼬마 (up, idle, idle) : 오빠? 정말 괜찮은 거야…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kid_girl, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_7')

	-- 유즈 (꼬마 방향, smile, cast2) : 무사해서 다행입니다!

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_8')

	-- 유즈 (꼬마 방향, attack, cast) : 보호자분은 아이가 깊은 바다에 들어가지 않도록 주의해주세요!

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'cast')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(father, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_2_9')

	-- 유즈 (꼬마 방향, smile, jump 1회) : 도움이 필요하시면 언제든 불러주세요!

	if self.is_clear_s3_3 then

		character_util.set_position(self.get_s3_3_kids(2), self.get_s3_3_kid_pos(4) + vector(1,0,0))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_s3_3_kids(3), self.get_s3_3_kid_pos(3))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_s3_3_kids(4), self.get_s3_3_kid_pos(4))

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(1), { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		self.get_s3_3_kids(1).Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_one_line_1'
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(2), { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })

		self.get_s3_3_kids(3).Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_one_line_3'
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(4), { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		self.get_s3_3_kids(4).Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_one_line_4'
	else
		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.set_position(self.get_s3_3_kids(i), self.get_s3_3_kid_pos(i))
		end
		--해변 남자 꼬마 1 (left, tired, cast)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(1), { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })

		--해변 여자 꼬마 2(left, scared, seat)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(2), { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })

		--해변 남자 꼬마 3 (right, attack, idle)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(3), { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })

		--해변 남자 꼬마 4 (right, attack, idle)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(4), { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })

		--퀘스트 마커 셋팅
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.s3_3_quest_marker_name, self.get_s3_3_kids(1), true)

		--trash item 5개
		local trash_item_table = {
			self.broken_wineglass_number,
			self.broken_healing_potion_number,
			self.broken_wineglass_number,
			self.broken_healing_potion_number,
			self.broken_wineglass_number
		}

		for i = 1, #trash_item_table do
			local trash = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = trash_item_table[i],
				pos = self.get_s3_3_trash_pos(i),
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			})

			local trash_bundle = { item = trash, wall = self.get_s3_3_trash(i) }
			table.insert(self.trash_items, trash_bundle)
		end
	end
end

--존 진입 시 연출
function local_class:s3_3_enter_routine()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid_npc_1 = self.get_s3_3_kids(1)
	local kid_npc_2 = self.get_s3_3_kids(2)
	local kid_npc_3 = self.get_s3_3_kids(3)
	local kid_npc_4 = self.get_s3_3_kids(4)

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = false

	local x_pos = yuze.Position.x

	if x_pos >= 21 and x_pos < 24 then
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
	elseif x_pos >= 24 and x_pos < 27 then
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')
	elseif x_pos >= 27 and x_pos < 31 then
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.4)

	--해변 남자 꼬마 3 (right, attack, idle) : [shout] 아이스크림 다 팔리겠어! 빨리 가자!!
	character_util.normal_jump(kid_npc_3, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_3, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--이후 카메라 1번 NPC 중심으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(kid_npc_1.Position, 1)

	--해변 남자 꼬마 4 (right, attack, release 2회) : 거기서 뭐하고 있어
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, kid_npc_4, { name = 'release', count = 2,
																				   sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, kid_npc_4, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_2',
																					skip = true })
	})

	--NPC 1 (left, tired, cast) : 잠깐 기다려줘… 모래 안쪽에 반짝이는 것들이…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_1, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_3', skip = true })

	--NPC 2 (left, tired, cast) : 나가도 괜찮은 거야…?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_2, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_2, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_4', skip = true })

	--해변 꼬마 3 (right, attack, idle) : 모래가 이렇게나 많은데 괜찮겠지! 얼른 나와!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_3, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_5', skip = true })

	--크게 줌 인 하여 NPC들만 보이도록 실행.
	camera_util.resize_to(3.4, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 1 (left, tired, cast) : 그런가…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_1, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_6', skip = true })

	--해변 남자 꼬마 1 (left, attack, walk) : 뭐어… 알았어!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_1, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_1, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_7', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(kid_npc_1, { name = 'walk' })
	wp_util.move_waypoint_async(kid_npc_1, kid_npc_1.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 2, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(kid_npc_1)

	--꼬마 전체 점프
	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_emotion(self.get_s3_3_kids(i), { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(self.get_s3_3_kids(i), true)
	end

	--유즈 (attack, jump 1회) : [shout] 잠깐! 움직이면 안돼!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_8',
														skip = true, life_time = 1, scale = 1.5,
														world_pos = vector(25, 0, -8), bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--이후 줌아웃하며 유즈에게 카메라 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--유즈 (꼬마들 방향, attack, release 2회) : 다칠 수도 있으니 가만히 있어!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, yuze, { name = 'release', count = 2,
																			  sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, yuze, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_9',
																			   skip = true })
	})

	--유즈 (꼬마들 방향, smile, jump 1회) : 누나가 말하기 전까지 움직이면 안돼!
	character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(yuze, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_10', skip = true })

	--해변 남자 꼬마 1 (left, tired, idle) : 아, 네에…
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_1, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_npc_1, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_3_11', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_2, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_3, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(kid_npc_4, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.s3_3_quest_marker_name)

	for i = 1, #self.trash_items do
		self.trash_items[i].wall.Position = self.get_s3_3_trash_pos(i)
		self.trash_items[i].wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.7, 0.5, 0.4))
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.s3_3_trash_marker_name .. i, self.trash_items[i].wall, true)
	end

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = true
end

function local_class:trash_collect(target)
	self.trash_count = self.trash_count + 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(target.item.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(target.item, 0, 0)
	target.wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if self.trash_count >= 5 then
		start_coroutine(self.s3_3_trash_clear_routine, self)
	else
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

end

--region s3-4
---3S_1~3 완료 시점에 강제 실행
---@param shout_bubble_screen_pos any vector2 비명 버블 출력 위치
function local_class:s3_4_shout_event(shout_bubble_screen_pos)
	if (not self.is_clear_s3_1 or not self.is_clear_s3_2 or not self.is_clear_s3_3) then
		self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = true

		if self.crowd_beach_sfx ~= nil then
			self.crowd_beach_sfx:Stop()
		end

		if self.amb_beach_sfx ~= nil then
			self.amb_beach_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	--유즈 해당 위치에서 idle, cross_arm 상태로 좌, 우 1회 씩 둘러봄.
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(yuze, nil)

	local shout_dir = shout_bubble_screen_pos.x - yuze.Position.x > 0 and 'right' or 'left'
	local shout_opposite_dir = shout_dir == 'right' and 'left' or 'right'
	local dirs = {
		shout_opposite_dir,
		shout_dir,
		shout_opposite_dir
	}

	for i = 1, #dirs do
		scene_util.set_direction(yuze, dirs[i])
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	--유즈 (비명 소리 반대방향, smile, cast2) : 좋아! 이제 대충 정리된 것…
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_4_4')

	--유즈 해당 방향 바라보며 attack 표정 실행.
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	scene_util.set_direction(yuze, shout_dir)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'attack')

	--라이프가드 여성 : [shout] 꺄아아아아악!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teatan_scream_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_4_5',
			true, { screen_pos = shout_bubble_screen_pos })

	--유즈 (마킹 방향, attack, jump 1회) : [shout] 안심하세요! 지금 출발합니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s3_4_6')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s4

	self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀되고, 여성 라이프가드 1, 2 사이 지점에 마킹 출력.
	local marker_target = self.get_s4_shout_marker_target()

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = true

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	if self.crowd_beach_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_beach_sfx:Stop()
	end

	if self.amb_beach_sfx ~= nil then
		self.amb_beach_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, marker_target, true)
end

	self:load_s3_cleared()

	if self.is_clear_s3_1 and self.is_clear_s3_2 and self.is_clear_s3_3 then
		local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s4

		self:s4_intro_scene()

	end

	--s2 끝난 상태의 npc 세팅 함수
