function local_class:s4_enter_android_zone()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local loraine = self.get_loraine()
	local android = self.get_s4_android()
	local lifeguard_1 = self.get_s4_lifeguard(1)
	local lifeguard_2 = self.get_s4_lifeguard(2)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'summer_s1_s4_event_start' }))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	self.controller.is_beach_ball_sound_on = false

	self.crowd_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_beach_01', loop = true })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	--라이프 가드 여성 1 (right, scared, cast) : [shout] 저, 저게 뭐야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lifeguard_1, 'short_story_summer_main_s1_s4_1')

	local android_pos = self.get_s4_android_pos()

	--카메라 4번 위치가 중심에 오도록 이동.
	local cam_to = vector_util.get_x0z(android_pos)

	camera_util.move_async(cam_to, 1)

	--안드로이드 생성과 함께, 바다에 배치되어 있던 NPC들 일제히 4번 위치를 scared 표정으로 바라봄.
	--해당 사항은 이벤트 종료 후 기본으로 원복
	local water_npcs_data = {
		{
			npc = self.get_s4_npc_in_water(3),
			original_dir = 'right',
			look_dir = 'right',
			anim = 'bomb_idle',
			emo = 'attack'
		},
		{
			npc = self.get_s4_npc_in_water(4),
			original_dir = 'right',
			look_dir = 'right',
			anim = 'bomb_idle',
			emo = 'smile'
		},
		{
			npc = self.get_s4_npc_in_water(5),
			original_dir = 'right',
			look_dir = 'left',
			anim = 'push',
			emo = 'smile'
		},
		{
			npc = self.get_s4_npc_in_water(6),
			original_dir = 'left',
			look_dir = 'left',
			anim = 'bomb_idle',
			emo = 'attack'
		}
	}

	for i = 1, #water_npcs_data do
		local npc_data = water_npcs_data[i]

		character_util.set_direction(npc_data.npc, npc_data.look_dir)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc_data.npc, 'cast')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc_data.npc, 'scared')
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_thriller'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')
	character_util.set_position(android, android_pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
	character_util.add_color(android, 'android_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(android, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(android, 'cover')

	--이때 안드로이드가 4번 위치에서 fx_common_water_splash_out과 함께 틴트 다운 상태로 생성.
	self.get_fx_water_splash_out():Instantiate(android.Bounds.center)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local yuze_align_pos = (lifeguard_1.Position + lifeguard_2.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0, -2)
	local yuze_align_wp = {
		vector(yuze_align_pos.x, 0, yuze.Position.z),
		yuze_align_pos
	}

	wait_all({
		--NPC 4가 이동하는 동안 유즈 붉은 점 위치까지 달려서 이동.(대각 이동 X)
		--유즈 위치에서 정지 후 이벤트.
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, yuze, yuze_align_wp,
				7, nil, { last_direction = 'up', run = true, play_sfx = true }),
		--NPC 4   Y축을 일정 조정하여 바다에 하반신이 잠긴 것으로 묘사.
		--이후 down, walk를 3타일 실행하여 지정된 위치까지 도착하는데, 이때 잠겨있던 하반신이 천천히 올라오는 것처럼 묘사.
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local lerp_color = function(fo, color_from, color_to, duration)
				local time_passed = 0

				while time_passed < duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
					local cur_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(color_from, color_to, progress)

					character_util.add_color(fo, 'android_tint', cur_color, 1, 0)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
			start_coroutine(lerp_color, android, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1 }), 1)
			character_util.move_distance(android, vector(0, 0.2, -1), 1, nil, true, true)
			camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
			start_coroutine(lerp_color, android, unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1 }), unity_color({ 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1 }), 1)
			character_util.move_distance(android, vector(0, 0.2, -1), 1, nil, true, true)
			camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 1)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

			scene_util.set_direction(lifeguard_1, 'right', nil)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(lifeguard_1, 'cast', { upper = true })
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lifeguard_1, 'scared')

			scene_util.set_direction(lifeguard_2, 'left', nil)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(lifeguard_2, 'cast', { upper = true })
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lifeguard_2, 'scared')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--NPC 4  floor 플로어 다다르는 순간 1, 2 NPC들 scared, cast, walk로 1타일 뒷걸음질하여 빠짐.
			character_util.move_distance(lifeguard_1, vector(-1, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, false, true)
			character_util.move_distance(lifeguard_2, vector(1, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, false, true)

			local move_pos = vector(android.Position.x, 0, lifeguard_1.Position.z)

-- 리더를 시작 위치로 옮기고 스테이지 시작 함수
function local_class:start_stage_event(dir, pos, directional_stage_entry, play_stage_music)
	-- 리더를 시작 좌표로 이동
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	leader.Position = pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)

	-- 시작 연출을 한다면 연출
	if directional_stage_entry then
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(leader.Position,
				leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))
	end

	if play_stage_music then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	end
end

function local_class:fade_typing_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
		if typing_text.Label.alpha >= 1 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 1
end

function local_class:fade_typing_text_out(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	local init_text_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha

	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = init_text_alpha - (cur_time / duration)
		if typing_text.Label.alpha <= 0 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
end

--s3 이벤트 종료시 enum값에 맞춰 입력
function local_class:mini_event_clear(event_enum)
	if (self.s3_event_state & event_enum) == 0 then
		self.s3_event_state = self.s3_event_state + event_enum
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.s3_event_state_key, self.s3_event_state)
	end
end

--불러온 state값을 토대로 is_clear 설정
function local_class:load_s3_cleared()
	self.s3_event_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.s3_event_state_key)

	if self.s3_event_state < 0 then
		self.s3_event_state = 0
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.s3_event_state_key, self.s3_event_state)
		return
	end

	local cleared = {false,false,false}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local val = 1 << (i - 1)
		cleared[i] = (self.s3_event_state & val) ~= 0
	end

	self.is_clear_s3_1 = cleared[1]
	self.is_clear_s3_2 = cleared[2]
	self.is_clear_s3_3 = cleared[3]
end

function local_class:load_inner_section_progress()
	self.cur_inner_section_progress = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.inner_section_progress_key)

	if self.cur_inner_section_progress == -1 then
		local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s1

		self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)
	end
end

--이너섹션 스테이트 증가 저장 함수
function local_class:update_inner_section_progress(progress)
	self.cur_inner_section_progress = progress
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress,
			self.inner_section_progress_key, self.cur_inner_section_progress)
end

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

		-- 해변에서 남자아이와 부딪혔을 때
		kid_event_1 = 2,
		-- 방이대 동료가 전부 합류 했을 때
		all_guards_join = 3,
		-- 쓰레기 던지는 커플 이벤트

		-- 아이스크림 가게 주인 인터렉트

		trash_event_clear = 6,
		-- 라이프 가드 이벤트 1
		life_guards_event_1 = 7,
		-- 라이프 가드 이벤트 2
		life_guards_event_2 = 8,
		-- 쓰레기장 상점주인 이벤트
		trash_seller_event_2 = 9,
		-- 안드로이드 꼬마 이벤트
		trash_android_kid_event = 10
	}
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_summer_kid = function(idx)

	end

	self.get_seller = function()
		return get_character('s2_seller')
	end

	self.get_sohee = function()
		return get_character('sohee')
	end

	self.get_marian = function()
		return get_character('marian')
	end

	self.get_bad_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('s2_bad_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_online_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('oneline_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	--field object
	self.get_trash = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_trash')
	end

	self.get_hide_seek_obj = function(num)
		return get_field_object('s2_hide_seek_' .. num)
	end

	-- 쓰레기 아이템
	self.get_item_follow_target = function(index)
		return get_field_object('s2_trash_item_' .. index)
	end

	-- marker
	self.get_s2_kid_marker = function(idx, num)
		return field:GetMarker('s2_kid_' .. idx .. '_marker_' .. num).position
	end

	self.get_s2_trash_pos = function(idx)
		return field:GetMarker('s2_trash_pos_' .. idx).position
	end

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_dead = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end

	end

	--zone name
	self.s2_event_zone_name = 's2_event_zone_'

	-- item
	self.soft_icecream = 20690

	self.hidden_boy_found = false
	self.hidden_girl_found = false
	self.is_hidden_boy_interacted_last = false

	self.teatan_zone_enter_delay_flag = true
	self.sohee_oneline_event_flag = true
	self.seller_event_direction_flag = true

	self.trash_items = {}

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_reset()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	self:npc_setting()

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, vector(13.5, 1, -14), true)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	-- 쓰레기 아이템 디스포즈
	for i = 1, #self.trash_items do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.trash_items[i].item)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_item_follow_target(i)) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_item_follow_target(i).Name)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_collect, self, self.trash_items[i]))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local summer_boy_1 = self.get_summer_kid(2)
	local hide_seek_obj_1 = self.get_hide_seek_obj(1)
	local watchtower = self.get_hide_seek_obj(2)
	local seller = self.get_seller()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, hide_seek_obj_1) and not self.hidden_girl_found then
		-- 꼬마 여자아이 찾아서 인터렉트 시
		self.hidden_girl_found = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.summer_girl_join_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, summer_boy_1) and not self.hidden_boy_found then
		-- 티탄 남자아이 찾아서 인터렉트 시
		self.hidden_boy_found = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.summer_teatan_boy_join_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, seller) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.trash_event then
		-- 동료 합류 후 상점 주인에게 인터렉트 시
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.seller_interact_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s2_seller_interact_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, seller) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.trash_android_kid_event then
		-- s3 쓰레기장에서 상점 주인 인터렉트 시
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trash_android_kid_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, watchtower) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.life_guards_event_2 then
		-- 망루에 있는 라이프가드 인터렉트 시
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.life_guards_event_2, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 1) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.kid_event_1
		-- 남자 꼬마와 부딪히는 이벤트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.kid_event_1, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 2) and
			self.teatan_zone_enter_delay_flag and not self.hidden_boy_found then
		-- 티탄 꼬마 숨어있는 주변 유즈 대사 3초 딜레이로 나오는 이벤트
		self.teatan_zone_enter_delay_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teatan_zone_enter_event, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 7) and
			self.teatan_zone_enter_delay_flag and not self.hidden_girl_found then
		-- 티탄 꼬마 숨어있는 주변 유즈 대사 3초 딜레이로 나오는 이벤트
		self.teatan_zone_enter_delay_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teatan_zone_enter_event, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 3) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_guards_join then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.trash_event
		-- 쓰레기 버리는 커플 이벤트
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s2_trash_event, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 4)
			and self.sohee_oneline_event_flag then
		self.sohee_oneline_event_flag = false
		-- 소히 마리안 이벤트
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sohee_oneline_event, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 5) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.life_guards_event_1 then
		-- 라이프 가드 2명 만나는 이벤트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.life_guards_event_1, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 6) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.trash_seller_event_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.trash_android_kid_event
		self.seller_event_direction_flag = false
		-- 상점 주인 허리 아프다는 이벤트 중앙으로 접근 시
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.seller_zone_enter_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s2_event_zone_name .. 3) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.trash_seller_event_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.trash_android_kid_event
		-- 상점 주인 허리 아프다는 이벤트 왼편에서 접근 시
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.seller_zone_enter_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:npc_setting()
	--섹션 진입때부터 유즈 walk 시작전까지 해변남성꼬마(right,idle,eat) 옆에 노란색 원 해변여성꼬마(left,damaged,prostrate)

	local summer_boy_2 = self.get_summer_kid(2)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_girl, 'damaged')

	hide_seek_obj_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local marian = self.get_marian()

	local sohee_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_sohee_pos').position
	local marian_pos = sohee_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(sohee, sohee_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(sohee, 'attack')

	character_util.set_position(marian, marian_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(marian, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(marian, 'attack')

-- 티탄 꼬마 숨어있는 주변 유즈 대사 3초 딜레이로 나오는 이벤트

-- 남자 꼬마와 부딪히는 이벤트
function local_class:kid_event_1()
	local summer_boy_1 = self.get_summer_kid(1)
	local summer_girl = self.get_summer_kid(3)
	local yuze = get_party_leader()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	party_util.align_party(vector(13.5, 1, -12), 'up', 1, 'arc')

	--유즈 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 미아들이 가장 많이 발견되는 장소라면…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_1')

	--유즈 (down, tired, walk) : 매장이나.. 아이들이 자주 노는...

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(yuze, { key = 'short_story_summer_main_s2_2', skip = true, life_time = 0.7 })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wp_util.move_async(yuze, { yuze.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5) }, 2.3,
					nil, { run = false })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--walk 시작하면 남성꼬마(right,idle,salute) 여성꼬마(left,smile,idle)(점프 2회)
			scene_util.set_direction(summer_boy_1, 'right', true)
			character_util.remove_anim(summer_girl)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_girl, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_direction(summer_girl, 'left', false)
			character_util.normal_jump(summer_girl, true)

			--남성꼬마(salute) 모션 취한 후 우측에서 해변 남성 꼬마가 run을 통해서 달려온다.
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(summer_boy_1, 'salute')
			wait_for_sec(0.7)

			--해변 남성 꼬마 (left, awesome, run)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_boy_1, 'awesome')

			--(이때 여성꼬마 (right,smile,walk)로 자연스럽게 화면 이탈후 제거)
			wp_util.move(summer_girl, { summer_girl.Position + vector(10, 0, 0) }, 3,
					nil, { run = false })

			wp_util.move_async(summer_boy_1, { summer_boy_1.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0) }, 7,
					nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
		end)

		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left', false)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(yuze.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'prostrate')
			character_util.jump_move(yuze, yuze.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
					3, 1, true, 'left')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.set_direction(summer_boy_1, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_boy_1, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(summer_boy_1, 'prostrate')
			character_util.jump_move(summer_boy_1, summer_boy_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
					3, 1, true, 'right')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_03')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_boy_1, 'surprise')
	wp_util.move_async(summer_boy_1, { summer_boy_1.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0) }, 7,
			nil, { run = true })

	--해변 남자 꼬마 (left, surprise, jump 1회) : 누나! 안 아파?
	character_util.normal_jump_async(summer_boy_1, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(summer_boy_1, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_3')

	--유즈 right, jump로 기상.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(yuze, 'right', 0.5, 0.7)
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	scene_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right', false)

	--유즈 (right,smile, idle) : 누나는 멀쩡해! 너야말로 괜찮아?

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_4')

	character_util.remove_emotion(yuze)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_6')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(summer_boy_1, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(summer_boy_1, 'cast2')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_10')
	character_util.remove_emotion(yuze)

	scene_util.set_question_anim(yuze)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(yuze, nil, 'silence')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')

	local bad_male = self.get_bad_npc(1)
	local bad_female = self.get_bad_npc(2)
	local seller = self.get_seller()

	--빨간원(left,idle,idle) : 대충 아무데나 던져놔~
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(bad_female, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_51', false)

	bad_male.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	bad_female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--주황원과 빨간원 왼쪽으로 이동 3번쓰레기 위치에서 해당 쓰레기 스프라이트 상인한테 투척 상인 빨간틴트로 피격 해당 쓰레기는 소멸
	wp_util.move(bad_male, { bad_male.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0) }, 3, nil,
			{ y_mode = 'floor' })
	wp_util.move_async(bad_female, { bad_female.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0) }, 3, nil,
			{ y_mode = 'floor' })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = bad_male.Position,
															target = seller.Position,
															itemid = 20696, notforinven = true,
															lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
			wait_for_sec(0.7)

			drop_item_util.dispose_item(trash_item)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wp_util.move(bad_male, { bad_male.Position + vector(-8.5, 0, 0) }, 3, nil,
					{ y_mode = 'floor', last_direction = 'right' })
			wp_util.move(bad_female, { bad_female.Position + vector(-8.5, 0, 0) }, 3, nil,
					{ y_mode = 'floor' })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(seller, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(seller, 'mad')
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = seller,
				loop = false, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 7
			})
			scene_util.set_release_anim(seller)
			--그후 상인(left,mad,release): 뭐 저런 녀석들이 다있어!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_summer_main_s2_52')
			character_util.remove_anim(seller)
		end)
	})

	--이후 상인(left,mad,eat) 인터랙트 가능상태로 변경
	scene_util.set_direction(seller, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(seller, 'eat')
	character_util.add_listener(seller, self.cs_controller)

	--상인 위에 느낌표 박스 출력
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(seller)

	--해당 커플들 맨왼쪽까지 이동하면 원라인상태로 전환

	--주황원(right,idle,idle) : 어차피 누가 버렸는지도 모르잖아.
	bad_male.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_main_s2_53'

	--빨간원(left,idle,idle) : 역시 자기는 합리적이라니까!
	bad_female.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_main_s2_54'

	bad_male.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	bad_female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

--쓰레기 수거
function local_class:trash_collect(target)
	self.trash_count = self.trash_count + 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(target.item.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(target.item, 0, 0)
	target.wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	if self.trash_count >= 4 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s2_trash_event_clear, self)
	else
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySummerMainSection3')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_sohee = function()
		return get_character('sohee')
	end

	self.get_marian = function()
		return get_character('marian')
	end

	self.get_yuze = function()
		return get_character('yuze')
	end

	self.get_kid_android = function()
		return get_character('kid_android')
	end

	self.get_kid_mother = function()
		return get_character('s3_kid_mother')
	end

	self.get_seller = function()
		return get_character('stamp_seller')
	end

	-- 동적로딩 npc
	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	-- object pool
	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	-- 진행도
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		talk_sohee = 2,

	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.quest_marker_name = controller.quest_marker_name
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.get_fx_hit()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self:npc_setting()
	self:item_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_sohee(), self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sohee()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_sohee
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sohee_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local sohee_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_sohee_pos').position
	local marian_pos = sohee_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(sohee, sohee_pos)
	character_util.set_position(marian, marian_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(marian, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'mad' })

	character_util.add_listener(sohee, self.controller)

	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		kid_girl = 'shortstory_sm_kid_girl',
		mother = 'shortstory_sm_female',
	})

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, sohee, true)
end

function local_class:item_setting()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId)
	if main_quest_progress == nil or main_quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 1 then
		self.controller:remove_item('shaving_machine')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.get_yuze = function()
		return get_character('yuze')
	end

	self.get_kid_android = function()
		return get_character('kid_android')
	end

	self.get_stamp_seller = function()
		return get_character('stamp_seller')
	end

	--Markers
	self.get_summerandroid_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('summerandroid_pos').position
	end

	--클리어 해야하는 엑티비티 아이디 리스트
	self.activity_quest_id_list = {
		bound_ball = 7001202,
		watermelon_breaking = 7001203,
		throwing_water_balloons = 7001204,
		beach_survival = 7001205
	}

	-- 커스텀 스테이지 이벤트 키
	self.activity_start_event_key = 'sm_activity_events_start'

	-- 커스텀 스테이트
	self.activity_custom_state_key = 'minigame_started'

	--Fx
	self.last_hit_effect_preset = 'FX_lasthit'

	--메인 퀘스트 미니게임 클리어 수
	self.quest_clear_count = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.quest_clear_count = self:get_activity_clear_count()

	-- 모든 엑티비티 클리어 시 바로 마무리 연출로 이동
	if self.quest_clear_count == 4 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self:start_stage_event()

			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.all_activity_clear, self)
		end))
	else
		local activity_custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.activity_custom_state_key)

		-- 엑티비티 시작까지 봤으면 인트로 연출 스킵
		if activity_custom_state == 1 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.get_yuze(), { self.activity_start_event_key }))

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_stage_event, self)
		else
			local stamp_seller = self.get_stamp_seller()

			character_util.add_listener(stamp_seller, self.controller)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, stamp_seller, true)

			if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_stage_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))

	local stamp_seller = self.get_stamp_seller()

	if stamp_seller ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(stamp_seller, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event related
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	local stamp_seller = self.get_stamp_seller()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, stamp_seller) then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(stamp_seller, self.controller)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.activity_intro_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	local is_main_quest_minigame_cleared = false

	for _, id in pairs(self.activity_quest_id_list) do
		if e.QuestId == id then
			self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
			is_main_quest_minigame_cleared = true
		end
	end

	if is_main_quest_minigame_cleared == true then
		if self.quest_clear_count == 1 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_activity_clear , self)
		elseif self.quest_clear_count == 2 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_activity_clear, self)
		elseif self.quest_clear_count == 3 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.third_activity_clear, self)
		elseif self.quest_clear_count == 4 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.all_activity_clear, self)
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySummerMainSection5')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_yuze = function()
		return get_character('yuze')
	end

	self.get_kid_android = function()
		return get_character('kid_android')
	end

	self.get_seller = function()
		return get_character('stamp_seller')
	end

	self.get_wall_civilian = function(number)
		return get_character('s5_wall_civilian_' .. number)
	end

	self.get_lorain = function()
		return get_character('lorain')
	end

	-- 동적로딩 npc
	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	-- object pool
	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	-- 진행도
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		talk_seller = 2,
		zone_enter = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.quest_marker_name = controller.quest_marker_name
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.get_fx_hit()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	local seller = self.get_seller()

	character_util.add_listener(seller, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, seller, true)

	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		bunny = 'shortstory_sm_worker_bunny',
		sweeper = 'shortstory_sm_worker_sweeper',
		kid = 'shortstory_sm_teatan_kid_summer'
	})
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_seller(), self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_seller()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_seller
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_seller_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's5_event_zone_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_seller then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.zone_fail, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's5_event_zone_2') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_seller then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.zone_enter
		start_coroutine(self.zone_success, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:npc_setting()
	--(1)여성(summer_female)(down,mad,idle) : 잘 좀 찾아봐!

function local_class:enter()
	-- 전투까지 도달한 적이 있으면 바로 전투부터 시작하도록 변경
	self.need_start_from_qte = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.skip_scene_data_key) <= 0
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.total_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_battle
		start_coroutine(self.progress_section_after_battle, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_routine()
	if self.need_start_from_qte then
		-- NPC 동적 로딩
		self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
			android_1 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',
			android_2 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',
			android_3 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',

			-- 달리다가 걸려넘어지는 android_1 대체용
			android_1_1 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',

			lifeguard = 'shortstory_sm_lifeguard_male',

			android_4 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',
			android_5 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',
			android_6 = 'shortstory_sm_worker_a',

			android_bunny = 'shortstory_sm_worker_bunny',
			android_sweeper = 'shortstory_sm_worker_sweeper',
			android_carpenter = 'shortstory_sm_worker_carpenter'
		})

		screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

		quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_hit', 'FX_lasthit', 'FX_Object_Twinkle',
				'fx_event_summer_android_fire', 'fx_event_summer_android_proj', 'fx_event_summer_android_hit')
	else
		quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_hit', 'FX_lasthit', 'FX_Object_Twinkle')
	end
end

function local_class:total_scene()
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	self:load_routine()

	if self.need_start_from_qte then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_qte

		local try_count = 0

		-- 실패 시 계속 재시작
		while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_qte do
			try_count = try_count + 1
			self:qte_scene(try_count == 1)

			-- 딜레이 추가
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		self:before_battle_scene()
	else
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_battle

		self:start_scene_from_battle()
	end
end

---안드로이드들이 쫓아오면서 방해 공작을 벌이고, 그것을 피해 끝까지 도달하면 종료
function local_class:qte_scene(is_first_try)
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local android_group = {
		self.optimized_npcs.android_1,
		self.optimized_npcs.android_2,
		self.optimized_npcs.android_3,
	}
	local lifeguard = self.optimized_npcs.lifeguard

	local used_npcs = {
		yuze,
		kid,
		android_group[1],
		android_group[2],
		android_group[3],
		lifeguard
	}

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count, done_callback)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == (wp_count - 1) then
				move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
				if done_callback then
					done_callback()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local wait_move_done = function(executed_move_count)
		while move_done_count < executed_move_count do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		move_done_count = 0
	end

	local dispose_used_npcs = function()
		for i = 1, #used_npcs do
			local npc = used_npcs[i]

			character_util.stop(npc)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
			npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	end

	local raid_target_offsets = {
		vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0.3),
		vector(0, 0, -0.3),
	}

	local raid_move_duration = 0.5

	local jump_start_x_diff = 2

	--유즈, 꼬마, 안드로이드들이 화면 좌측에서부터 달려오며 추격전
	local default_run_speed = 5
	local endless_run_diff = vector(1000, 0, 0)

	-- FIXME : 타일맵에서 마커 위치 왼쪽으로 당기고 이 코드를 바꿔야 함
	local yuze_start_pos = field:GetMarker('s6_qte_party_start').position + unity_class.vector3.right * 8
	local party_walk_diff = unity_class.vector3.right * 3
	local yuze_run_start_pos = yuze_start_pos + party_walk_diff
	local kid_offset = vector(-1, 0, 0)

	yuze.Position = yuze_run_start_pos
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)

	yuze.Position = yuze_start_pos
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
	wp_util.move(yuze, yuze_run_start_pos, 3,
			nil, { callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })

	kid.Position = yuze_start_pos + kid_offset
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
	wp_util.move(kid, yuze_run_start_pos + kid_offset, 3,
			nil, { callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })

	--페이드 인 되면
	local beach_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default'
	})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--현재 시작 위치 3타일 왼쪽에서 right, idle, walk 상태로 걷는 중인 유즈와 스텔라 보여줌.
	--현재 시작 위치에 도달하면 정지.
	wait_move_done(2)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(yuze)

	--유즈가 right 에서 up 0.3초 down 0.3 초 둘러본 후,
	scene_util.look_around(yuze, { 'up', 'down' }, nil, 0.8)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--left, smile, idle 상태로 전환하여 대사.
	scene_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')

	--유즈(left, smile, idle) : 이쪽은 비교적 한적한 해변이니까, 잠시 동안은…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_0_1')

	--그때 안드로이드 3기 화면 왼쪽에서 뛰어와 아래 이미지 위치에 멈추며 대사.
	--5타일 간격 유지
	local android_group_offset = {
		vector(-6, 0, 0),
		vector(-6.5, 0, 1),
		vector(-6.5, 0, -1),
	}

	local androids_approach_x_diff = 2.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	if is_first_try then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', volume = 0.4 })
	end

	for i = 1, #android_group do
		local npc = android_group[i]
		local target_pos = yuze.Position + android_group_offset[i]
				+ unity_class.vector3.right * androids_approach_x_diff

		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
		npc.Position = target_pos + unity_class.vector3.left * 6

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0.5)
		wp_util.move(npc, target_pos, default_run_speed,
				nil, { run = true, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	wait_move_done(#android_group)

	local android_1 = android_group[1]

	--중앙의 안드로이드 (right, attack, attack x 2) : AA72! 대체 뭘하고 있는 거야?!
	--유즈와 스텔라 동시에 left, surprised, jump x 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(yuze, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(kid)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(android_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(android_1)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_1, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_0_2')
	character_util.remove_anim(android_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(kid)
	character_util.remove_emotion(yuze)

	--안드로이드 3기 느낌표 버블 출력 후
	--attack 이모션으로 전환
	local emoticons = {}

	for i = 1, #android_group do
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(android_group[i], 'attack')
		local emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(android_group[i], nil, 'notice')
		table.insert(emoticons, emoticon)
	end

	--유즈 (left, attack, attack) : 스텔라! 뛰어! (유즈 대사 시 스텔라는 right 상태)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(yuze)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(yuze, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_0_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(beach_loop_sfx, 2)

	--대사 끝나자마자 유즈와 스텔라 right, attack 이모션으로 전환 후 오른쪽으로 달림.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
	wp_util.move(yuze, yuze.Position + endless_run_diff,
			default_run_speed, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	wp_util.move(kid, kid.Position + endless_run_diff,
			default_run_speed, nil, { run = true })

	--유즈 일행과 5타일 벌어진 시점에서
	while yuze.Position.x + android_group_offset[1].x < android_1.Position.x do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--출발하며
	local android_x_error = yuze.Position.x + android_group_offset[1].x - android_1.Position.x

	for i = 1, #android_group do
		local npc = android_group[i]

		emoticons[i]:Clear()

		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
		npc.Position = npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * android_x_error
		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + endless_run_diff, default_run_speed,
				nil, { run = true })
	end

	--기존처럼 액팅 시작.

	--튜브 피하기 qte
	--2초 후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--안드로이드1이 튜브를 꺼내듬 (임시 스프라이트 사용)
	local tube_item_id = 20695
	local tube_appear_offset = vector(0.5, 0.4, 0)
	local tube_hold_offset = vector(0.2, 0.8, 0)

	local tube_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = tube_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1,
		pos = android_1.Position + tube_appear_offset
	})

	local tube_holdup_duration = 0.3

	--scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(android_1, 'bow_attack', { upper = true })
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(android_1, 'attack')

	drop_item_util.move_item_async(tube_item, android_1.Position + tube_hold_offset
			+ tube_holdup_duration * default_run_speed * unity_class.vector3.right,
			{ duration = tube_holdup_duration })

	--0.5초 후
	local tube_hold_duration = 0.5

	drop_item_util.move_item_async(tube_item, android_1.Position + tube_hold_offset
			+ tube_hold_duration * default_run_speed * unity_class.vector3.right,
			{ duration = tube_hold_duration })

	-- 화면상에서 보이는 속도
	local tube_additional_speed = 8
	-- 실제 속도
	local tube_move_speed = default_run_speed + tube_additional_speed
	-- 튜브가 사라지는 시간
	local tube_disappear_duration = 0.5
	-- 예상 이동 시간
	local tube_move_duration = (yuze.Position.x + 9 - tube_item.Position.x)
			/ tube_additional_speed - tube_disappear_duration
	-- 예상 도착 위치
	local tube_move_target_pos = tube_item.Position + tube_move_duration * tube_move_speed * unity_class.vector3.right

	--유즈를 향해 던짐
	--scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(android_1, 'throw', { upper = true, remove_after = 0.5 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_03')
	drop_item_util.move_item(tube_item, tube_move_target_pos,
			{ duration = tube_move_duration, angle = -360 * 5, is_fly = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(android_1)

	local tube_move_start_time = unity_class.time.time

	--꼬마 기준 2타일까지 다가오면
	local qte_start_x_diff = 3
	local qte_fail_x_diff = 1

	while tube_item.Position.x < kid.Position.x - qte_start_x_diff do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--슬로우,
	--qte이벤트 출력(위->아래)
	local qte_duration = (qte_start_x_diff - qte_fail_x_diff) / tube_additional_speed
	local qte_unscaled_duration = 1.8
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	local qte_success = qte_util.swipe('up', qte_duration, qte_duration / qte_unscaled_duration)

	--실패
	if not qte_success then
		while tube_item.Position.x < kid.Position.x - 0.5 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		--꼬마가 튜브에 맞아서
		tube_item:Stop()
		tube_item:ConsumeComplete()

		-- 화면 shake, fx_hit, 피격 모션
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self:hit_response(kid, vector(-0.35, 0.4, 0))

		--(damaged, prostrate) 상태로
		character_util.stop(kid)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = 0.2 })
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid, 'damaged')

		--앞으로 날아감
		local kid_roll_duration = 0.5

		-- 예상 위치 계산
		--꼬마가 날아가면서
		character_util.spine_rotate(kid, -180, kid_roll_duration)
		character_util.jump(kid, 0.7, kid_roll_duration)
		wp_util.move_async(kid, yuze.Position
				+ kid_roll_duration * default_run_speed * unity_class.vector3.right, nil, kid_roll_duration)

		--화면 shake 후 유즈 기준 정면 8타일 앞에 라이프가드 남성 npc 생성(left, attack, release)
		lifeguard.Position = yuze.Position + vector(8, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(lifeguard, 'left')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(lifeguard, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(lifeguard, 1, 0.5)

		--여기서 뛰면 안 됩니다! :(스킵 불가 대사창)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lifeguard, {
			key = 'short_story_summer_main_s6_1', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout',
			type_speed = 0, keep_display = true
		})

		--유즈랑 뒤엉켜서 앞으로 굴러감
		local target_rotate = -720
		local roll_target_pos = lifeguard.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0)
		local roll_move_speed = default_run_speed + 2
		local roll_duration = (roll_target_pos - yuze.Position).magnitude / roll_move_speed

		character_util.stop(yuze)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, 'prostrate')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
		character_util.spine_rotate(kid, target_rotate - 180, roll_duration)
		character_util.spine_rotate(yuze, target_rotate, roll_duration)

		wp_util.move(kid, roll_target_pos, roll_move_speed, nil,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
		wp_util.move(yuze, roll_target_pos, roll_move_speed, nil,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })

		--이후 앞에서 나타난 라이프 가드와 충돌하고,
		wait_move_done(2)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lifeguard)

		--충돌 시 화면 shake, fx_hit
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
		self:hit_response(lifeguard, vector(-0.35, 0.4, 0))
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(kid)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(kid)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(yuze)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(yuze)

		--뒤로 날아감
		local execute_fall = function(character, target_pos, height, duration, dont_shake)
			character_util.jump(character, height, duration)
			character_util.set_locked_dir(character, character.Direction)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(character, 'prostrate')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(character, 'damaged')
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, duration)

			wp_util.move(character, target_pos, nil, duration, {
				callback = move_done_cb_generator(1, function()
					character_util.set_direction(character, character.LockedDirection)
					character_util.reset_locked_dir(character)
					self:hit_response(character, unity_class.vector3.zero, dont_shake)

					if dont_shake then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
					end
				end)
			})
		end

		execute_fall(kid, roll_target_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0),
				2, 0.7)
		execute_fall(yuze, roll_target_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
				1.5, 0.45)

		--라이프가드는 반대 방향으로 날아감
		execute_fall(lifeguard, lifeguard.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0),
				1.5, 0.45, true)

		wait_move_done(3)

		--이후 안드로이드들이 꼬마를 둘러싸며
		while android_1.Position.x < kid.Position.x - jump_start_x_diff do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

		for i = 1, #android_group do
			local npc = android_group[i]
			character_util.stop(npc)

			scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = raid_move_duration })
			character_util.jump(npc, 1, raid_move_duration)
			wp_util.move(npc, kid.Position + raid_target_offsets[i],
					nil, raid_move_duration, { callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
		end

		wait_move_done(#android_group)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)

		--페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.4, 2)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		dispose_used_npcs()

		--추격 이벤트 처음부터 재시작
		return
	end

	--성공
	while tube_item.Position.x < kid.Position.x - qte_fail_x_diff do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--유즈와 꼬마가 점프해서 튜브를 피함
	local execute_mario_jump = function(character, height, duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(character, height, duration)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(character, 'get', { remove_after = duration })
	end

	execute_mario_jump(kid, 2, 0.6)

	wait_for_sec(math.abs(kid.Position.x - yuze.Position.x) / tube_additional_speed)

	execute_mario_jump(yuze, 2, 0.6)

	qte_start_x_diff = 3
	qte_fail_x_diff = 1

	--fx_eight_tail_hammock_basic_proj (투사체)
	--fx_eight_tail_hammock_basic_proj_contrail (궤적)
	--fx_eight_tail_hammock_basic_proj_explosion (폭발)
	local shoot_and_hit_routine = function(info, bullet_y_rot, fall_offset)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
		local target = info.fo
		local is_left = kid.Position.x > target.Position.x
		local fall_target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position
				+ (target.Position - kid.Position).normalized * 4) + (fall_offset or unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local time_passed = 0
		local bullet_speed = 5.5
		local shoot_pos = kid.Position + vector(is_left and -0.5 or 0.5, 0.25, 0)
		local bullet_diff = target.Position - shoot_pos
		local bullet_move_diff = (bullet_diff.magnitude - 0.7) * bullet_diff.normalized
		local bullet_target_pos = shoot_pos + bullet_move_diff
		local hit_delay = bullet_move_diff.magnitude / bullet_speed
		local bullet = self.get_kid_effect.proj():Instantiate(shoot_pos)
		local bullet_transform = bullet.transform
		bullet_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
		bullet_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, bullet_y_rot, 0)

		--안드로이드 3기는 물총 이펙트 맞고
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stella_shoot_01')
		self.get_kid_effect.fire():Instantiate(shoot_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim(kid)
		character_util.set_direction(kid, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(kid, 'rifle_shoot2', { remove_after = 0.167 })

		while time_passed < hit_delay do
			local progress = time_passed / hit_delay
			bullet_transform.position = shoot_pos * (1 - progress) + bullet_target_pos * progress

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		bullet:Dispose()

		self.get_kid_effect.explosion():Instantiate(target.Position)

		local fall_start_pos = target.Position
		time_passed = 0
		local fall_duration = 0.7

		--공중에서 dead 모션 후
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(target, 'damaged')
		character_util.spine_rotate(target, is_left and 720 or -720, fall_duration)

		while time_passed < fall_duration do
			local progress = time_passed / fall_duration
			local cur_xz = fall_start_pos * (1 - progress) + fall_target_pos * progress
			local cur_y = fall_start_pos.y * math.sin(math.pi / 2 * (1 - progress))
			character_util.set_position(target, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_y), true)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		--땅에 떨어짐.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self:hit_response(target, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end

function local_class:hit_response(character, hit_offset, dont_shake)
	if not lua_helper.get_or_default(dont_shake, false) then
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	end

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(character)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)

	local hit_pos = character.Position + hit_offset + 0.001 * unity_class.vector3.up

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_pos)
	--self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(hit_pos)
end

function local_class:before_battle_scene()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count, done_callback)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == (wp_count - 1) then
				move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
				if done_callback then
					done_callback()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local wait_move_done = function(executed_move_count)
		while move_done_count < executed_move_count do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		move_done_count = 0
	end

	local light = get_field_object('directional_light')
	local animator = light.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('idle')

	--페이드 인 하면
	--유즈랑 꼬마가 화면 좌측에서 하단 위치까지 뛰어옴
	local align_center_pos = field:GetMarker('s6_align_center').position
	local yuze_offset = vector(0.6, 0, 0)
	local kid_offset = vector(-0.6, 0, 0)
	local pre_run_dist = 7

	--상단 스크린샷 위치에 정렬할 때 까지 유즈 attack표정, 꼬마 idle 표정으로 달려온다.

	wp_util.move(yuze, align_center_pos + yuze_offset, 5, nil, {

	scene_util.set_direction(marian, 'right')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(marian, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_46')

	--꼬마 (left, tired, idle) : …굉장히 높은 수치로 신뢰하고 있습니다.

	})
	character_util.remove_anim(lorain)

	--1초 대기 후 아래의 대사
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--마리안 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 예로부터 티탄족의 과학력은 세계 제일이었지…

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(marian, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_50_3')

	--로레인 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 뭘 하려는…
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(lorain, 'short_story_summer_main_s6_50_4', nil, {
		bubble_direction = 'rb'
	})
	character_util.remove_anim(lorain)

	--직후 마리안이 mad표정 [shout] “티탄족의 전투력 또한 세계 제이이일!!!!!!!!!”로
	scene_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down', false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(marian, {
		key = 'short_story_summer_main_s6_51', bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0, keep_display = true, scale = 1.3
	})

	local lorain_push_end_pos = vector(lorain.Position.x, 1, battle_zone_bounds.min.z + 1)
	local marian_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.8

	local lorain_start_pos = lorain.Position
	local lorain_target_pos = (lorain_start_pos + lorain_push_end_pos * 2) / 3
	local first_push_duration = 1

	--로레인에게 달려든다.
	local marian_run_duration = 0.2
	camera_util.move(lorain_target_pos + marian_offset, marian_run_duration + first_push_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(marian, lorain.Position + marian_offset,
			nil, marian_run_duration, { run = true })

	--로레인 attack 표정으로
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lorain, 'attack')

	--맞부딪히고 (fx_hit, fx_lasthait)
	local hit_effect_pos = lorain.Position + marian_offset / 2 + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.4
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_effect_pos)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(hit_effect_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)

	--로레인이 위 스크린샷 위치까지 밀려나면서 둘은 shoot으로 계속해서 대치.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'shoot')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(marian, 'shoot', { upper = true })
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(marian, 'walk')

	--처음 맞부딪힐 때 빠르게 반 정도 밀리고,
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < first_push_duration do
		local pos_progress = interpolations_constants.ease_out_sine(time_passed, 0, 1, first_push_duration)
		lorain.Position = lorain_start_pos * (1 - pos_progress) + lorain_target_pos * pos_progress
		marian.Position = lorain.Position + marian_offset

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	lorain.Position = lorain_target_pos
	marian.Position = lorain.Position + marian_offset

	character_util.remove_anim(marian)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(marian)

	--마리안 (left, attack, shoot) : 이게 바로 아이언 마리안 모드다!!!

	start_coroutine(function()
		local second_push_duration = 0.8
		time_passed = 0

		lorain_start_pos = lorain.Position
		lorain_target_pos = lorain_push_end_pos

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(marian, 'walk')

		while time_passed < second_push_duration do
			local pos_progress = interpolations_constants.ease_in_out_sine(time_passed, 0, 1, second_push_duration)
			lorain.Position = lorain_start_pos * (1 - pos_progress) + lorain_target_pos * pos_progress
			marian.Position = lorain.Position + marian_offset

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		lorain.Position = lorain_target_pos
		marian.Position = lorain.Position + marian_offset

		character_util.remove_anim(marian)

		is_push_done = true
	end)

	--로레인 (right, attack, shoot) : [shout] 뭣들 해요?! 어서 제압하지 않고!
	character_util.remove_emotion(yuze)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'attack')

	while not is_push_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 1, #androids do

		local look_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(npc.Direction)

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + look_direction,
				3, nil, { run = true, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	wait_move_done(#androids)

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })

	-- 보스전부터 시작하도록 저장
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.skip_scene_data_key, 1)

	--유즈, vs  안드로이드의 전투.
	--로레인, 꼬마 안드로이드는 배틀게이트 안에 있으나 전투 참여하지 않음.
	character_util.convert_to_npc(kid)
	character_util.set_active_state(kid, 'visible')
	character_util.set_active_state(lorain, 'visible')
	character_util.set_active_state(marian, 'visible')

	character_util.remove_emotion(yuze)

	character_util.set_immortal(yuze, true)

	--안드로이드 1,2
	--일반 ai 근거리 사용
	--무기 : laser_sword 사용
	--안드로이드 3,4
	--일반 ai 원거리 사용
	--무기 : machinegun
	--프로젝타일 : bullet_light
	for i = 1, #androids do
		local enemy = androids[i]
		character_util.convert_to_monster(enemy, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(enemy, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	--배틀게이트 올려지며 전투 시작.
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i))
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_battle
end

function local_class:start_scene_from_battle()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	local androids = {
		self.get_battle_android(1),
		self.get_battle_android(2),
		self.get_battle_android(3),
		self.get_battle_android(4),
	}

	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	local android_setting_info = {
		{
			dir = 'right',
			pos = field:GetMarker('s6_left_npc_appear_1').position,
		},
		{
			dir = 'right',
			pos = field:GetMarker('s6_left_npc_appear_2').position,
		},
		{
			dir = 'left',
			pos = field:GetMarker('s6_right_npc_appear_1').position,
		},
		{
			dir = 'left',
			pos = field:GetMarker('s6_right_npc_appear_2').position,
		},
	}

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count, done_callback)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == (wp_count - 1) then
				move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
				if done_callback then
					done_callback()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local wait_move_done = function(executed_move_count)
		while move_done_count < executed_move_count do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		move_done_count = 0
	end

	for i = 1, #androids do
		local npc = androids[i]

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)

		npc.Position = android_setting_info[i].pos
		character_util.set_direction(npc, android_setting_info[i].dir)

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCustomIdleAnimation(npc))
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(androids[2], 'cover')

	local lorain_x_pos = (android_setting_info[1].pos.x + android_setting_info[3].pos.x) / 2

	local battle_zone_bounds = field:GetZone(self.battle_zone_name).Bounds
	lorain.Position = vector(lorain_x_pos, 1, battle_zone_bounds.min.z + 1)
	character_util.set_direction(lorain, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'shoot')

	marian.Position = lorain.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.8
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(marian, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(marian, 'shoot', { upper = true })

	kid.Position = vector(lorain_x_pos, 1, battle_zone_bounds.max.z - 1)
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'down')
	character_util.shake(kid, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'cast')

	local light = get_field_object('directional_light')
	local animator = light.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('idle')

	yuze.Position = android_setting_info[3].pos + unity_class.vector3.left * 2
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(yuze, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yuze, CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCustomIdleAnimation(yuze))

	self.controller:start_kid_blinking()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_suspense_theme' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--안드로이드1,2,3,4, 앞으로 2타일씩 달려나가며
	for i = 1, #androids do
		local npc = androids[i]

		local look_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(npc.Direction)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + look_direction,
				3, nil, { run = true, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	wait_move_done(#androids)

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })

	--유즈, vs  안드로이드의 전투.
	--로레인, 꼬마 안드로이드는 배틀게이트 안에 있으나 전투 참여하지 않음.
	character_util.convert_to_npc(kid)
	character_util.set_active_state(kid, 'visible')
	character_util.set_active_state(lorain, 'visible')
	character_util.set_active_state(marian, 'visible')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	character_util.set_immortal(yuze, true)

	--안드로이드 1,2
	--일반 ai 근거리 사용
	--무기 : laser_sword 사용
	--안드로이드 3,4
	--일반 ai 원거리 사용
	--무기 : machinegun
	--프로젝타일 : bullet_light
	for i = 1, #androids do
		local enemy = androids[i]
		character_util.convert_to_monster(enemy, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(enemy, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	--배틀게이트 올려지며 전투 시작.
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i))
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_battle
end

function local_class:progress_section_after_battle()
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i))

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySummerThrowingBalloonsController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = Controller @
		Comment = Controller 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.in_event_zone = false

	-- 연출을 잠시 멈출 것인지
	self.stop_event = true

	-- 이벤트 연출 루틴을 멈출 것인지
	self.stop_event_routine = true

	-- 미니게임 장소에서 이벤트 연출 진행 중인 npc들
	self.event_npcs = nil

	self.fx_water_explosion_name = 'fx_event_wateballoon_explosion'

	self.throwing_balloons_event_zone_name = 'throwing_balloons_event'
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.stop_event_routine = true

	self.event_npcs = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.throwing_balloons_event_zone_name) then
		self.in_event_zone = true

		if self.stop_event_routine then

			self.stop_event_routine = false

			start_coroutine(self.throwing_water_balloon_routine, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.throwing_balloons_event_zone_name) then
		self.in_event_zone = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_throwing_balloons_challenge' then
		self:stop_throwing_balloons_routine()
		return true
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'end_throwing_balloons_challenge' then
		self:restart_throwing_balloons_routine()
		return true
	end


	return false
end

	local right_tower_pos = field:GetMarker('throwing_wb_enemy_tower_pos').position

	if self.quest_progress and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:oneline_npc_setting(true)
	end

		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1.3 })

	self.right_tower = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = right_tower_pos, itemid = 20705,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1.3 })

	self.green_water_balloon = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = vector(999, 0, 999), itemid = 20698,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	self.red_water_balloon = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = vector(999, 0, 999), itemid = 20697,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	self.event_npcs = {
		get_character('throwing_balloons_male'),
		get_character('throwing_balloons_female'),
		get_character('throwing_balloons_bad_male'),
		get_character('throwing_balloons_bad_female')
	}
end

function local_class:throwing_water_balloon_routine()
	local left_male = get_character('throwing_balloons_male')
	local right_male = get_character('throwing_balloons_bad_male')

	-- 이벤트 연출을 멈출 것인지 체크하는 함수
	local check_stop_event_routine = function()
		while not self.in_event_zone or self.stop_event_routine do
			if self.stop_event_routine then
				return true
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		return false
	end

	-- 물풍선 날아가는 연출
	local move_balloon_func = function(balloon, from, to)
		local height = 3

		local duration = 0.7
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			if self.stop_event_routine then
				balloon.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				return
			end

			time_passed  = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + 0.5

			balloon.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_y)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_water_01', play_pos = balloon.Position })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_water_explosion_name):Instantiate(balloon.Position)
		balloon.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	while not self.stop_event_routine do
		-- 왼쪽 npc가 물풍선 던지는 연출
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(left_male, { name = 'boong_attack_ready' })

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', parent = left_male })
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(left_male, 'boong_attack', { remove_after = 0.35 })

		move_balloon_func(self.green_water_balloon,
			left_male.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			right_male.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0))

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(2)

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end

		-- 오른쪽 npc가 물풍선 던지는 연출
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(right_male, { name = 'boong_attack_ready' })

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', parent = right_male })
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(right_male, 'boong_attack', { remove_after = 0.35 })

		move_balloon_func(self.red_water_balloon,
			right_male.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			left_male.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(2)

		if check_stop_event_routine() then
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stop_throwing_balloons_routine()
	self.stop_event_routine = true

	for i = 1, #self.event_npcs do
		local npc = self.event_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	self.left_tower.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.right_tower.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:restart_throwing_balloons_routine()
	for i = 1, #self.event_npcs do
		local npc = self.event_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	local left_tower_pos = field:GetMarker('throwing_wb_player_tower_pos').position
	self.left_tower.Position = left_tower_pos

	local right_tower_pos = field:GetMarker('throwing_wb_enemy_tower_pos').position
	self.right_tower.Position = right_tower_pos

	self.stop_event_routine = false
	start_coroutine(self.throwing_water_balloon_routine, self)
end

--- 퀘스트 클리어 여부에 따른 원라인 npc 세팅
function local_class:oneline_npc_setting(is_complete_quest)
	-- 날다람쥐 방위대 원라인 세팅
	local oneline_kid_pos = field:GetMarker('oneline_kid_pos').position

	local oneline_kid_boy = get_character('s2_summer_kid_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oneline_kid_boy)
	character_util.set_direction(oneline_kid_boy, 'down')

	local oneline_kid_teatan = get_character('s2_summer_kid_2')

	oneline_kid_teatan.Position = oneline_kid_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1)

	local oneline_kid_girl = get_character('s2_summer_kid_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oneline_kid_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oneline_kid_girl, 'left')
	oneline_kid_girl.Position = oneline_kid_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1)

	if not is_complete_quest then
		-- 클리어 전
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_kid_boy, 'smile')
		oneline_kid_boy.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_kid_oneline_1'

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_kid_teatan, 'smile')
		oneline_kid_teatan.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_kid_oneline_2'

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_kid_girl, 'smile')

	else
		-- 클리어 후

		scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(oneline_kid_boy, false)
		oneline_kid_boy.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_china_01'
		oneline_kid_boy.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_kid_oneline_4'

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_kid_teatan, 'awesome')
		oneline_kid_teatan.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_bad_fairy_01'
		oneline_kid_teatan.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_kid_oneline_5'

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_kid_girl, 'awesome')
		oneline_kid_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_kid_oneline_6'
	end
end

end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 사회자 (down, smile, cast2) : 어린 도전자도 환영합니다!
	self.get_emcee().Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_summer_throwing_balloons_49'

function local_class:on_event(e)

		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_emcee()) then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		start_coroutine(self.talk_with_emcee, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'throwing_balloons_center_event') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		start_coroutine(self.enter_center_zone, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- 사회자 (down, idle, jump 1회) : 왕년에 공 좀 던져보신 분들! 어서 여기로 오세요!

	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_center_zone then
		return

	-- 사회자 (down, attack, cast2) : 물풍선으로 모든 모래성을 무너뜨려 우승하면 스탬프를 찍어드립니다!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(emcee, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(emcee, 'attack')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local yuze = user_party.Leader

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(emcee)

	wp_util.move(kid_android, emcee.Position + vector(1, 0, -1),
		nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(yuze, emcee.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })

	-- 사회자 (down, smile, cast) : 물풍선 던지기에 관심 있으실까요?

function local_class:fail_mini_game()
	local emcee = self.get_emcee()

	emcee.Position = self.origin_emcee_pos
	character_util.set_direction(emcee, 'down')
	party_util.align_to_target(emcee, 'down', 0, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 사회자 (down, smile, idle) : 아쉽네요… 하지만 기회는 언제든 열려 있으니 마음껏 도전하세요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(emcee, 'short_story_summer_throwing_balloons_45')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(emcee)
	self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state - 1
end

--- 미니게임 실행
function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.is_play_mini_game = true

	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	if not self.mini_game_loaded then
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'summer', function()
			self.mini_game_loaded = true
		end)
	end

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 미니게임에서 shear 적용되지 않도록 처리
	if not self.shear_controller then
		self.shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller():GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController))
		self.origin_shear = self.shear_controller.Shear
	end

	self.shear_controller.Shear = 0

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

--- 미니게임 끝났을 때 세팅
function local_class:end_mini_game_setting()
	self.shear_controller.Shear = self.origin_shear

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })

	self.controller:restart_throwing_balloons_routine()
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

	self.get_couple_man = function()

	end

		return get_character('watermelon_kid_1')
	end
	self.get_kid_2 = function()
		return get_character('watermelon_kid_2')
	end

	-- fo
	self.get_water_balloon = function(num)
		return get_field_object('water_balloon_' .. num)
	end
	self.get_water_melon = function()
		return get_field_object('water_melon')
	end

	end

	self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = nil

	self.water_melon_item_num = 20689

function local_class:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.drop_item_water_melon ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_water_melon)
		self.drop_item_water_melon = nil
	end

	if self.drop_item_broken_water_melon ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_broken_water_melon)
		self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = nil
	end

		if self.drop_item_water_balloon_list ~= nil and self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index])
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] = nil
		end
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

		self.post_story_section = nil

end

	end

end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			return self:on_interact_event(e)
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

	return false
end

	self:item_setting()
end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mc()) then
		if not self.watermelon_challenge_quest_clear then
			return false
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_mc(), { key = self.string_key .. 51, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_couple_woman()) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_couple_woman(), { key = self.string_key .. 41, skip = false })
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_couple_man()) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_couple_man(), { key = self.string_key .. 42, skip = false })
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid_1()) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_kid_1(), { key = self.string_key .. 43, skip = false })
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid_2()) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_kid_2(), { key = self.string_key .. 44, skip = false })
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:item_setting()
	-- 미니 게임 전 연출을 위한 물풍선
	for index = 1, self.water_ballon_count do
		self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = self.get_water_balloon(index).Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			itemid = self.water_balloon_item_num, notforinven = true
		})
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if self.drop_item_broken_water_melon == nil then
				self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = self.get_water_melon().Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					itemid = self.broken_water_melon_item_num, notforinven = true
				})
			end
		else
			if self.drop_item_water_melon == nil then
				self.drop_item_water_melon = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = self.get_water_melon().Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					itemid = self.water_melon_item_num, notforinven = true
				})
			end
		end
	end

	local couple_woman = self.get_couple_woman()
	local kid_1 = self.get_kid_1()
	local kid_2 = self.get_kid_2()

	character_util.set_position(mc, mc_pos)

	character_util.set_direction(kid_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(kid_2, mc_pos + vector(0, 0, -4))
	character_util.set_direction(kid_2, 'right')

	character_util.set_emotion(kid_1, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_2, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_position(couple_man, mc_pos + vector(-1, 0, 3))
	character_util.set_direction(couple_man, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(couple_man, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_position(couple_woman, mc_pos + vector(0, 0, 3))
	character_util.set_direction(couple_woman, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(couple_woman, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_direction(kid_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(kid_2, 'right')
