--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), 'normal_dying_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.start

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s10_battle_gate_1'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s10_battle_gate_2'))

	self.fx_list = {}

	--보석 위치에 퀘스트 마커 출력
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_character.red_crystal() }
	}, nil, nil, true)

	self:start_npc_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent))

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.grid_enter_scene and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's10_battle_grid') then
		self.current_state = self.states.red_crystal_interact_scene

		start_coroutine(self.grid_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.red_crystal_interact_scene and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_character.red_crystal()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_scene

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_character.red_crystal(), self.controller)

		--self.get_character.red_crystal().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		start_coroutine(self.red_crystal_interact_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_scene and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.ending

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

		start_coroutine(self.end_battle_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	self.stage_ended = true
end

function local_class:normal_dying_end_event(e)
	local constant_knight_list = self.get_character.constant_knight_list(8, 8)
	local constant_knight_leader_party = constant_knight_list['leader_party']

	for idx = 1, 8 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, constant_knight_leader_party[idx]) then
			self.dying_count = self.dying_count + 1

			return
		end
	end
end

--endregion Event

--region Custom
function local_class:grid_enter_scene()
	local fake_knight = self.get_character.fake_knight()
	local ghost_buster_another = self.get_character.ghost_buster_another()
	local teatan_hero_another = self.get_character.teatan_hero_another()

	local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	local fake_knight_move_pos_list = {
		center_pos + vector(3, -1, -10),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, -9),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, 0)
	}
	local ghost_buster_another_move_pos_list = {
		center_pos + vector(3, -1, -10),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, -9),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, -1)
	}
	local teatan_hero_another_move_pos_list = {
		center_pos + vector(3, -1, -10),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, -9),
		center_pos + vector(3, 0, 1)
	}
	--우측 그리드 진입로는 배틀게이트로 막아놓는다.
	--그리드 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏지 않은 채로 이벤트 진행.

	--짭기사 일행이 속도 8로 위 경로따라 이동한다.
	--(계단 올라갈 때 y축 높이도 올려서 이동.)
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fake_knight, fake_knight_move_pos_list,
			8, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ghost_buster_another, ghost_buster_another_move_pos_list,
			8, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(teatan_hero_another, teatan_hero_another_move_pos_list,
			8, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
end

function local_class:red_crystal_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ghost_buster = self.get_character.ghost_buster()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_character.teatan_hero()

	local fake_knight = self.get_character.fake_knight()
	local ghost_buster_another = self.get_character.ghost_buster_another()
	local teatan_hero_another = self.get_character.teatan_hero_another()

	local constant_knight_list = self.get_character.constant_knight_list(8, 8)
	local constant_knight_leader_party = constant_knight_list['leader_party']
	local constant_knight_fake_knight_party = constant_knight_list['fake_knight_party']

	local red_crystal = self.get_character.red_crystal()

	local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--보석에 인터랙트하면 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 진행.
	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
	--연출1
	--카메라 포커스는 1초간 보석에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move(center_pos, 1)

	--연출2
	--위 그림 위치대로 일행들 1초간 정렬.

	local teatan_hero_move_pos = center_pos + vector(-3, 0, 1)
	local leader_move_pos = center_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)
	local ghost_buster_move_pos = center_pos + vector(-3, 0, -1)

	local wp_key = 'wp_key_1'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(teatan_hero, teatan_hero_move_pos,
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_move_pos,
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ghost_buster, ghost_buster_move_pos,
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--짭기사 (left, idle, nod 1회)출력
	scene_util.set_anim_async(fake_knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.
	--가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_async({
		--(forced)보석을 향해 쏴라!
		{ 'bs_main_s10_choose_1', 'forced' },
		--(mercy)지금이야!
		{ 'bs_main_s10_choose_2', 'mercy' },
		--(intellect)파이어 인 더 홀!
		{ 'bs_main_s10_choose_3', 'intellect' },
	})

	--기사 right, attack, get, jump 2회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--짭기사(left, attack, nod 2회) : 알겠어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'bs_main_s10_1')

	--짭기사와 기사가 1초간 보석을 향해 1칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),

	--카메라 shake 세기 0.15, 0.1초 async 없이

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, 'damaged')

	--기사 일행 왼쪽으로 0.4초만에 6.5칸 밀려난다.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(-6.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.4, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'right', last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ghost_buster, ghost_buster.Position + vector(-6.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.4, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'right', last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(teatan_hero, teatan_hero.Position + vector(-6.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.4, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'right', last_direction = 'right' })

	--연출3
	--카메라 사이즈 0.4초만에 5.5로 줌아웃.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.5, 0.4)

	--각 연출 끝난 후, 다음 진행.
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 다음 연출 출력
	--리더 (right, attack, idle)
	--소히 1(right, attack, rifle_idle)
	--무기 장착: cwp_ghost_buster
	--마리안 1 (right, attack, rifle_idle)
	--무기 장착:  cwp_teatanhero
	--짭기사 (left, attack, idle)
	--무기는 cwp_knight / angel_shield 장착
	--소히2 (left, attack, rifle_idle)
	--무기 장착: cwp_ghost_buster
	--마리안 2 (right, attack, rifle_idle)
	--무기 장착:  cwp_teatanhero
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(ghost_buster)
	character_util.remove_anim(teatan_hero)
	character_util.remove_anim(fake_knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(ghost_buster_another)
	character_util.remove_anim(teatan_hero_another)

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster_another, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero_another, self, 'attack')

	--콘스탄트 기사 몬스터들이 공중에서 떨어지며 등장한다.
	--기사 쪽은 기사 성별 반대 콘스탄트 기사로,  left, idle, idle로 등장.
	--짭기사 쪽은 기사 성별 콘스탄트 기사로 right, idle, idle로 등장.
	local end_count = 0

	local target
	local dir
	local pos

	local constant_knight_leader_party_data = {
		target = constant_knight_leader_party,
		pos = {
			center_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 2.5),
			center_pos + vector(-6, 0, 0.5),
			center_pos + vector(-6, 0, -0.5),
			center_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, -2.5),
			center_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 2.5),
			center_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0.5),
			center_pos + vector(-3, 0, -0.5),
			center_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, -2.5),
		},
		dir = {
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
			'left',
		}
	}

	local constant_knight_fake_knight_party_data = {
		target = constant_knight_fake_knight_party,
		pos = {
			center_pos + vector(5.5, 0, 2.5),
			center_pos + vector(6, 0, 0.5),
			center_pos + vector(6, 0, -0.5),
			center_pos + vector(5.5, 0, -2.5),
			center_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 2.5),
			center_pos + vector(3, 0, 0.5),
			center_pos + vector(3, 0, -0.5),
			center_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -2.5),
		},
		dir = {
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
			'right',
		}
	}

	for idx = 1, #constant_knight_leader_party do
		start_coroutine(function()
			self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
					constant_knight_leader_party_data.target[idx],
					constant_knight_leader_party_data.dir[idx],
					constant_knight_leader_party_data.pos[idx],
					10,
					0.3,
					1,
					{ shadow_offset_y = 1 })

			end_count = end_count + 1
		end)
	end

	for idx = 1, #constant_knight_fake_knight_party do
		start_coroutine(function()
			self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
					constant_knight_fake_knight_party_data.target[idx],
					constant_knight_fake_knight_party_data.dir[idx],
					constant_knight_fake_knight_party_data.pos[idx],
					10,
					0.3,
					1,
					{ shadow_offset_y = 1 })

			end_count = end_count + 1
		end)
	end

	while (self.stage_ended) or
			(end_count ~= (#constant_knight_leader_party + #constant_knight_fake_knight_party)) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--전원 동시에 착지하는 순간 카메라 shake 0.3초, 세기 0.2
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	--카메라 사이즈 0.5초간 4로 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 1)

	--카메라 포커스는 0.5초간 기사에게로 복귀 async 없이.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--위 연출 끝나면 다음 진행

	--소히(right, attack, idle) : 순순히 부서질 생각은 없나보네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'bs_main_s10_2')

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--(intellect)플랜 B로 진행한다!
		{ 'bs_main_s10_choose_4', 'intellect' },
		--(mercy)아직 기회는 있어!
		{ 'bs_main_s10_choose_5', 'mercy' },
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(intellect)플랜 B로 진행한다!
		--기사 right, attack, cast2, jump 2회
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')

		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--마리안(right, attack, nod 2회) : 플랜 B같은 건 없었지만… 임기응변으로 가자고!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'bs_main_s10_3')
	else
		--(mercy)아직 기회는 있어!
		--기사 right, attack, dagger_idle, jump 2회
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dagger_idle')

		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--소히(right, attack, nod 2회) : 그래… 이 녀석들 얼른 해치워버리자고!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'bs_main_s10_4')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fake_knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster_another)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero_another)

	--이후 배틀게이트 올라오며 전투 진행.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('red_crystal_battle_gate_1'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('red_crystal_battle_gate_2'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('red_crystal_battle_gate_3'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('red_crystal_battle_gate_4'))

	--전투할 때 카메라 크기는 5로 진행
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

	--배틀 시작
	self:constant_knight_battle_start(constant_knight_leader_party)

	--짭기사 일행 싸우는 연출 진행(8섹션 참고 부탁드립니다.)
	start_coroutine(self.fake_knight_battle_routine, self)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:fake_knight_battle_routine()
	local fake_knight = self.get_character.fake_knight()
	local ghost_buster_another = self.get_character.ghost_buster_another()
	local teatan_hero_another = self.get_character.teatan_hero_another()

	local constant_knight_list = self.get_character.constant_knight_list(8, 8)
	local constant_knight_fake_knight_party = constant_knight_list['fake_knight_party']

	--짭기사 손에 무기 장착.
	scene_util.show_weapon(fake_knight)

	--소히 전무(시트에 추가될 예정, 무기 숨김 처리만 해제하면 될 것 같습니다.) 장착
	scene_util.show_weapon(ghost_buster_another)

	--0.5초간 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동.
	wp_util.move(fake_knight,
			fake_knight.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5)

	--소히2
	--0.5초만에 아래로 0.5칸 이동.
	wp_util.move(ghost_buster_another,
			ghost_buster_another.Position + vector(-1, 0, -0.5), nil, 0.5)

	--0.5초만에 아래로 0.5칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(teatan_hero_another,
			teatan_hero_another.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0.5), nil, 0.5)

	local explosion_routine = function(fo, duration, angle)
		local time_passed = 0
		local explosion_time_passed = -1
		local explosion_time_step = 0.2
		local struggle_time_passed = -1
		local struggle_time_step = 0.6

		character_util.shake(fo, 0.06, duration)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'damaged')

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			explosion_time_passed = explosion_time_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime
			struggle_time_passed = struggle_time_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--몸부림
			if struggle_time_passed < 0 then
				struggle_time_passed = struggle_time_step / 2
				character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(fo, angle, struggle_time_step / 6, struggle_time_step * 2 / 6)
				angle = angle * -1
			end

			--터지는 연출
			if explosion_time_passed < 0 then
				explosion_time_passed = explosion_time_step

				local center = fo.Bounds.center;
				local chance = unity_class.random.value
				local radius_rand = 0.5 + chance * 0.5

				local width = fo.Hitbox.size.x * radius_rand;
				local depth = fo.Hitbox.size.z * radius_rand;
				local rand = unity_class.random.value * math.pi * 2;
				local pos = center + vector(math.cos(rand) * width, 0, math.sin(rand) * depth)
				local explosion_fx = self.fx.explosion_small():Instantiate(pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, fo.transform)
				explosion_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.stop_shake(fo)
		character_util.cancel_spine_deviate_local_angle(fo)
	end

	local fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue = {
		2, 3, 6, 7
	}
	local ghost_buster_another_constant_knight_idx_queue = {
		4, 8
	}
	local teatan_hero_another_constant_knight_idx_queue = {
		1, 5
	}

	local common_hero_landing_routine = function(reset_data, idx_queue)
		local count = 0
		local end_count = #reset_data.target

		for idx = 1, end_count do
			table.remove(idx_queue, 1)
		end

		for idx = 1, end_count do
			table.insert(idx_queue, reset_data.death_target_idx[idx])
		end

		for idx = 1, end_count do
			start_coroutine(function()
				self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
						reset_data.target[idx],
						reset_data.dir[idx],
						reset_data.pos[idx],
						10,
						0.5,
						1,
						{ shadow_offset_y = 1 })

				count = count + 1
			end)
		end

		while self.current_state ~= self.states.ending and (count ~= end_count) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local fake_knight_routine = function()
		local effect_pos_1 = fake_knight.Bounds.center + vector(-1, 0, 0.5)
		local effect_pos_2 = fake_knight.Bounds.center + vector(-1, 0, -0.5)

		--region 이동용 콘스탄스 기사
		local move_target_idx_1 = fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue[3]
		local move_target_idx_2 = fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue[4]

		local move_target_1 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[move_target_idx_1]
		local move_target_2 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[move_target_idx_2]
		--region 이동용 콘스탄스 기사

		--region death 용 콘스탄스 기사
		local death_target_idx_1 = fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue[1]
		local death_target_idx_2 = fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue[2]

		local death_target_1 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[death_target_idx_1]
		local death_target_2 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[death_target_idx_2]

		local reset_data = {
			target = {
				death_target_1,
				death_target_2,
			},
			pos = {
				move_target_1.Position,
				move_target_2.Position
			},
			dir = {
				'right',
				'right'
			},
			death_target_idx = {
				death_target_idx_1,
				death_target_idx_2
			}
		}
		--endregion death 용 콘스탄스 기사

		--death 기사의 idx

		local sword_attack_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fake_knight, 'sword_attack')

		--이후 아래 루틴 반복.
		--left, attack, sword_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.
		scene_util.set_direction(fake_knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(sword_attack_duration * 0.5)

		if self.current_state == self.states.ending then
			return
		end

		--sword_attack 애니메이션에 기사들 맞는 순간에 맞추어
		--fx_hit, fx_lasthit 이펙트 배치.
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(effect_pos_1)
		self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(effect_pos_1)

		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(effect_pos_2)
		self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(effect_pos_2)

		--앞에 있는 콘스탄트 기사들 2명 왼쪽으로 airspin 되어 사라진다.(완전히 사라질 때까지 async.
		character_util.air_spin(death_target_1, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })
		character_util.air_spin(death_target_2, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		death_target_1.Position = self.wait_pos
		death_target_2.Position = self.wait_pos

		self:heal_routine(death_target_1)
		self:heal_routine(death_target_2)

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.current_state == self.states.ending then
			return
		end

		--기사 left, attack, sword_idle.
		scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, 'sword_idle')

		--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--연출1
					--콘1, 콘2 위치에 있던 콘스탄트 기사들 2명이 1초간 앞으로 3칸 이동한다.
					local move_key = 'move_key'

					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(move_target_1,
							move_target_1.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
							nil, 1, self, move_key)

					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(move_target_2,
							move_target_2.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
							nil, 1, self, move_key)

					wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
				end,
				function()
					--연출2
					--콘스탄트 기사들 2명이 콘1, 콘2 자리에 화면 바깥에서부터 0.5초간 right, idle, idle로 떨어지며 등장한다.
					common_hero_landing_routine(reset_data, fake_knight_constant_knight_idx_queue)
				end
		)
		--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.
	end

	local ghost_buster_another_routine = function()
		--소히2

		--region 이동용 콘스탄스 기사
		local move_target_idx_1 = ghost_buster_another_constant_knight_idx_queue[2]

		local move_target_1 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[move_target_idx_1]
		--region 이동용 콘스탄스 기사

		--region death 용 콘스탄스 기사
		local death_target_idx_1 = ghost_buster_another_constant_knight_idx_queue[1]

		local death_target_1 = constant_knight_fake_knight_party[death_target_idx_1]

		local reset_data = {
			target = {
				death_target_1,
			},
			pos = {
				move_target_1.Position,
			},
			dir = {
				'right',
			},
			death_target_idx = {
				death_target_idx_1
			}
		}
		--endregion death 용 콘스탄스 기사

		--이후 아래 루틴 반복

		--fx_magiton_chain_ready 이펙트를 소히2에게 배치.
		self.fx.magitonchain_ready():Instantiate(ghost_buster_another.Position)

		--소히2 left, attack, rifle_reload 1회 실행.
		scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster_another, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster_another, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(ghost_buster_another, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', count = 1 })

		--아래 연출 각 한 줄마다 동시에 진행.
		--fx_magiton_chain을 소히2와 정면의 콘스탄트 기사 사이에 연결.
		local weapon_offset = vector(-1, 0.15, 0)
		local magitonchain = self.fx.magitonchain():Instantiate(
				ghost_buster_another.Bounds.center + weapon_offset,
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 150, 0), nil)

		magitonchain.transform.localScale = vector(0.75, 1, 1)

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--콘스탄트 기사 right, damaged, damaged로 smallExplosion 연출 1초로 죽는다.
					explosion_routine(death_target_1, 1, 15)

					if self.current_state == self.states.ending then
						return
					end

					local dead_state = CS.Oak.CharacterSmallExplosionState.Create(death_target_1, 1, 0.2)

					message_system:Send(death_target_1.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(dead_state))

					wait_for_sec(1)
				end,
				function()
					--0.4초마다 재배치하여 총 2회 배치
					--fx_magiton_chain_Firing 이펙트를 전무 끝에 배치.
					--fx_magiton_chain_Firing 이펙트를 정면 여기사 스파인 중앙 지점에 위치.
					wait_for_sec(0.4)
					self.fx.magitonchain_fire():Instantiate(ghost_buster_another.Bounds.center + weapon_offset)

					wait_for_sec(0.4)
					self.fx.magitonchain_fire():Instantiate(ghost_buster_another.Bounds.center + weapon_offset)
				end,
				function()
					--소히2 left, attack, rifle_shoot2 애니메이션 1초간 실행.
					scene_util.play_wait_action(ghost_buster_another, self,

		missile.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(2, 2, 2)
		local trail = self.fx[tail_key]():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)

			trail.transform.position = cur_value

function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration, finish_y_pos, data)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	finish_y_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(finish_y_pos, 0)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	local info = {}

	info.shadow_offset_y = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_offset_y', 0)
	info.is_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_active', true)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	if info.is_active then
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > finish_y_pos then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
		end

		fo.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = info.shadow_offset_y - fo.Position.y

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--TODO: 착지 될 때 효과음이 고정이라면 여기서 랜딩 끝날 때의 사운드 재생 하는 것도 좋을 듯함
	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
end

	heal_info.skipEffect = true

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end
--endregion Setting

return local_class

		end,
		--짭기사
		fake_knight = function()

		end,
		--반대기사 투명화로 사용
		camera_tracking_fo = function()
			return user_util.get_knight_character('fake_knight_female', 'fake_knight_male')
		end,
		--콘스탄트 기사 리스트 호출
		constant_knight_list = function(leader_party_number, fake_knight_party_number)
			local is_leader_constant_male = user_util.has_knight_male()

			local constant_knight_party_list = {}

			constant_knight_party_list['fake_knight_party'] = {}

			end

		--레드 크리스탈

	--endregion Marker

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			cwp_knight = 21593,
			champion_sword = 21580,
			red_crystal = 21594,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		lasthit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		atk_red = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bs_obj_turret_debuff_atk_red')
		end,
		magiton = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bs_ghostbuster_magiton')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil
	--endregion Fx

	--region HeavenHold
	self.resholder = nil
	self.tavern_root = nil
	self.tavern_camera = nil

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.dying_count = 0

	self.atk_red_loop = true

	self.is_finish_speech = false

	self.is_animal = nil

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 60065
	--endregion Etc
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), 'normal_dying_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_npc_setting()

	self.fx_list = {}

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_get, self.background_fade_controller = global_table_util.try_create_background_fade_controller()

		--asset_path, asset_name 디폴트 값 사용
		self.background_fade_controller:load_async('ondemand/blossom/effects', 'white_tint_background')
	end)

	local is_animal_type_character = function()
		if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Pet or
				user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.WhiteTigerBaby then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	self.is_animal = is_animal_type_character()

	start_coroutine(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent))

	self.atk_red_loop = false

	--페이드 아웃 관련
	if self.background_fade_controller ~= nil then
		self.background_fade_controller:dispose_loaded()
		self.background_fade_controller = nil

		self.is_get = nil
	end

	if self.resholder then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:normal_dying_end_event(e)
	local constant_knight_list = self.get_character.constant_knight_list(8, 8)
	local constant_knight_leader_party = constant_knight_list['leader_party']

	for idx = 5, 6 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, constant_knight_leader_party[idx]) then
			self.dying_count = self.dying_count + 1

			return
		end
	end
end

--endregion Event

--region Custom
function local_class:start_scene()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0)
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ghost_buster = self.get_character.ghost_buster()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_character.teatan_hero()

	local fake_knight = self.get_character.fake_knight()
	local ghost_buster_another = self.get_character.ghost_buster_another()
	local teatan_hero_another = self.get_character.teatan_hero_another()

	local constant_knight_list = self.get_character.constant_knight_list(8, 8)
	local constant_knight_leader_party = constant_knight_list['leader_party']
	local constant_knight_fake_knight_party = constant_knight_list['fake_knight_party']

	local red_crystal = self.get_character.red_crystal()

	local camera_tracking_fo = self.get_character.camera_tracking_fo()
	--화면 페이드인 전 세팅.
	--마 : 마리안
	--up, attack, rifle_idle, 전무 장착 상태.
	--소 : 소히
	--down, attack, rifle_idle, 전무 장착 상태.
	--기 : 기사
	--right, attack, dagger_idle, 무기 장착 안 한 상태.
	--기2 : 짭기사
	--left, attack, dagger_idle, cpw_knight와 angel_shield 장착 되어 있는 상태로 출력
	--소2 : 소히2
	--down, attack, rifle_idle, 전무 장착 상태.
	--마2 : 마리안2
	--up, attack, rifle_idle, 전무 장착 상태.
	scene_util.hide_weapon(leader)
	scene_util.show_weapon(ghost_buster)
	scene_util.show_weapon(teatan_hero)

	scene_util.hide_weapon(fake_knight)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fake_knight, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_knight')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fake_knight, '[base]weapon2', 'angel_shield')

	scene_util.show_weapon(ghost_buster_another)
	scene_util.show_weapon(teatan_hero_another)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 1초간 검게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--소히 앞에 있는 콘스탄트 기사들이 위쪽으로 1초간 0.5칸 이동한다. async
	local wp_key = 'wp_key_1'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(constant_knight_leader_party[5],
			constant_knight_leader_party[5].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 1, self, wp_key)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(constant_knight_leader_party[6],
			constant_knight_leader_party[6].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 1, self, wp_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--아래 연출 동시 출력
	--소히 (down,attack, rifle_shoot2) 상태 출력되며 아래 방향으로 FX_Magiton_pack 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, 'rifle_shoot2')

	local laser_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hyper_laser_01', loop = true })

	local fx_magiton = self.fx.magiton():Instantiate(
			ghost_buster.Bounds.center + vector(0.05, 0, -0.6),
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0), nil)

	--주황색 콘스탄스 기사 shake 0.03세기로 1초간 출력
	scene_util.shake(constant_knight_leader_party[5], 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.shake(constant_knight_leader_party[6], 0.03, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(ghost_buster)

	fx_magiton:Dispose()

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(laser_sfx)

	--모두 완료되면 다음으로 진행

	--소히 (down, attack, rifle_idle) 상태 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, 'rifle_idle')

	local constant_knight_save_pos_list = {
		constant_knight_leader_party[5].Position,
		constant_knight_leader_party[6].Position
	}

	--주황색 콘스탄스 기사 아래로 air spin으로 사망
	character_util.air_spin(constant_knight_leader_party[5], { offset = unity_class.vector3.down * 3 })
	character_util.air_spin(constant_knight_leader_party[6], { offset = unity_class.vector3.down * 3 })

	while self.dying_count ~= 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--주황색 콘스탄트 기사 위치 (up, idle) 상태로 y축에서 10에서 0까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동
	local end_count = 0

	for idx = 1, 2 do
		start_coroutine(function()
			self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
					constant_knight_leader_party[idx + 4],
					'up',
					constant_knight_save_pos_list[idx],
					10,
					0.3,
					1,
					{ shadow_offset_y = 1 })

			--y축 0에 도달하면 fx_hit 출력
			self.fx.hit():Instantiate(constant_knight_save_pos_list[idx] + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			end_count = end_count + 1
		end)
	end

	while end_count ~= 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--소히(down, attack, rifle_idle) : 주… 줄어들지를 않잖아…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'down',
			nil, 'attack', 'bs_main_s11_1')

	--카메라 0.7초에 걸쳐 짭기사 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(fake_knight, 0.7)

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 shake 0.03세기로 0.5초간 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)

	--짭기사 (left, attack, sword_idle)[shout 말풍선] : $name!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(fake_knight, self, nil,
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'bs_main_s11_2', skip = false, force_sfx = true })

	--카메라 0.7초에 걸쳐 리더 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	--기사 고개 끄덕.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_async({
		--(forced)주인공 등장!
		{ 'bs_main_s11_choose_1', 'forced' },
		--(brutal)전투의 함성!
		{ 'bs_main_s11_choose_2', 'brutal' },
		--(mercy)공주님을 위해!
		{ 'bs_main_s11_choose_3', 'mercy' },
	})

	--기사 right, attack, get, jump 2회
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--카메라 사이즈 0.5초만에 3으로 줌인. async 없이.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)

	--카메라 포커스 0.5초만에 짭기사에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(fake_knight.Position, 0.5)

	--짭기사(left, attack, unique/throw_down) 애니메이션 스케일 0으로 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(fake_knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, { name = 'unique/throw_down', scale = 0 })

	----짭기사 weapon2에 손에 cwp_knight 장착

	--짭기사 unique/throw_down 애니메이션 1회 실행, 끝 자세 유지.
	local throw_down_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fake_knight, 'unique/throw_down')

	character_util.remove_anim(fake_knight)
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, { name = 'unique/throw_down', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(throw_down_duration * 0.4)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fake_knight, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_02')

	--cwp_knight를 기사 위에 배치해서 기사가 일직선으로 던지는 듯한 연출 진행.
	local start_pos_2 = fake_knight.Bounds.center + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	local cwp_knight_2 = self.sprite:create('cwp_knight_2', start_pos_2,
			self.sprite.sprite_info.cwp_knight, 0.75, true,
			nil, nil, true)

	quest_drop_item_util.rotate(cwp_knight_2, 135, 0)

	camera_tracking_fo.Position = cwp_knight_2.SpriteTransform.position

	local origin_parent = cwp_knight_2.SpriteTransform.parent
	local shadow_origin_parent = cwp_knight_2.ShadowTransform.parent

	cwp_knight_2.SpriteTransform:SetParent(camera_tracking_fo.Transform)
	cwp_knight_2.ShadowTransform:SetParent(camera_tracking_fo.Transform)

	--0.3초만에 정면의 콘스탄트 기사에게로 직선으로 날아간다. async 없이. 카메라는 cwp_knight 아이템 팔로우.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(camera_tracking_fo,
			camera_tracking_fo.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.3, self, wp_key)

	stage_camera:Move(camera_tracking_fo, 0.1, camera_tracking_fo, true)

	--0.2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--타임 스케일 슬로우 0.1배속.
	time_util.mod('slow', 0.1)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--칼 도착하는 순간
	--콘스탄트 기사 right, damaged, damaged.
	scene_util.set_emotion(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4], self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4], self, 'damaged')

	--타임 스케일 슬로우 제거.
	time_util.unmod('slow')

	--도착 위치에 fx_hit, fx_lasthit 배치.
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4].Bounds.center)
	self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4].Bounds.center)

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
	local curves_duration = 1.6
	local start_pos = camera_tracking_fo.Position
	local end_pos = center_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)

	local qte_stop = false

	local jump_move_function = function(duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = fake_knight.Position
		local end_pos = center_pos + vector(0.6, 0, 0)

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			local cur_pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, 1.5, nil, 1)

			character_util.set_position(fake_knight, cur_pos, true)

			if not qte_stop then
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			while qte_stop do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					wait_for_sec(0.38)

					--짭기사 right, attack unique/pound 애니메이션 1회 실행하여 높이 1.5로 점프해 0.8초만에 보석 좌표 + (0.6, 1.5, 0) 위치로 이동.
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fake_knight)

					scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')
					scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, { name = 'unique/pound', loop = false })
				end,
				function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
					jump_move_function(0.8)
				end
		)
	end)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

				--콘스탄트 기사 NPC 일반 피격 연출 출력
				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4].Bounds.center + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
				self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4].Bounds.center + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4])
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4])

				--화면 shake 0.03세기로 0.5초간 출력
				camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)

				--콘스탄트 기사 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 이동
				wp_util.move_async(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4],
						constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
						nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

				--1초 대기 후 (right, prostrate) 출력
				wait_for_sec(1)

				scene_util.set_anim(constant_knight_fake_knight_party[4], self, 'prostrate')
			end,
			function()
				--연출1 - 칼 포물선 그리며 날아가는 연출
				--cwp_knight는 초당 765도 회전하며 높이 4로 포물선을 그리며 2초만에 보석 좌표 + (-2.5, 0, 0.7) 지점으로 이동한다. 최종 도착 시에는 바닥과 수직으로 서도록 처리.
				--계속해서 카메라는 팔로우 하되, x축으로만 이동하고 y, z축은 이동하지 않는다.
				camera_tracking_fo.SpineController:SetShadowAlpha(1)
				cwp_knight_2.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

				quest_drop_item_util.rotate(cwp_knight_2, 742.5 * curves_duration, curves_duration)

				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(curves_duration, function(progress)
					local pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, 4, -1, 1)
					local add_sprite_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 0.7, progress)

					cwp_knight_2.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, add_sprite_z)

					character_util.set_position(camera_tracking_fo, pos, true)
				end)

				--parent 초기화
				cwp_knight_2.SpriteTransform:SetParent(origin_parent)
				cwp_knight_2.ShadowTransform:SetParent(shadow_origin_parent)
			end,
			function()
				--연출2 - 칼 도착 지점에 기사가 도착하는 연출
				--0.8초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.8)

				--기사 right, attack, get으로 높이 1로 점프해서 0.8초만에 칼 도착 지점 좌표 + (0, 0, -0.7) 지점에 도착.
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')

				character_util.jump(leader, 1, 0.8)

				wp_util.move_async(leader, end_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), nil, 0.8)

				self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(end_pos)
			end
	)
	--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.
	--카메라 팔로우 기사로 전환.
	stage_camera:Move(leader, 0.5, leader, true)

	--아이템 스프라이트 제거하고, 기사 손에 cwp_knight 장착.
	camera_tracking_fo.Position = self.wait_pos

	self.sprite:dispose('cwp_knight_2')

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_knight')

	--기사 right, attack, sword_idle로 전환.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_idle')

	--시간 멈춤 처리.
	local mod_key = 'mod_key'

	--QTE 우측으로 슬라이드.
	--실패 처리 없음.
	--성공시 다음 연출 진행.
	qte_stop = true

	local all_npc_set_time_scale = function(time_scale)
		--모든 npc 정지
		for _, npc in pairs(constant_knight_leader_party) do
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, time_scale)

		end

		for _, npc in pairs(constant_knight_fake_knight_party) do
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, time_scale)

		end

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(fake_knight, time_scale)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(ghost_buster_another, time_scale)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(teatan_hero_another, time_scale)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(leader, time_scale)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(ghost_buster, time_scale)

	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	--타임 스케일 슬로우 0.1배
	time_util.mod(mod_key, 0.1)

	--카메라 0.3초간 보석 포커스로 이동 (async 없이)
	all_npc_set_time_scale(1)

	qte_stop = false


	--기사 right, attack, sword_attack_stab으로 보석을 타격.
	if self.is_animal then

			local fishing_throw_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'fishing/fishing_throw')

			wait_for_sec((fishing_throw_duration * 0.33) * 0.4)

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(leader, 0)
		end)
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })
	end

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(red_crystal, 'Top Effects', 3)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(leader, 'Top Effects', 1)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(fake_knight, 'Top Effects', 2)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(red_crystal, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fake_knight, false)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--보석 타격되는 순간
				wait_for_sec(0.15)

				--카메라 shake 세기 0.15, 0.4초
				camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.4)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')

				--무기 닿은 위치에 fx_hit, fx_lasthit 배치.
				local leader_fx_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.4, 0.2, 0.2)

				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader_fx_pos)
				self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(leader_fx_pos)

				local fake_knight_fx_pos = center_pos + vector(0.4, 0.2, 0.2)

				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(fake_knight_fx_pos)
				self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(fake_knight_fx_pos)

				--0.2초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--타임 스케일 슬로우 원복.
				time_util.unmod(mod_key)

				--카메라 보석 원래 위치로 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동
				camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0.5)
			end,
			function()
				if self.is_animal then
					--기사 0.3초간 우측으로 1칸 이동.
					wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0), nil, 0.22)
				else
					wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 0.3)
				end
			end
	)
	--짭기사 쪽과 동시에 무기 끝이 보석에 닿는 게 목표입니다.

	--1.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--보석 스프라이트 shake 0.03세기로 지속.
	scene_util.normal_shake(red_crystal, 9999, false)

	--아래 루틴 시작
	--FX_Obj_Turret_Debuff_atk_red를 크기 0.1배로 0.3초마다 하나씩 배치
	self.atk_red_loop = true

	local is_air_spin = true

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(red_crystal, 'Top Effects', 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local sec_term = 0.3
		local idx = 0
		local time_passed = 0

		local execute_fx_duration = 0

		while self.atk_red_loop do
			if time_passed >= execute_fx_duration then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_limit_break_05')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_champ_sword_06')

				self.fx_list['atk_red_' .. idx] = self.fx.atk_red():Instantiate(red_crystal.Position + vector(0, 1.7, 0))

				idx = idx + 1

				execute_fx_duration = sec_term * idx
			end

			if is_air_spin and time_passed >= 0.5 then
				is_air_spin = false

				--콘스탄스 기사 airspin로 모두 제거
				--왼쪽은 왼쪽으로 출력
				--오른쪽은 오른쪽으로 출력
				for _, npc in pairs(constant_knight_leader_party) do
					character_util.air_spin(npc, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })
				end

				for _, npc in pairs(constant_knight_fake_knight_party) do
					character_util.air_spin(npc, { offset = unity_class.vector3.right * 3 })
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end)

	--카메라 0.05세기로 shake 지속 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	if self.is_animal then
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(leader, 1)

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_idle')
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, 'sword_idle')

	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.normal_jump(fake_knight)

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(red_crystal, 'Top Effects', 4)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(leader, 'Top Effects', 2)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(fake_knight, 'Top Effects', 3)

	--FX_Obj_Turret_Debuff_atk_red 제거
	self.atk_red_loop = false

	--카메라 shake 제거

	--보석 break 애니메이션 타임스케일 0.3배로 출력
	time_util.mod(mod_key, 0.3)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(red_crystal, 'break') * 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	end)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(red_crystal, self, { name = 'break', loop = false })

	--타일스케일 끝나면 복귀
	time_util.unmod(mod_key)

	character_util.stop_shake(red_crystal)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(red_crystal, active_state_type.disabled)

	--가시/짭기사 (보는 방향, smile, idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fake_knight)

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'smile')

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, 'sword_idle')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--짭기사 (left, smile, idle): $name! 성공했어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, nil,
			nil,
			'smile',
			'bs_main_s11_2_1')

	--기사 (right, smile, victory_sword 1회 출력)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep = true })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, volume = 0.6 })

	--카메라 shake 세기 0.1로 시작.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999)

	--기사/짭기사 (attack)표정과 동시에 1회 점프 출력
	--기사 (right, attack, sword_idle)
	--짭기사 (left, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')

	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(fake_knight)

	self.is_finish_speech = false

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local back_move_key = 'back_move_key'

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--짭기사 (left, attack, idle): 공간이… 붕괴되고 있어…!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(fake_knight, self, nil,
						nil,
						'smile',
						'bs_main_s11_2_2')

				--기사, 짭기사 0.5초에 걸쳐 뒷걸음질으로 네모 위치에 각자 이동
				--(attack, sword_walk)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')

				if self.is_animal then
					character_util.remove_anim(leader)
				else
					scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_walk')
				end

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
						center_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, self,
						back_move_key, { last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

				scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, 'sword_walk')

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fake_knight,
						center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, self,
						back_move_key, { last_direction = 'left', locked_dir = 'left' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, back_move_key)

				character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sword_idle')
				scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight, self, 'sword_idle')

				local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

				self.is_finish_speech = true

				start_coroutine(function()
					--카메라 skake 4초에 걸쳐 서서히 제거
					coroutine_util.while_each_frame(4, function(progress)
						local cur_magunitude = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.1, 0, progress)

						camera_util.cancel_shake()

						camera_util.shake(cur_magunitude, 1)
					end)

					camera_util.cancel_shake()
				end)

				--화면 하얗게 5초간 페이드 아웃. async 없이.
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_color(255, 255, 255)
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_active(true)
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_sorting_order('Top Effects', 1)
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_scale(100)
				self.background_fade_controller:set_background_position(center_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(shake_sfx, 5)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 5)

				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(5, function(progress)
					self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(progress * 1)
				end)

				character_util.stop_shake(red_crystal)
			end,
			function()
				--뒷걸음질 대기 시간 까지 대기
				while not self.is_finish_speech do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				self.is_finish_speech = false

				--짭기사 left, smile, idle 1.5초 대기.
				scene_util.set_emotion(fake_knight, self, 'smile')

				wait_for_sec(1.5)

				--짭기사 (left, sleep_deep, idle) 상태에서 (silence) 이모티콘 출력
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(fake_knight, self,
						'left',
						nil,
						'sleep_deep',
						'silence')

				--짭기사(left, smile, idle):언젠가 또 말날 수 있기를.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, nil,
						nil,
						{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
						'bs_main_s11_2_3')

				--짭기사(left, smile, bomb_Idle) : 언젠가 또 만날 수 있기를. 또 하나의 나.
				--방패 뺀 상태로
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
				character_util.spine_set_attachment(fake_knight, '[base]weapon2', 'empty')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, nil,
						{ name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true },
						{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
						'bs_main_s11_3')

				self.is_finish_speech = true
			end
	)

	--화면이 완전히 하얗게 페이드아웃 된 이후, 기사, 짭기사 1초에 걸쳐 하얀색 틴트 1에서 0까지 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')

	character_util.add_fade_color(leader, leader.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 1)
	character_util.add_fade_color(fake_knight, fake_knight.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	self:tavern_scene()
end

function local_class:tavern_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ghost_buster = self.get_character.ghost_buster()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_character.teatan_hero()
	local princess = self.get_character.princess()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.white)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(ghost_buster, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, active_state_type.enabled)

	scene_util.hide_weapon(leader)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(ghost_buster)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(teatan_hero)

	--페이드인 전 세팅
	--루틴 제거 및 카메라 shake 제거
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(0)

	local center_pos_2 = self.get_marker_pos.center(2) + vector(0, 0, -0.05)

	local party_move_list = {
		leader = {
			start_pos = center_pos_2 + vector(-0.25, 0.1, -2 + 1),
		},
		teatan_hero = {
			start_pos = center_pos_2 + vector(-0.15, 0.1, -0.75 + 1),
			align_pos = center_pos_2 + vector(-0.25, 0.1, -1.2 + 1),
		},
		ghost_buster = {
			start_pos = center_pos_2 + vector(0.95, 0.1, -0.75 + 1),
			align_pos = center_pos_2 + vector(1.1, 0.1, -1.5 + 1),
		}
	}

	--바닥에 보석이 하나 놓여져 있다.
	--기사, 마리안 right, sleep, prostrate
	--소히 left, sleep, prostrate
	character_util.set_position(leader,
			party_move_list.leader.start_pos)
	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero,
			party_move_list.teatan_hero.start_pos)
	character_util.set_position(ghost_buster,
			party_move_list.ghost_buster.start_pos)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'left', false)

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'sleep')

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, 'prostrate')

	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)

	--카메라 사이즈 3.
	self:load_tavern()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)

	local camera_pivot = self.get_marker_pos.center(2) + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pivot, 0)

	local champion_sword_creation_pos = party_move_list.ghost_buster.align_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.25)
	local red_crystal_creation_pos = champion_sword_creation_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	--카메라 포커스 아래 그림의 붉은 보석 지점으로.
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(leader, 'Default', 0)

	character_util.remove_fade_color(leader, leader.Name, 0)

	--챔피언소드 스프라이트 아래 그림의 위치에 배치.
	self.sprite:create('champion_sword', champion_sword_creation_pos,
			self.sprite.sprite_info.champion_sword, 0.5, true,
			nil, nil, true)
	--	quest_drop_item_util.rotate(self.sprite.sprite_table['champion_sword'], 225)

	self.sprite.sprite_table['champion_sword']:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Default', 0)

	--붉은 보석 스프라이트 아래 그림의 위치에 배치.
	self.sprite:create('red_crystal', red_crystal_creation_pos,
			self.sprite.sprite_info.red_crystal, 0.5, false,
			nil, nil, true)

	self.sprite.sprite_table['red_crystal']:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Default', 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lobby_heaven_hold', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })

	--부유성 여관 내부 로드.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--잠들어 있던 일행들 마리안, 소히, 기사 순으로 2회 shake한 후, 마리오 점프하며 일어난다. 일어났을 때 표정 tired로.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				character_util.shake_and_wakeup(teatan_hero, 'right', nil, 'tired', true)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.shake_and_wakeup(ghost_buster, 'left', nil, 'tired', true)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(2)

				character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'right', nil, 'tired', true)
			end
	)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마리안(right, tired, idle) : 아우… 머리야….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'bs_main_s11_4')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 연출
	--마리안 (right, tried, walk) 1초에 걸쳐 위와 동일하게 정렬
	--1섹션 최초 상태
	--소히 (left, tired, walk) 1초에 걸쳐 위와 동일하게 정렬
	--1섹션 최초 상태
	do
		wp_util.move(ghost_buster, party_move_list.ghost_buster.align_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_async(teatan_hero, party_move_list.teatan_hero.align_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	--소히 left, idle, idle):  question 이모티콘.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ghost_buster, nil, 'question')

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(ghost_buster, '[base]weapon1', 'bs_red_gem')

	--소히(left, idle, bow_idle, 손에 보석 든 채로) : 이건… 뭐지?
	--소히 애니메이션 유지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, nil,
			{ name = 'bow_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'bs_main_s11_5')

	--마리안, 기사도 right, tired, bow_idle로 보석을 손에 든다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'bs_red_gem')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(teatan_hero, '[base]weapon1', 'bs_red_gem')

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'tired')

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bow_idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, 'bow_idle')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 선1택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--(mercy) 이건 분명… 꿈에서…?
		{ 'bs_main_s11_choose_4', 'mercy' },
		--(intellect) : 비싸게 팔 수 있지 않을까?
		{ 'bs_main_s11_choose_5', 'intellect' },
	})

function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, height_x1, height_x2)
	height_x1 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x1, 0)
	height_x2 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x2, 0)

	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(height_x1, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(height_x2, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration, finish_y_pos, data)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	finish_y_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(finish_y_pos, 0)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	local info = {}

	info.shadow_offset_y = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_offset_y', 0)
	info.is_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_active', true)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	if info.is_active then
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > finish_y_pos then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
		end

		fo.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = info.shadow_offset_y - fo.Position.y

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:interact_portal_scene()
	local linda = self.character.linda
	local student_president = self.character.student_president
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster_another
	local teatan_hero = self.character.teatan_hero_another

	--린다/케이트 인터렉션 시 BGM 볼륨 0.6
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove(linda.name)

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	--린다/케이트 둘 중 누구에게든 인터랙트하면 이벤트 진행.
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(ghost_buster, 'Default', 2)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(knight, 'Default', 2)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(teatan_hero, 'Default', 2)

	--1초간 위 위치로 일행들 정렬.
	--도착하면 기사 일행 전원 up, idle, idle.
	do
		local knight_pos = self.marker.party_pos(2, 1) + vector(0,0,-0.5)
		local teatan_hero_pos = self.marker.party_pos(2, 2) + vector(0,0,-0.5)
		local ghost_buster_pos = self.marker.party_pos(2, 3) + vector(0,0,-0.5)

		wp_util.move(knight, knight_pos, nil, 1, {last_direction = 'up'})
		wp_util.move(teatan_hero, teatan_hero_pos, nil, 1, {last_direction = 'up'})
		wp_util.move_async(ghost_buster, ghost_buster_pos, nil, 1, {last_direction = 'up'})
	end

	--케이트 down, scared, idle
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(student_president)
	scene_util.set_direction(student_president, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(student_president, self, 'tired')

	--린다(down, scared, idle, jump 1회) : $name! 큰일이야!
	character_util.normal_jump(linda, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(linda, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'damaged', keep = true }, 'blossom_main_s2_1')

	--린다(up, scared, release 2회) : 밥이 저 안에…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(linda, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'blossom_main_s2_2')

	scene_util.set_direction(linda, 'down', false)

	--케이트(down, scared, release 2회) : 우… 우리 학교 학생 한 명도 빨려 들어갔어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(student_president, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },{ name = 'damaged', keep = true }, 'blossom_main_s2_3')

	--소히(up, idle, bomb_idle) : 학생회장? 여기서 뭐 하고 있었던 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'up',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'blossom_main_s2_4')

	--케이트(down, scared, cast) : 네가 부유성에 왔다고 하길래 몇명이서 구경하러 왔었어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(student_president, self, 'down',
			'cast', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'blossom_main_s2_5')

	--케이트(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 그런데 갑자기 균열이 생기더니 미나랑 수염많은 아저씨가 저 안으로 빨려들어갔어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(student_president, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'blossom_main_s2_6')

	--린다(down, tired, idle) : 아, 그리고 붉은색 모자를 쓴… 옐다?도 빨려 들어갔어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(linda, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'blossom_main_s2_7')

	--케이트(down, tired, idle) : 하이퍼 씨… 였던 것 같아요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(student_president, self, 'left',

	do

function local_class:intro_scene()

	local student_president = self.character.student_president
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster_another
	local teatan_hero = self.character.teatan_hero_another

	self:load_heavenhold_backgroud()

	local heavenhold_center_pos = self.marker.party_pos(1, 1)
	local portal_front = self.marker.portal_front()

	--위 그림 좌하단처럼 선 채로 right, idle, idle.
	--균열 이펙트 배치
	--fx_event_portalspawn_red_open 이펙트 사용.
	--퀘스트 마커는 린다에게.
	--린다 down, scared, idle
	--케이트 up, idle, success

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(linda, 'Default', 2)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(student_president, 'Default', 2)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(linda, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.set_position(linda,
			portal_front + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(linda, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(linda)
	scene_util.set_emotion(linda, self, 'tired')
	character_util.add_listener(linda, self.controller)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(student_president, active_state_type.enabled)

			portal_front + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(student_president, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(student_president)
	scene_util.set_emotion(student_president, self, 'tired')
	character_util.add_listener(student_president, self.controller)

	self.fx_portal = self.fx:portal():Instantiate(self.marker.portal())

	local portal_aura = self.fx_portal.transform:GetChild(1)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local component = portal_aura.transform:GetChild(i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystemRenderer))
		component.sortingLayerName = 'Default'
		component.sortingOrder = 1
	end

	character_util.set_position(knight, heavenhold_center_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, "right")

	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero,
			self.marker.party_pos(1, 2))
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, "right")

	character_util.set_position(ghost_buster,
			self.marker.party_pos(1, 3))

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.rescue then
		if self.current_rescue_state.hyper == self.rescue_state.battle and
				type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.hyper()) then

			self.current_rescue_state.hyper = self.rescue_state.complete

			start_coroutine(self.interact_hyper, self)

			return true
		elseif self.current_rescue_state.bob == self.rescue_state.safe and
				type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.bob()) then

			self.current_rescue_state.bob = self.rescue_state.complete

			start_coroutine(self.interact_bob, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_rescue_state.student_bad == self.rescue_state.safe and
				type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.student_bad()) then

			self.current_rescue_state.student_bad = self.rescue_state.complete

			start_coroutine(self.interact_student_bad, self)
			return true
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.bob_run and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_bob_run_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.constant_knight

		start_coroutine(self.bob_run_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.constant_knight and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_constant_knight_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.constant_knight_battle

		sp_util.start_scene(self.constant_knight_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.chasm and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_center_chasm_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.rescue

		sp_util.start_scene(self.center_chasm_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.rescue then
		if self.current_rescue_state.bob == self.rescue_state.danger then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'bob_chasm_field') then
				self:inner_chasm_monster_setting(true)

				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_bob_battle') then
				self.current_rescue_state.bob = self.rescue_state.battle

				start_coroutine(self.enter_bob_chasm, self)

				return true
			end
		end

		if self.current_rescue_state.student_bad == self.rescue_state.danger then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'student_bad_chasm_field') then
				self:inner_chasm_monster_setting(false)

				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_student_bad_battle') then
				self.current_rescue_state.student_bad = self.rescue_state.battle

				start_coroutine(self.enter_student_bad_chasm, self)

				return true
			end
		end

		if self.current_rescue_state.hyper == self.rescue_state.danger and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_hyper_zone') then
			self.current_rescue_state.hyper = self.rescue_state.battle

			start_coroutine(self.enter_hyper_chasm, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.constant_knight_battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name.constant_knight then

		self.current_state = self.states.chasm

		start_coroutine(self.after_constant_knight_battle, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.rescue then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name.bob then

			self.current_rescue_state.bob = self.rescue_state.safe

			local bob = self.npc.bob()
			bob.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			character_util.add_listener(bob, self.controller)

			--배틀게이트 OFF
			self:open_battle_gate(self.battle_gate.bob)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_teatans_main' })

			self:convert_constant_knight_to_npc()
			return true

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name.student_bad then

			self.current_rescue_state.student_bad = self.rescue_state.safe

			character_util.add_listener(self.npc.student_bad(), self.controller)

			--배틀게이트 OFF
			self:open_battle_gate(self.battle_gate.student_bad)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_teatans_main' })

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('student_bad_door', false))

			self:convert_constant_knight_to_npc()
			return true

		end
	end

	return false
end
