function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.group_name, npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if npc_preset.pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_preset.pos)
		end

		if npc_preset.dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, npc_preset.dir)
		end

		if npc_preset.emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_preset.emo)
		end

		if npc_preset.anim ~= nil then
			local anim_data = {
				name = data[i].anim,
				one_shot_sfx = false,
				scale = 1
			}

			if npc_preset.anim_scale ~= nil then
				anim_data.scale = 1.5
			end

			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim_data)
		end

		if npc_preset.active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_preset.active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if npc_preset.tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_fade_color(npc, npc_preset.name, npc_preset.tint, 1, 0)
		end

		if npc_preset.alpha ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_preset.alpha, 0)
		end

		if npc_preset.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_preset.hitbox
		else
			npc.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.75, 0.4))
		end

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if npc_preset.group_name == 'spirit' then
			npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		end

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end
end

-- 해당 함수가 메인 퀘스트 컨트롤러에 있어서 서브퀘스트는 따로 복사
function local_class:hole_in(fo_list, pos, start_y, dir, offset, duration, delay)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.5)
	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0.2)
	start_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(start_y, 12)

	local group = {}

	if not type_util.is_table(fo_list) then
		table.insert(group, fo_list)
	else
		group = fo_list
	end

	local bounce_cb = function(count)
		if count ~= 1 then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01', type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'player' })
	end

	local fall_cal_list = {}

	for i = 1, #group do
		local fo = group[i]

		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'embarrassed')

		local fall_cal = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(start_y, 12, 12, 1, bounce_cb)
		fall_cal:SetElasticity(0.3)
		fall_cal:ScaleTime(1.8)

		local target_pos = pos + offset[i]
		character_util.set_position(fo, vector(target_pos.x, fall_cal:GetDistance(), target_pos.z), true)

		table.insert(fall_cal_list, {
			fo = fo,
			cal = fall_cal
		})
	end

	local list_cal = fall_cal_list[#fall_cal_list]
	local current_time = 0

	while fall_cal_list ~= nil and not list_cal.cal:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		current_time = current_time + dt

		for i = 1, #fall_cal_list do
			local fo = fall_cal_list[i].fo
			local cal = fall_cal_list[i].cal

			local is_active = current_time > (delay * i)

			if not cal:IsDone() and is_active then
				cal:Proceed(dt)
				fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, cal:GetDistance())
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(group)

	for i = 1, #group do
		local fo = group[i]
		local target_pos = pos + offset[i]
		character_util.set_position(fo, vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos))
	end
end

function local_class:entrance_zone_event_scene()
	self.current_state = self.states.entrance_event

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local first_entrance_pos = self.pivot_pos.first_entrance_pos()

	--최조 진입 연출 (존 엔터)
	--빨간 네모 존 진입 시 강제 연출 진행
	--화면 shake 0.05세기로 지속 출력
	local portal_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_portal_04', loop = true })

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 999)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 균열 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(first_entrance_pos, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_01')

	--위의 균열 위치에 fx_event_portalspawn_red_open 출력
	self.fx_list['red_open'] = self.fx.portal_red():Instantiate(first_entrance_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5))
	self.fx_list['red_open_exit'] = self.fx.portal_red():Instantiate(self.pivot_pos.portal_exit_pos())

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--균열로 인해 스타피스를 못먹는 형태
	--fx_event_portalspawn_red_open 출력 완료되면 다음 연출 진행

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(portal_sfx, 1)

	--화면 shake 정지
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 리더 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--리더 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 복귀 후 컨트롤 해제
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_party_leader())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:hole_in_directing(hole_pos, delay, dir)
	local jump_duration = 0.5

	local cur_user_party = get_user_party()

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 0, cur_user_party.Count - 1 do
			local fo = cur_user_party[i]

			local target_pos = hole_pos.Position
			local dist = vector_util.magnitude(fo.Position - target_pos)

			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')
			character_util.jump(fo, 1, jump_duration)

			local speed = math.max(1, dist / jump_duration)

			wp_util.move(fo, target_pos, speed, nil, {
				locked_dir = dir
			})

			start_coroutine(function()
				wait_for_sec(jump_duration - delay)
				character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.27)
			end)

			wait_for_sec(delay)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, interpolations_constants.linear)
end

function local_class:hole_fall_directing(delay, dir, target_pos, is_white_fade)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local start_y = 12

	camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 0)

	local fall_cal_list = {}
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local fo = leader

	character_util.stop(fo)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	local fall_cal = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(start_y, 12, 12, 0)
	fall_cal:SetElasticity(0.3)
	fall_cal:ScaleTime(1.8)

	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(target_pos.x, fall_cal:GetDistance(), target_pos.z), true)

	table.insert(fall_cal_list, {
		fo = fo,
		cal = fall_cal
	})

	if not is_white_fade then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.7, interpolations_constants.linear)
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.white)
	end

	local list_cal = fall_cal_list[#fall_cal_list]
	local current_time = 0

	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 1800, 1.6)

	while fall_cal_list ~= nil and not list_cal.cal:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		current_time = current_time + dt

		for i = 1, #fall_cal_list do
			local fo = fall_cal_list[i].fo
			local cal = fall_cal_list[i].cal

			local is_active = current_time > (delay * i)

			if not cal:IsDone() and is_active then
				cal:Proceed(dt)
				fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, cal:GetDistance())
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:entrance_event_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local center_pos = self.pivot_pos.first_entrance_pos()

	local party_align_pos = {
		center_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
		center_pos + vector(-4.5, 0, 0.5),
		center_pos + vector(-4.5, 0, -0.5),
		center_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 1),
		center_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 0),
		center_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, -1)
	}

	local game_start_pos = self.pivot_pos.game_start_pos()

	--현재 파티멤버 저정
	self:save_party()
	self:clone_leader_npc()

	--균열 인터렉트 시 위와 같이 정렬
	--리더 (right, idle, idle)
	--마리안, 소히 (right, idle, idle)
	--짭기사 (right, idle, idle)
	--티탄을 탄 마리안 (right, idle, idle)
	--소히 5성 (right, idle, idle)
	--파티원 3인일 때도 동일
	local wp_key = 'align_key'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	for idx = 1, #self.save_user_party do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.save_user_party[idx], party_align_pos[idx],
				nil, 1, self, wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--파티멤버 npc화
	for idx = 2, #self.save_user_party do
		scene_util.set_direction(self.save_user_party[idx], 'right', false)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.save_user_party[idx])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local portal_inhole_wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_portal_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })

	--균열 좌측 2타일에 fx_obj_event_portal_wind_up R (y:90)로 배치
	local portal_pos = self.pivot_pos.first_entrance_pos()
	local portal_wind_up = self.fx.portal_inhole_wind():Instantiate(portal_pos + vector(0.4, 0, 0.5))

	portal_wind_up.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

	--0.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--모든 파티원 (surprise) 표정 출력
	for idx = 1, #self.save_user_party do
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.save_user_party[idx], self, 'surprise')
	end

	--파티원 뒤로 1타일 1초에 걸쳐 (surprise, walk)로 이동
	for idx = 2, #self.save_user_party do
		local npc = self.save_user_party[idx]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc,
				npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1, self, nil,
				{ run = false, locked_dir = 'right' })
	end

	--리더 (right, surprise, idle) 상태로 1회 normal_jump 후 (notice) 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			'notice')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--동시 출력
	--리더 (right, surprise, idle) 상태에서 shake 0.02세기로 지속 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.02, 9999)

	--리더 1초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 0.5타일로 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'idle' })

	local wp = leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, 1, { run = false })

	--리더 (right, surprise, embarrassed) 상태로  y축 최대 0.25 상태로 포탈 중앙으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wp_util.move_async(leader, portal_pos + vector(0, 0.25, 0), nil, 0.5,
			{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying' })

	--동시 연출
	--도착하면 리더 알파값 1에서 0으로 0.3초에 걸쳐 전환
	--카메라 0.7초에 걸쳐 circular fade out
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 0, 0.3)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(portal_inhole_wind_sfx, 1)
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 1, 0)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	portal_wind_up:Dispose()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	for idx = 2, #self.save_user_party do
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.save_user_party[idx])
	end

	--리더만 일반적인 holeInteractable의 진입 연출(구멍에 뛰어들고, 화면 검게 서큘러 페이드 아웃 되는 것)까지만 실행.

	-- 떨어지는 연출
	self:hole_fall_directing(0.2, 'right', game_start_pos)

	--리더 right, empty, prostrate로 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'empty')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	--FX_Common_SmokeScreen 배치.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.fx.smokescreen():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(game_start_pos))

--리더 복제
function local_class:clone_leader_npc()
	if self.already_copied then
		return
	end

	self.already_copied = true

	local copy_leader = self.dynamic_npcs:get('copy_leader', 'copy_leader')

	yield_return_func(self.setting_dynamic_npc_skin, self)

	local npc = copy_leader

	scene_util.set_direction(copy_leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(copy_leader, self, 'empty')
	scene_util.set_anim(copy_leader, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', -1)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

	character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)

	npc.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.4, 0.75, 0.35))
end

function local_class:setting_dynamic_npc_skin()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local user_party_leader = get_party_leader()

	local asset_bundle_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetBundleName
	local asset_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetName
	local skin_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.SkinName

	local dynamic_npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get('copy_leader', 'copy_leader')

	-- 코스튬이 있다면 코스튬으로 아니면 캐릭터 기본 스팩의 데이터로 SpriteAssetName 세팅
	if user_party_leader.Costume == nil then
		dynamic_npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName
	else
		dynamic_npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName = user_party_leader.Costume.CostumeSpec.AssetName
	end

	-- 캐릭터 일반 이름 세팅
	dynamic_npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CharacterName = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.CharacterName

	-- 메뉴얼 조종할 때 캐릭터 걷기 속도 세팅
	dynamic_npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed

	-- 메뉴얼 조종할 때 캐릭터 달리기 속도
	dynamic_npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed

	-- 프리팹 불러올 때 까지 대기
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			asset_bundle_name, asset_name, function(prefab)
				local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				local spine_controller = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

				if spine_controller ~= nil then
					dynamic_npc.SpineController:SwitchSpineController(spine_controller)
				else
					CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go)
				end
			end)

	-- 스킨 설정
	if skin_name then
		dynamic_npc.SpineController.SkinName = skin_name
	end
end

function local_class:save_party()
	self.save_user_party = {}

	for idx = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.save_user_party, user_party[idx])
	end
end

function local_class:convert_party()
	if not self.save_user_party then
		return
	end

	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.save_user_party[2], user_party)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.save_user_party[3], user_party)

	if #self.save_user_party == 6 then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.save_user_party[4], user_party)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.save_user_party[5], user_party)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.save_user_party[6], user_party)
	end

	self.save_user_party = nil
end
--endregion EntranceEvent

function local_class:possession_success_scene()
	self.gimmick:possession_success_scene()
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

return local_class

		--빙의 공통 연출
	end

	--위 연출 전부 끝나면 다음으로 진행

	scene_util.set_emotion(dokkaebi, self, 'tired')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(dokkaebi, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	--동시 출력
	do
		local is_speech_end = false

		--은하 (tired, idle) 상태로 0.5초 간격으로 (right, left) 3회 반복
		--대사 출력: 여긴….
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil,
					nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_19')

			is_speech_end = true
		end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(dokkaebi, direction_constants.right)

			character_util.set_direction(dokkaebi, direction_constants.left)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		while not is_speech_end do

		end
	end

	--은하 (left, tired, idle): 숲 속에서 수련 중이었는데… 갑자기 이상한 균열에 빠져버렸어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_20')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	field_object_util.shake(dokkaebi, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.play_wait_action(dokkaebi, self, 'down',

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(dokkaebi, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, nil, 'silence')

	--은하 (down, attack, cast) 1초간 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(dokkaebi, self, 'attack')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--은하 (down, attack, idle): 아니…! 매번 신선님들에게 의지할 순 없어요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(dokkaebi)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_21')

	--은하 (left, attack, idle): 그동안… 신선님의 수련도 열심히 받았고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_21_1')

	--은하 (left, attack, victory_get): 새로운 도술도 많은 연습했으니까요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
			'victory_get', nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_21_2')

	--은하 (left, attack, idle 상태에서 normal_jump 2회 출력): 이곳에서 나가는 방법을 찾아봐야겠어요!
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
						nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_dokkaebi_body_22')

	--카메라는 은하 팔로우 없이 현 상태 고정
	camera_util.unset_target()

	--은하 (attack, run) 6의 속도로 햐얀색 화살표 방향으로 이동
	do
		local wp = {}

		wp[1] = dokkaebi.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2.5
		wp[2] = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', wp[1])

		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = dokkaebi })

		wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, 6,
				nil, { run = true })

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)
	end

	--카메라 밖으로 나가면 제거

return {

	end
}

 		local item = self.spirit_data.fo_list[summer_android_spirit].item

		field_object_util.set_active_state(summer_android_spirit, active_state_type.enabled)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_04')

		local temp_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local time_passed = 0
		local final_duration = 1
		local start_pos = mecha_android.Bounds.center
		local end_pos = mecha_android.Position + vector(2, 0, 2)
		local height = 1

		while true do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed >= final_duration then
				break
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration)

			-- 아이템 포물선운동
			local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
			summer_android_spirit.Position = temp_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

return {

	end

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_11')
	end

	--AA72 (right, smile, idle): 앞으로 더 도움이 되는 스텔라가 될 수 있을 겁니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_12')

	do
		local is_speech_end = false

		start_coroutine(function()
			--AA72 (right, smile, idle 상태에서 2회 normal_jump): 푸슉! 푸슉! 푸슉!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
					nil, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_13')

			is_speech_end = true
		end)

		character_util.normal_jump_async(summer_android, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.cancel_jump(summer_android)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(summer_android, '01_small_jump_01')

		while not is_speech_end do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--AA72 위 노란색 동선으로 이동
	do
		--AA72 위 노란색 동선으로 이동
		--(idle, run)
		--6의 속도
		local first_wp = {}
		local speed = 6

		first_wp[1] = summer_android.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 4
		first_wp[2] = first_wp[1] + unity_class.vector3.right * 2

		wp_util.move_async(summer_android, first_wp, speed, nil, {run = true, play_sfx = '01_dash_01'})

		local jump_distance = 5

		--빨간색 1번 위치 도달하면 (right, idle, jump)로 y축 최대 2의 높이로 빨간색 2번 위치까지 이동
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'jump')
		character_util.jump(summer_android, 1, jump_distance / speed)
		wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * jump_distance,
				speed, nil, { y_mode = 'flying' })

		character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)

		--도착하면 노란색 동선 마저 이동
		wp_util.move_async(summer_android, screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', summer_android.Position),
				speed, nil, { y_mode = 'floor' })
	end

	--AA72 카메라 그리드 밖으로 나가면 출력 제거 상태
	field_object_util.set_active_state(summer_android, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:mecha_android_possession_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local summer_android = self.section.dynamic_npcs:get('body', 'summer_android')
	local mecha_android_spirit = self.section.spirit.mecha_android_spirit.fo()

	--Mk.99 메모리가 들어갈 경우
	do
		--플레이어 위와 같이 정렬
		--(left, idle, idle)
		--1초에 걸쳐 이동
		wp_util.move_async(knight, summer_android.Position + vector(2, 0, -1),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = direction_constants.left })

		--빙의 공통 연출
	end

	--위 연출 전부 끝나면 다음으로 진행

	--AA72 (right, idle, prostrate): 메모리 동기화 작업 진행 중….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(summer_android)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
	nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_1')

	character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)

	--AA72 (right, idle, idle): 이 기체는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_2')

	--AA72 (right, smile, idle): 그토록 바라던 AA 시리즈입니다.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
						nil, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_3')
			end,
			function()
				character_util.normal_double_jump(summer_android, true)
			end
	)

	--AA72 (right, smile, idle) shake 출력: 이제 더 이상 숨어서 쉬지 않아도 됩니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	field_object_util.shake(summer_android, 0.03, 9999)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_4')

	field_object_util.stop_shake(summer_android)

	--AA72 (right, smiel, idle): 부유성 광장에서 대놓고 쉬어야겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_4_1')

	--AA72 (right, mad, idle) 상태에서 (notice) 출력
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.8, 1)
	field_object_util.shake(summer_android, 0.03, 9999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'mad', 'notice')

	field_object_util.stop_shake(summer_android)

	--AA72 (right, mad, idle): 메모리 동기화 실패.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'mad', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_5')

	--AA72 (right, mad, idle): 이럴 순 없습니다…. 나의 꿈이….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	field_object_util.shake(summer_android, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, 'mad', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_6')

	--AA72 (right, damaged, prostrate): 으윽… 메모리가 사출 됩니다.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true }, 'damaged', 'bs_possession_s1_summer_android_body_7')
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1.5)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
			end
	)

	--동시 출력
	do
		character_util.shake(summer_android, 0.03, 1)

		--AA72 스파인에서 fx_dead 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.section.fx.dead():Instantiate(summer_android.Position)

		--AA72 (right, dead, prostrate) 상태 출력?
		scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'empty')

		--1번 위치에 메모리 y축 최대 2 높이까지 1초에 걸쳐 포물선 이동
		local item = self.spirit_data.fo_list[mecha_android_spirit].item
		quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(item, 1, 0)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(mecha_android_spirit, active_state_type.enabled)

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

		local temp_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local time_passed = 0
		local final_duration = 1
		local start_pos = summer_android.Bounds.center
		local end_pos = summer_android.Position + vector(1, 0, -2.5)
		local height = 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_04')
		while true do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed >= final_duration then
				break
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration)

			-- 아이템 포물선운동
			local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
			mecha_android_spirit.Position = temp_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:enter()

	local android = self.controller.get_android() ---@ type Character
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debug_loop, self))

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()

	self.game_ended = true
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

			party_util.align_party(vector(-13.46704, 0, -173.8172), 'down', 0)
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')

			-- 카메라 그리드 변경 기다림
			coroutine.yield()

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
			party_util.reset_controllers()
		elseif CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.W) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_reaper_brings_android_scene, self)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

---@param e InteractEvent
---@return boolean
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 하나로 플레이하고 있는지 확인 필수.
	if not self.controller:is_playing_hana()then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_gate_interactable()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_reaper_brings_android_scene, self)
	end
	return true
end

---@param e ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller:is_playing_hana() then return false end

	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	---@type string
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.judgement_door_event_name and not self.seen_android_entering then
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_reaper_brings_android_scene, self)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.play_reaper_brings_android_scene, self))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:play_reaper_brings_android_scene()
	self.seen_android_entering = true

	local gate = get_field_object('judgement_gate')
	local gate_animator = gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	gate.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	gate_animator.speed = 7
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gate_open_01')
	gate_animator:Play('judgegate_open')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	--region 필요 NPC 설정
	local android = self.controller.get_android() ---@type Characater
	local reaper = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(1) ---@type Characater

	android.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	reaper.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(reaper, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(android, field:GetMarker('android_gate_init').position)
	character_util.set_position(reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_1_gate_init').position)

	character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'down')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 0, 0)

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldAndroidSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = AfterWorldAndroid @
		Comment = 안드로이드의 처우에 관해 이야기하는 사신들 @
		index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 섹션의 상태
	self.section_state = {
		none = 0,
		entered_office = 1,
	}

	self.current_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 대사 키
	self.script_key = 'aw_android_s1_'

	-- 이벤트 존
	self.administrative_office_zone = 'administrative_office_enterence'

	self.is_administrative_office_npc_active = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	local android = self.controller.get_android()
	local reaper = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(1)
	local office_reaper = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(6)

	self:set_office_when_event_not_available(office_reaper, android, reaper)

	-- 퀘스트 진행 조건에 부합한지 확인.
	if not self:is_quest_available() then
		reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_android_pre_4'
		return
	end

	self:subscribe_events()
	self:set_administrative_office()
	self:set_office_2()

	self.evidence_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Theatres/AfterWorldEvidence')

	self.is_administrative_office_npc_active = true
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:set_office_when_event_not_available(office_reaper, android, reaper)
	character_util.set_position(office_reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_android_pre_2').position)
	character_util.set_direction(office_reaper, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_state(office_reaper, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(android, field:GetMarker('android_office').position)
	character_util.set_position(reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_android_pre_1').position)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(android, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(reaper, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(reaper, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	character_util.set_emotion(reaper, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 안드로이드에 스타피스 이펙트 설정
	if self.controller.cached_star_piece_effect == nil then
		local star_piece_effect_pool = self.controller.get_star_piece_effect()
		---@type PooledUnityObject
		self.controller.cached_star_piece_effect = star_piece_effect_pool:Instantiate(android.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, android.Transform)
	end

	office_reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_android_pre_1'
	reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_android_pre_4'
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.is_administrative_office_npc_active then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	end
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:subscribe_events()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

---@param e CameraGridEnterEvent
function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local entered_grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'corp_lobby') then
		if not self.is_administrative_office_npc_active then
			self:subscribe_events()
			self:set_administrative_office()
			self:set_office_2()
			self.is_administrative_office_npc_active = true
		end
	end
end

---@param e ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name ---@ type string

	if zone_name == self.administrative_office_zone then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_administrative_office_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 안드로이드를 행정실로 데려와 사신과 대화하는 씬
function local_class:play_administrative_office_scene()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.entered_office

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-11, 0, -207.5), 1)

	local reaper_1 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(1) ---@ type Character
	local reaper_2 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(2) ---@ type Character
	local reaper_3 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(3) ---@type Character
	local reaper_4 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(4) ---@type Character
	local reaper_5 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(5) ---@type Character
	local reaper_6 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(6) ---@type Character
	local android = self.controller.get_android() ---@ type Character

	-- 행정실에 안드로이드 떠넘거기 도망감.
	self:toss_android_to_office(reaper_1, reaper_2)

	-- 중앙으로 사신과 안드로이드 모음
	self:gather_reapers_at_center(reaper_2, reaper_3, reaper_4, reaper_5, reaper_6, android)

	-- 안드로이드들의 처우에 대해서 논의
	self:reapers_argued_about_android(reaper_2, reaper_3, reaper_4, reaper_5, reaper_6)

	-- 안드로이드, 다 무시하고 구석으로 가서 eat자세로 만화책 꺼낸 후 누운 채로 만화책을 보기 시작한다.
	self:android_found_comics(reaper_2, reaper_3, reaper_4, reaper_5, reaper_6, android)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false

---@param e InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target


	-- 배터리 상호작용해서 먹는 연출
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.controller.get_interactable_battery()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.found_energy_battery then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pick_up_battery, self)
		end

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.controller.get_reaper_at_office2_by_idx(3)) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.found_new_battery, self)
		end

		-- 안드로이드에게 배터리를 넣는 연출
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.controller.get_android()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.picked_up_battery then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_android_battery_inserted, self)
		end
	end
end

	local moved_object = e.FieldObject

			character_util.set_active_state(employee_1, 'disabled')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_emotion(employee_3, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(employee_3, { key = self.script_key .. 9 })
			character_util.move_distance_async(employee_3, move_distance, nil, move_speed,
					true, true)
			character_util.set_position(employee_3, far_far_away)
			character_util.set_active_state(employee_3, 'disabled')
		end)
	})

	local battery = self.controller:get_interactable_battery()
	battery.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	character_util.add_listener(battery, self.controller)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 사무실 2에 있는 안드로이드 배터리를 집어드는 씬
function local_class:pick_up_battery()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.picked_up_battery

	local battery = self.controller:get_interactable_battery()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(battery, self.controller)
	battery.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.controller.android_battery_sprite.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.item_get_event('aw_android_battery',
			'aw_android_battery_title', 'aw_android_battery_sub',
			'aw_android_battery_desc')

	character_util.add_listener(self.controller.get_android(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:play_android_battery_inserted()
	local android = self.controller.get_android()

	party_util.align_to_target(android, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 배터리를 넣을 것인지 떠날 것인지 선택.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 배터리를 넣는다.
		{ self.script_key .. 'choice_1', 'mercy' },
		-- 떠난다.
		{ self.script_key .. 'choice_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then return end

	self.current_state = self.section_state.inserted_battery

	local reaper_2 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(3)
	local reaper_3 = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(4)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.controller)

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true, 'temp')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	local battery = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = user_party.Leader.Position, target = android.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
			, itemid = 20500, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true, sprscale = 0.929,
			  showoncharacter = true })
	battery.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.01, -0.03)
	battery.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1.055, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false, 'temp')
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.125)

	-- 배터리 dropitem으로 던지고 아이템이 안드로이드에게 들어가서 안드로이드 벌떡 선 채로 덜덜 떨다가 눈 돌아오는 것으로 변경
	battery.ConsumeTarget = android

	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(android)
	local shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_04', loop = true })
	character_util.shake(android, 0.07, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.stop_shake(android)
	shake_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_robot_02')
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	-- 배터리를 안드로이드에 넣으면 안드로이드 전원 들어옴
	character_util.remove_emotion(android)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.remove_emotion(android)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.75)

	-- 저승사자2(down, surprise, release) : 어? 저 친구 눈에 불 들어왔어요!
	character_util.set_direction(reaper_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(reaper_2, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_2, { key = self.script_key .. 11, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(reaper_2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(reaper_2)

	-- 저승사자3(down, idle, question) : 이제 이승으로 돌려보낼 수 있겠는데요?
	character_util.set_direction(reaper_3, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_3, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_3, { key = self.script_key .. 12, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(reaper_3)

	-- 안드로이드(left, idle, idle) : …
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 안드로이드(left, idle, idle) : 드디어 편히 쉴 수 있나 했는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 안드로이드(left, idle, idle) : 결국 날 찾았군요. 축하합니다. 그럴 가치가 있었나요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 15, skip = true })

	-- 저승사자2 안드로이드에게 달려가서 release
	local reaper_2_wp_to_android = {
		reaper_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
		reaper_2.Position + vector(1, 0, -5.5),
		reaper_2.Position + vector(4.5, 0, -5.5),
		reaper_2.Position + vector(4.5, 0, -4.5)
	}
	character_util.move_waypoint(reaper_2, reaper_2_wp_to_android, 5, true,
			nil, nil, 'left', true)

	-- 안드로이드(left, idle, idle) : 그 집요함에 존경을 표합니다, 마스터
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 16, skip = false })

	-- 저승사자2(right, idle, release) : 만화책은 놓고 가!
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(reaper_2, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_2, { key = self.script_key .. 17, skip = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(reaper_2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'attack_stab', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate((reaper_2.Position + android.Position) / 2)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(android)

	character_util.set_emotion(reaper_2, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.move_to_async(reaper_2, reaper_2.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.right,
			nil, 8, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_2, { name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 안드로이드(down, idle, idle) : …마크룩스 마지막 권은…
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = self.script_key .. 34, skip = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matching_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 18, skip = true })

	self.controller.comics.ConsumeTarget = android

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- TODO: FIXME: dissolve 이펙트 나오면 사라지는 연출 바꿀것.
	-- 안드로이드(down, idle, idle) : (서서히 사라진다.)…내…가… 가져간다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(android, 0, 2)

	--대사와 동시에 저승사자2 surprise표정으로 마리오점프로 일어남
	character_util.set_emotion(reaper_2, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(reaper_2, 'left')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.script_key .. 19, skip = false })
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'disabled')
	self.controller.cached_star_piece_effect:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 안드로이드가 사라진 곳에 스타피스 떨어진다.
	local android_position = android.Position
	star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), android_position, android_position)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
end

-- 행정실에 있는 사신 NPC들 설정
function local_class:set_administrative_office()
	local office_center = field:GetMarker('administrative_office').position - vector(0, 0, 1)

	local android = self.controller.get_android()
	character_util.set_position(android, vector(-12, 0, -209))
	-- 안드로이드에 스타피스 이펙트 설정
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(android, office_center + vector(2.5, 0, -3.5))
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'sleep' })

	if self.controller.cached_star_piece_effect == nil then
		local star_piece_effect_pool = self.controller.get_star_piece_effect()
		---@type PooledUnityObject
		self.controller.cached_star_piece_effect = star_piece_effect_pool:Instantiate(android.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, android.Transform)
	end

	-- 만화책 설정
	if self.controller.comics == nil then
		self.controller.comics = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = android.Position, target = android.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
				, itemid = 20511, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true, sprscale = 0.6,
				  showoncharacter = true })

		local drop_item_rotation_adj = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -14.5, -40.32))
		local drop_item_position_adj = vector(-0.08, 1.5, -0.31)
		self.controller.comics.SpriteTransform.localRotation = drop_item_rotation_adj
		self.controller.comics.ShadowTransform.localRotation = drop_item_rotation_adj
	end

	-- 사신들 설정
	local num_administrative_reapers = 5

	-- 섹션2에서 사용되는 사신들의 초기 좌표
	local init_poses = {
		office_center + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
		office_center + vector(-1.5, 0, 1),
		office_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -1),
		office_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -2),
		office_center + vector(1.5, 0, -1),
	}

	for i = 1, num_administrative_reapers do
		local reaper = self.controller.get_reaper_by_idx(i + 1)
		local init_pos = init_poses[i]
		character_util.set_position(reaper, init_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(reaper, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim(reaper)
	end
end

-- 오피스2 초기 설정
function local_class:set_office_2()
	local num_reapers = 3
	local marker_name = 'office2_reaper_pos_'
	local reaper_dir = {
		'down',
		'right',
		'left'
	}

	for i = 1, num_reapers do
		local reaper = self.controller.get_reaper_at_office2_by_idx(i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name .. i)

		character_util.set_active_state(reaper, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(reaper, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(reaper, reaper_dir[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(reaper)

		if i == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(reaper, { name = 'eat' })
			character_util.add_listener(reaper, self.controller)
		end
	end

	local drop_item_rotation_adj = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
	local battery_pos = field:GetMarker('battery_pos').position

	if self.controller.android_battery_sprite == nil then
		self.controller.android_battery_sprite = self.controller:generate_drop_item(20500, 'dontfindlooter', battery_pos)
		self.controller.android_battery_sprite.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1.5, -0.4)
		self.controller.android_battery_sprite.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1.5, -0.5)
		self.controller.android_battery_sprite.SpriteTransform.localRotation = drop_item_rotation_adj
		self.controller.android_battery_sprite.SpriteTransform.localRotation = drop_item_rotation_adj
	end

	local battery = self.controller:get_interactable_battery()
	battery.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	battery.Position = battery_pos - vector(0, 1, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class
